1.155.s:
āditya uvāca
sādhusādhu suraśreṣṭha sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi bhūdhara .
śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ kṛṣṇa gadato nikhilaṃ mama . . 1
1.155.d:
आदित्य उवाच
साधुसाधु सुरश्रेष्ठ साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि भूधर ।
शृणुष्वैकमनाः कृष्ण गदतो निखिलं मम ॥ 1
1.155.m:
Āditya said:
Well said, well said, foremost of the gods! Well have I been asked, O bearer of the earth! / Listen with single-minded attention, O Kṛṣṇa, as I declare everything.

1.155.s:
ārādhaya tvayaṃ devo mama rūpamanaupamam .
catuṣkoṇaṃ paraṃ vyoma adbhutaṃ gairikojjvalam . . 2
1.155.d:
आराधय त्वयं देवो मम रूपमनौपमम् ।
चतुष्कोणं परं व्योम अद्भुतं गैरिकोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 2
1.155.m: Let this god worship my incomparable form: / the supreme sky with four corners, wondrous and bright as red ochre.

1.155.s:
tvāmārādhya ca cakrāṃkaṃ śaṃkaro vṛttamādarāt ..
śabdādau satataṃ brahma sagarādau trilocanaḥ .. 3 ..
1.155.d:
त्वामाराध्य च चक्रांकं शंकरो वृत्तमादरात् ॥
शब्दादौ सततं ब्रह्म सगरादौ त्रिलोचनः ॥ 3 ॥
1.155.m: Having worshipped you marked with the discus, Śaṅkara [shall worship] the circular [form] with reverence, / Brahmā continually in sound and the rest, and the three-eyed one in Sagara and the rest.

1.155.s:
madhyāhne tvaṃ sadā deva bhaktyā māmarcayasva vai ..
yatheṣṭamṛbhavaḥ sarve bhaktyā māṃ pūjayaṃtu vai .. 4 ..
1.155.d:
मध्याह्ने त्वं सदा देव भक्त्या मामर्चयस्व वै ॥
यथेष्टमृभवः सर्वे भक्त्या मां पूजयंतु वै ॥ 4 ॥
1.155.m: At midday, O god, do worship me always with devotion; / let all the Ṛbhus worship me with devotion as they desire.

1.155.s:
tato brahmādayo devāḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ vibhāvasoḥ ..
praṇamya śirasā sarvaṃ idaṃ vacanamabruvan .. 5 ..
1.155.d:
ततो ब्रह्मादयो देवाः श्रुत्वा वाक्यं विभावसोः ॥
प्रणम्य शिरसा सर्वं इदं वचनमब्रुवन् ॥ 5 ॥
1.155.m: Then the gods headed by Brahmā, having heard the words of the sun, / bowed their heads to everything and spoke these words:

1.155.s:
dhanyā deva vayaṃ sarve kṛtakṛtyāstathaiva ca ..
asmābhirbhagavānpṛṣṭa stejasā prajvalaṃti ca .. 6 ..
1.155.d:
धन्या देव वयं सर्वे कृतकृत्यास्तथैव च ॥
अस्माभिर्भगवान्पृष्ट स्तेजसा प्रज्वलंति च ॥ 6 ॥
1.155.m: Blessed are we all, O god, and we have accomplished our purpose; / the Blessed One has been questioned by us, and they blaze with splendour.

1.155.s:
saṃbhūtā jñāninaḥ sarve bhavato darśanādvayam ..
tamomohāttathā taṃdrā sarvamekapade gatam .. 7 ..
1.155.d:
संभूता ज्ञानिनः सर्वे भवतो दर्शनाद्वयम् ॥
तमोमोहात्तथा तंद्रा सर्वमेकपदे गतम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.155.m: All of us have become possessors of knowledge from seeing you; / darkness, delusion, and lethargy have vanished all at once.

1.155.s:
vayaṃ tvanmūrtayaḥ sarve tejasā tava saṃvṛtāḥ ..
utpattisthitināśāya lokānāṃ tava śāsanāt .. 8 ..
1.155.d:
वयं त्वन्मूर्तयः सर्वे तेजसा तव संवृताः ॥
उत्पत्तिस्थितिनाशाय लोकानां तव शासनात् ॥ 8 ॥
1.155.m: We are all your forms, enveloped by your splendour, / for the creation, preservation, and destruction of the worlds, by your command.

1.155.s:
sthitāḥ sarve surajyeṣṭha lokapālāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
adhunā sādha yāmeha vyomnaḥ pūjāṃ vrajāmahe .. 9 ..
1.155.d:
स्थिताः सर्वे सुरज्येष्ठ लोकपालाश्च कृत्स्नशः ॥
अधुना साध यामेह व्योम्नः पूजां व्रजामहे ॥ 9 ॥
1.155.m: All the world protectors and all the eldest gods are positioned in their entirety. / Now we shall set forth; let us go to worship the firmament.

1.155.s:
itthaṃ teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ ..
uvāca brahmaviṣṇvīśānsāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ .. 1.155.10 .. ..
1.155.d:
इत्थं तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा भास्करो वारितस्करः ॥
उवाच ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशान्सामपूर्वमिदं वचः ॥ 1.155.10 ॥ ॥
1.155.m: Having heard their words, the sun, who steals the waters, / spoke these soothing words to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva:

1.155.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
evametanna saṃdeho yadā vadatha suvratāḥ..
yūyaṃ manmūrtayaḥ sarve yuṣmākamahameva hi..11..
1.155.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
एवमेतन्न संदेहो यदा वदथ सुव्रताः॥
यूयं मन्मूर्तयः सर्वे युष्माकमहमेव हि॥11॥
1.155.m: Āditya said: / It is just so, without doubt, as you speak, O men of good vows: / you are all my forms, and I alone indeed am you.

1.155.s:
yadetaddarśanaṃ devāḥ pramāṇa ca yaduttamam..
jvālāmālākulaṃ śubhraṃ śāṃḍileyamivojjhitam .. 12 ..
1.155.d:
यदेतद्दर्शनं देवाः प्रमाण च यदुत्तमम्॥
ज्वालामालाकुलं शुभ्रं शांडिलेयमिवोज्झितम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.155.m: That which is this vision, O gods, and which is the supreme authority, / filled with garlands of flames, radiant, as if abandoned by Śāṇḍilī,

1.155.s:
yuṣmākaṃ devaśārdūlāstannibodhata kāraṇam..
ahaṃkāravimūḍhānāṃ mithaḥ kalahināṃ tathā .. .. 13 ..
1.155.d:
युष्माकं देवशार्दूलास्तन्निबोधत कारणम्॥
अहंकारविमूढानां मिथः कलहिनां तथा ॥ ॥ 13 ॥
1.155.m: learn the reason for it, O tigers among gods: / for you who were deluded by egotism and quarrelling with one another,

1.155.s:
prabodhārthaṃ hi yuṣmākaṃ tamaso nāśanāya ca ..
pravartanāya sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca pradarśitam ..14..
1.155.d:
प्रबोधार्थं हि युष्माकं तमसो नाशनाय च ॥
प्रवर्तनाय सर्वेषां कर्मणां च प्रदर्शितम् ॥14॥
1.155.m: it was shown to awaken you, to destroy darkness, / and to set all activities into motion.

1.155.s:
tasmādevaṃ viditvā tu nāhaṃkāraḥ kadācana ..
kartavyo bhūtimicchadbhiḥ satataṃ devasattamāḥ .. 15 ..
1.155.d:
तस्मादेवं विदित्वा तु नाहंकारः कदाचन ॥
कर्तव्यो भूतिमिच्छद्भिः सततं देवसत्तमाः ॥ 15 ॥
1.155.m: Therefore, knowing this, egotism should never / be indulged in by those who desire prosperity, O best of gods.

1.155.s:
mānaṃ darpamahaṃkāraṃ pūrvaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ ..
ārādhayata māṃ bhaktyā satataṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ .. 16 ..
1.155.d:
मानं दर्पमहंकारं पूर्वं त्यक्त्वा सुदूरतः ॥
आराधयत मां भक्त्या सततं श्रद्धयान्विताः ॥ 16 ॥
1.155.m: Having first cast far away conceit, pride, and egotism, / worship me constantly with devotion and endowed with faith.

1.155.s:
tato drakṣyatha me rūpaṃ sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ ca yat ..
yasya saṃdarśanādeva sarve siddhimavāpsyatha .. 17..
1.155.d:
ततो द्रक्ष्यथ मे रूपं सकलं निष्कलं च यत् ॥
यस्य संदर्शनादेव सर्वे सिद्धिमवाप्स्यथ ॥ 17॥
1.155.m: Then you will see my form, which is both with parts and without parts, / by the mere sight of which all of you will attain perfection.

1.155.s:
evamuktvā mahārāja sahasrakiraṇo vibhuḥ ..
jagāmādarśanaṃ teṣāṃ paśyatāmeva bhārata .. 18 ..
1.155.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महाराज सहस्रकिरणो विभुः ॥
जगामादर्शनं तेषां पश्यतामेव भारत ॥ 18 ॥
1.155.m: Having spoken thus, O great king, the thousand-rayed lord / vanished from their sight even as they watched, O Bhārata.

1.155.s:
atha te vismitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇupinākinaḥ ..
tejasā tasya devasya bhāskarasya mahaujasaḥ ..19..
1.155.d:
अथ ते विस्मिताः सर्वे ब्रह्मविष्णुपिनाकिनः ॥
तेजसा तस्य देवस्य भास्करस्य महौजसः ॥19॥
1.155.m: Then all of them—Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Pinākin—were filled with wonder / by the splendour of that god Bhāskara of great power.

1.155.s:
parasparamathocuste vismayena tadā nṛpa ..
aho mahātmā'yaṃ devo'ditiputro divaspatiḥ .. 1.155.20 ..
1.155.d:
परस्परमथोचुस्ते विस्मयेन तदा नृप ॥
अहो महात्माऽयं देवोऽदितिपुत्रो दिवस्पतिः ॥ 1.155.20 ॥
1.155.m: Then they said to one another in astonishment, O king: / “Ah, great-souled is this god, the son of Aditi, lord of heaven,

1.155.s:
bṛhadbhānurmahātejā lokadīpo vibhāvasuḥ ..
yena sarve vayaṃ trātā nighnatā vipulaṃ tamaḥ ..21..
1.155.d:
बृहद्भानुर्महातेजा लोकदीपो विभावसुः ॥
येन सर्वे वयं त्राता निघ्नता विपुलं तमः ॥21॥
1.155.m: greatly shining, of vast splendour, the lamp of the world, Vibhāvasu, / by whom we all have been rescued, he having destroyed the vast darkness.

1.155.s:
ārādhayāmastaṃ sarve gatvā sthānāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
yena sarve vayaṃ tasya prasādātsiddhimāpnumaḥ ..22 ..
1.155.d:
आराधयामस्तं सर्वे गत्वा स्थानानि कृत्स्नशः ॥
येन सर्वे वयं तस्य प्रसादात्सिद्धिमाप्नुमः ॥22 ॥
1.155.m: Let us all worship him, going to our several abodes, / so that by his grace we all may attain perfection.”

1.155.s:
tadvyoma pūjayitvā tu parayā śraddhayā vibhoḥ ..
āmaṃtrya te mithaḥ sarve gatāḥ pūjārthamādarāt .. 23 ..
1.155.d:
तद्व्योम पूजयित्वा तु परया श्रद्धया विभोः ॥
आमंत्र्य ते मिथः सर्वे गताः पूजार्थमादरात् ॥ 23 ॥
1.155.m: Having worshipped that firmament of the lord with supreme faith, / and taking leave of one another, they all went out of reverence for the sake of worship.

1.155.s:
jagāma puṣkaraṃ brahmā śālagrāmaṃ janārdanaḥ ..
vṛṣabhadhvajo gato vīra parvataṃ gaṃdhamādanam ..24..
1.155.d:
जगाम पुष्करं ब्रह्मा शालग्रामं जनार्दनः ॥
वृषभध्वजो गतो वीर पर्वतं गंधमादनम् ॥24॥
1.155.m: Brahmā went to Puṣkara, Janārdana to Śālagrāma, / and the bull-bannered god went, O hero, to the Gandhamādana mountain.

1.155.s:
tyaktvā mānamahaṃkāraṃ kurvaṃtastapa uttamam ..
ārādhayaṃti taṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram..25..
1.155.d:
त्यक्त्वा मानमहंकारं कुर्वंतस्तप उत्तमम् ॥
आराधयंति तं देवं भास्करं वारितस्करम्॥25॥
1.155.m: Abandoning conceit and egotism, performing supreme asceticism, / they worshipped that god Bhāskara, the stealer of waters.

1.155.s:
vyomni kṛtvā catuṣkoṇaṃ brahmā nityamapūjayat ..
cakrāṃkitaṃ harirnityaṃ samyagvyomaṃ tvapūjayat .. 26 ..
1.155.d:
व्योम्नि कृत्वा चतुष्कोणं ब्रह्मा नित्यमपूजयत् ॥
चक्रांकितं हरिर्नित्यं सम्यग्व्योमं त्वपूजयत् ॥ 26 ॥
1.155.m: Brahmā worshipped constantly, making a four-cornered shape in the firmament; / Hari properly worshipped every day the firmament marked with a discus;

1.155.s:
haro'pi satataṃ vīra tejasā vahnisannibham ..
apūjayatsadā vṛttaṃ vyomaṃ bhaktyā samanvitaḥ .. 27 ..
1.155.d:
हरोऽपि सततं वीर तेजसा वह्निसन्निभम् ॥
अपूजयत्सदा वृत्तं व्योमं भक्त्या समन्वितः ॥ 27 ॥
1.155.m: Hara also, O hero, constantly worshipped with devotion / the circular firmament, resembling fire in brilliance.

1.155.s:
divyavarṣasahasrāṃte pūjayaṃto divākaram ..
gaṃdhamālyopahāraistu nṛtyagītapravāditaiḥ ..28..
1.155.d:
दिव्यवर्षसहस्रांते पूजयंतो दिवाकरम् ॥
गंधमाल्योपहारैस्तु नृत्यगीतप्रवादितैः ॥28॥
1.155.m: Worshipping the day-maker at the end of a thousand divine years / with offerings of perfumes and garlands, and with dances, songs, and instrumental music,

1.155.s:
atoṣayanmahātmānaṃ kurvāṇāstapa uttamam ..
bhaktyācalena manasā vivasvaṃtamanuttamam .. 29 ..
1.155.d:
अतोषयन्महात्मानं कुर्वाणास्तप उत्तमम् ॥
भक्त्याचलेन मनसा विवस्वंतमनुत्तमम् ॥ 29 ॥
1.155.m: performing supreme austerity with unswerving mind and devotion, / they pleased the great-souled, unexcelled Vivasvat.

1.155.s:
atha teṣāṃ mahārāja prasanno bhuvanādhipaḥ ..
darśayāmāsa lokātmā yugapadvai vibhāvasuḥ .. 1.155.30 ..
1.155.d:
अथ तेषां महाराज प्रसन्नो भुवनाधिपः ॥
दर्शयामास लोकात्मा युगपद्वै विभावसुः ॥ 1.155.30 ॥
1.155.m: Then, O great king, the lord of the worlds, Vibhāvasu, the soul of the universe, / pleased with them, manifested himself simultaneously [to each].

1.155.s:
kṛṣṇātmā ca mahātejāścaturdhā yogatonagha ..
gatvaikena suraśreṣṭhaṃ sobravītparamaṃ vacaḥ .. 31 ..
1.155.d:
कृष्णात्मा च महातेजाश्चतुर्धा योगतोनघ ॥
गत्वैकेन सुरश्रेष्ठं सोब्रवीत्परमं वचः ॥ 31 ॥
1.155.m: He of dark nature and great splendour, dividing himself into four by yoga, O sinless one, / approached the best of gods with one [form] and spoke supreme words.

1.155.s:
anyena śaṃkaraṃ manye anyena garuḍadhvajam ..
sa tatāpa tathānyena rathārūḍho divaṃ sadā .. 32 ..
1.155.d:
अन्येन शंकरं मन्ये अन्येन गरुडध्वजम् ॥
स तताप तथान्येन रथारूढो दिवं सदा ॥ 32 ॥
1.155.m: With another he [approached] Śaṅkara, I consider, and with another the Garuda-bannered god; / and with another he constantly heated heaven, mounted upon his chariot.

1.155.s:
evaṃ yogabalādbhānuḥ kṛtavānmahadadbhutam..
ugre tapasi vartaṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā cainaṃ caturmukham .. 33 ..
1.155.d:
एवं योगबलाद्भानुः कृतवान्महदद्भुतम्॥
उग्रे तपसि वर्तंतं दृष्ट्वा चैनं चतुर्मुखम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.155.m: Thus, by the power of yoga, the sun performed a great wonder. / And seeing the four-faced god engaged in fierce austerity,

1.155.s:
pūjayantaṃ mahadvyoma bhūgatairmukhapaṅkajaiḥ ..
uvāca taṃ mahārāja bhāskaraścaturānanam .. 34 ..
1.155.d:
पूजयन्तं महद्व्योम भूगतैर्मुखपङ्कजैः ॥
उवाच तं महाराज भास्करश्चतुराननम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.155.m: worshipping the great firmament with his lotus-faces turned to the earth, / the sun, O great king, spoke to the four-faced god:

1.155.s:
paśyapaśya suraśreṣṭha varadaṃ māmupāgatam ..
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ bhānorviriṃcastamathaikṣata .. 35 ..
1.155.d:
पश्यपश्य सुरश्रेष्ठ वरदं मामुपागतम् ॥
श्रुत्वैवं वचनं भानोर्विरिंचस्तमथैक्षत ॥ 35 ॥
1.155.m: “Behold, behold, O best of gods, I have come as a granter of boons!” / Having heard these words of the sun, Viriñci then looked at him.

1.155.s:
dṛṣṭvā jagāma praṇato hyavaniṃ mukhapaṃkajaiḥ ..
harṣādutphullanayanaḥ punarutthāya bhāskaram ..
uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ .. 36 ..
1.155.d:
दृष्ट्वा जगाम प्रणतो ह्यवनिं मुखपंकजैः ॥
हर्षादुत्फुल्लनयनः पुनरुत्थाय भास्करम् ॥
उवाच परमं वाक्यं कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः ॥ 36 ॥
1.155.m: Having seen him, bowing down with his lotus-faces to the ground, / his eyes wide open with joy, standing up again, with hands folded in supplication, / he spoke supreme words to the sun:

1.155.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
namaste devadeveśa namaste timirāpaha ..
namaste bhūta bhavyeśa bhūtāde bhūtabhāvana .. 37 ..
1.155.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥
नमस्ते देवदेवेश नमस्ते तिमिरापह ॥
नमस्ते भूत भव्येश भूतादे भूतभावन ॥ 37 ॥
1.155.m: Brahmā said: / “Homage to you, O lord of the gods of gods! Homage to you, O dispeller of darkness! / Homage to you, O lord of past and future, origin of beings, source of all beings!

1.155.s:
prasādaṃ kuru me deva prasanno'tha divākaraḥ ..
gatiranyā na me deva vidyate tvadṛte vibho .. 38 ..
1.155.d:
प्रसादं कुरु मे देव प्रसन्नोऽथ दिवाकरः ॥
गतिरन्या न मे देव विद्यते त्वदृते विभो ॥ 38 ॥
1.155.m: Show favour to me, O god!” Then the day-maker was pleased. / “No other recourse exists for me, O god, except you, O lord.”

1.155.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
evameva yathāttha tvaṃ nāsti tatra vicāraṇā ..
tvaṃ me prathamajaḥ putraḥ saṃbhūtaḥ kāraṇātpurā .. 39 ..
1.155.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
एवमेव यथात्थ त्वं नास्ति तत्र विचारणा ॥
त्वं मे प्रथमजः पुत्रः संभूतः कारणात्पुरा ॥ 39 ॥
1.155.m: Āditya said: / “It is just so, as you say; there is no question about that. / You are my first-born son, born formerly from a cause.

1.155.s:
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te varadosmi tavāgrataḥ ..
yamicchasi surajyeṣṭha mā tvaṃ śaṃkāṃ kuru prabho .. 1.155.40 ..
1.155.d:
वरं वरय भद्रं ते वरदोस्मि तवाग्रतः ॥
यमिच्छसि सुरज्येष्ठ मा त्वं शंकां कुरु प्रभो ॥ 1.155.40 ॥
1.155.m: Choose a boon, good fortune to you! I am here before you as a granter of boons. / Whatever you desire, O eldest of the gods, do not hesitate, O lord.”

1.155.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
yadi me bhagavāṃstuṣṭo dadāti varamuttamam ..
kartuṃ śaknomi sṛṣṭiṃ ca prasādāttava gopate ..
kṛtākṛtā hi me deva sṛṣṭirneha prasidhyati .. 41 ..
1.155.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥
यदि मे भगवांस्तुष्टो ददाति वरमुत्तमम् ॥
कर्तुं शक्नोमि सृष्टिं च प्रसादात्तव गोपते ॥
कृताकृता हि मे देव सृष्टिर्नेह प्रसिध्यति ॥ 41 ॥
1.155.m: Brahmā said: / “If the Lord is pleased and grants me an excellent boon: / by your grace, O lord of rays, may I be able to create; / for my creation, done and undone, does not succeed here, O god.”

1.155.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
na putratvamahaṃ prāptastava deva caturmukha ..
tavānvaye gamiṣyāmi putratvaṃ hi marīcaye .. 42 ..
1.155.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
न पुत्रत्वमहं प्राप्तस्तव देव चतुर्मुख ॥
तवान्वये गमिष्यामि पुत्रत्वं हि मरीचये ॥ 42 ॥
1.155.m: Āditya said: / “I did not attain sonship to you, O four-faced god; / in your lineage, indeed, I shall attain sonship to Marīci.

1.155.s:
tato yāsyati te siddhiṃ kṛtsnā sṛṣṭiścaturmukha ..
bhavitaivaṃ na sandeho matprasādā jjagatpate .. 43 ..
1.155.d:
ततो यास्यति ते सिद्धिं कृत्स्ना सृष्टिश्चतुर्मुख ॥
भवितैवं न सन्देहो मत्प्रसादा ज्जगत्पते ॥ 43 ॥
1.155.m: Then your entire creation will attain completion, O four-faced god; / it shall be so without doubt, by my grace, O lord of the world.”

1.155.s:
evamukto viriṃcistu raviṇā pṛthivīpate ..
taṃ vai vyoḍhaṃ vivastraṃtaṃ lokanāthaṃ jagatpatim .. 44 ..
1.155.d:
एवमुक्तो विरिंचिस्तु रविणा पृथिवीपते ॥
तं वै व्योढं विवस्त्रंतं लोकनाथं जगत्पतिम् ॥ 44 ॥
1.155.m: Having been spoken to thus by the sun, O lord of the earth, / Viriñci [addressed] that radiant Vivasvat, the protector of the world, the lord of the universe.

1.155.s:
punarāha surajyeṣṭhaḥ praṇamya śirasā ravim ..
kva me vāso jagannātha bhaviṣyati divaspate .. 45 ..
1.155.d:
पुनराह सुरज्येष्ठः प्रणम्य शिरसा रविम् ॥
क्व मे वासो जगन्नाथ भविष्यति दिवस्पते ॥ 45 ॥
1.155.m: Bowing to the sun with his head, the eldest of the gods spoke again: / “Where will my dwelling be, O lord of the universe, O lord of heaven?”

1.155.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
yanme rūpaṃ mahadvyoma pṛṣṭhaśṛṃgamanuttamam ..
tatra devakadaṃbaistu bhavānnityaṃ nivatsyati .. 46 ..
1.155.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
यन्मे रूपं महद्व्योम पृष्ठशृंगमनुत्तमम् ॥
तत्र देवकदंबैस्तु भवान्नित्यं निवत्स्यति ॥ 46 ॥
1.155.m: Āditya said: / “In that supreme form of mine which is the great firmament, upon the highest peak, / there you shall dwell constantly with the host of gods.

1.155.s:
indraḥ pūrvadiśo bhāge āgneyyāṃ śāṃḍilīsutaḥ ..
dakṣiṇasyāṃ yamo nityaṃ nairṛtyāmatha nirṛtiḥ .. .. 47 ..
1.155.d:
इन्द्रः पूर्वदिशो भागे आग्नेय्यां शांडिलीसुतः ॥
दक्षिणस्यां यमो नित्यं नैरृत्यामथ निरृतिः ॥ ॥ 47 ॥
1.155.m: Indra in the eastern quarter; in the south-east the son of Śāṇḍilī; / in the south constantly Yama; in the south-west Nirṛti;

1.155.s:
paścimāyāṃ tu varuṇo vāyavyāṃ tu sadāgatiḥ ..
uttare tu diśo bhāge nivaseddhanadastataḥ .. 48 ..
1.155.d:
पश्चिमायां तु वरुणो वायव्यां तु सदागतिः ॥
उत्तरे तु दिशो भागे निवसेद्धनदस्ततः ॥ 48 ॥
1.155.m: in the west Varuṇa; in the north-west Sadāgati; / and then in the northern quarter Dhanada should reside;

1.155.s:
aiśānyāṃ śaṃkaro devo madhye tvaṃ viṣṇunā saha ..
śrutvaitvaṃ vacanaṃ bhānorvedhāḥ prītyā tamabravīt .. 49 ..
1.155.d:
ऐशान्यां शंकरो देवो मध्ये त्वं विष्णुना सह ॥
श्रुत्वैत्वं वचनं भानोर्वेधाः प्रीत्या तमब्रवीत् ॥ 49 ॥
1.155.m: in the north-east the god Śaṅkara; and you in the centre together with Viṣṇu.” / Having heard these words of the sun, the creator spoke to him with affection.

1.155.s:
kṛtakṛtyaṃ tathātmānaṃ manyate ca narādhipa ..
cakāra ca tathā sarvaṃ bhāska roktamaśeṣataḥ .. 1.155.50 ..
1.155.d:
कृतकृत्यं तथात्मानं मन्यते च नराधिप ॥
चकार च तथा सर्वं भास्क रोक्तमशेषतः ॥ 1.155.50 ॥
1.155.m: And he considered himself to have achieved his purpose, O king of men, / and carried out everything completely as spoken by the sun.

1.155.s:
sa ca siddhiṃ gato vīra prasādādbhāskarasya tu ..
ādityopi varaṃ dattvā brahmaṇyo brahmaṇe'nagha .. 51 ..
1.155.d:
स च सिद्धिं गतो वीर प्रसादाद्भास्करस्य तु ॥
आदित्योपि वरं दत्त्वा ब्रह्मण्यो ब्रह्मणेऽनघ ॥ 51 ॥
1.155.m:
And he attained perfection, O hero, through the grace of the Sun.
Having granted a boon to Brahmā, Āditya, benevolent to brāhmaṇas, O sinless one,

1.155.s:
jagāma saha devena parvataṃ gandhamādanam ..
dadarśa tatra bhūteśaṃ tapastīvraṃ samāśritam .. 52 ..
1.155.d:
जगाम सह देवेन पर्वतं गन्धमादनम् ॥
ददर्श तत्र भूतेशं तपस्तीव्रं समाश्रितम् ॥ 52 ॥
1.155.m:
went with the god to Mount Gandhamādana.
There he saw the Lord of Beings engaged in intense asceticism,

1.155.s:
kapardinaṃ śūladharaṃ candrārkakṛtaśekharam ..
pūjayaṃtaṃ paraṃ vyoma suvrataṃ teja sānvitam .. 53 ..
1.155.d:
कपर्दिनं शूलधरं चन्द्रार्ककृतशेखरम् ॥
पूजयंतं परं व्योम सुव्रतं तेज सान्वितम् ॥ 53 ॥
1.155.m:
having matted locks, bearing a trident, with the moon and sun as his crest,
worshipping the supreme ether, steadfast in his vow, endowed with brilliance,

1.155.s:
gandhamālyopahāraiśca nṛtyagītapravāditaiḥ ..
mukhavādyaiśca bahubhiḥ praṇavastotragītibhiḥ ...
saṃpūjyaiva mahadvyoma jagāma śirasā mahīm .. 54 ..
1.155.d:
गन्धमाल्योपहारैश्च नृत्यगीतप्रवादितैः ॥
मुखवाद्यैश्च बहुभिः प्रणवस्तोत्रगीतिभिः ॥।
संपूज्यैव महद्व्योम जगाम शिरसा महीम् ॥ 54 ॥
1.155.m:
with offerings of incense and garlands, dances, songs, and instrumental music,
and with many sounds from the mouth, and songs of praise with the praṇava.
Having worshipped the great ether, he bowed his head to the earth.

1.155.s:
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ pūjayantaṃ ca bhāskarastripurāṃtakam ..
tuṣṭovocanmahātejā gośrutābharaṇaṃ haram .. 59 ..
1.155.d:
दृष्ट्वैवं पूजयन्तं च भास्करस्त्रिपुरांतकम् ॥
तुष्टोवोचन्महातेजा गोश्रुताभरणं हरम् ॥ 59 ॥
1.155.m:
Seeing the destroyer of Tripura worshipping in this manner,
the Sun, of great splendour, was pleased and said to Hara, whose ornament is the [serpent] whose hearing is its eyes:

1.155.s:
bhīma tuṣṭo'smi te vatsa varaṃ matto vṛṇuṣva vai ..
tavāṃtikamahaṃ prāpto varado bhūbhṛdālaya .. 56 ..
1.155.d:
भीम तुष्टोऽस्मि ते वत्स वरं मत्तो वृणुष्व वै ॥
तवांतिकमहं प्राप्तो वरदो भूभृदालय ॥ 56 ॥
1.155.m:
"O Bhīma, I am pleased with you, child! Choose a boon from me.
I have come into your presence, bestower of boons, O you whose abode is the mountain."

1.155.s:
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ bhānormahādevo mahīpate ..
dadarśa lokanāthaṃ taṃ prajvalaṃtamanuttamam ..
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā aṣṭāṃgairbhūtalaṃ gataḥ .. 57 ..
1.155.d:
श्रुत्वैवं वचनं भानोर्महादेवो महीपते ॥
ददर्श लोकनाथं तं प्रज्वलंतमनुत्तमम् ॥
उवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा अष्टांगैर्भूतलं गतः ॥ 57 ॥
1.155.m:
Hearing this speech of the Sun, O king, Mahādeva
saw that Lord of the World blazing, unequalled.
Having prostrated himself, having touched the earth with eight limbs, he said:

1.155.s:
namonamaste deveśa prabhākara divākara ..
śubhālaya śubhādhāra vikartana śubhānana .. 58 ..
1.155.d:
नमोनमस्ते देवेश प्रभाकर दिवाकर ॥
शुभालय शुभाधार विकर्तन शुभानन ॥ 58 ॥
1.155.m:
"Salutations, salutations to you, O Lord of the Gods, light-maker, day-maker,
abode of auspiciousness, foundation of auspiciousness, Vikartana of auspicious face!

1.155.s:
prasādaṃ kuru deveśa prasannastvaṃ vikartana ..
saṃsārārṇavamagnasya bhava poto jagatpate .. 59 ..
1.155.d:
प्रसादं कुरु देवेश प्रसन्नस्त्वं विकर्तन ॥
संसारार्णवमग्नस्य भव पोतो जगत्पते ॥ 59 ॥
1.155.m:
Show your grace, O Lord of the Gods; be gracious, O Vikartana!
To one sunken in the ocean of worldly existence, become a boat, O Lord of the Universe!

1.155.s:
tavāṃgasaṃbhavo deva putrohaṃ vallabhastava ..
yatkaroti mahādeva pitā putrasya tatkuru .. 1.155.60 ..
1.155.d:
तवांगसंभवो देव पुत्रोहं वल्लभस्तव ॥
यत्करोति महादेव पिता पुत्रस्य तत्कुरु ॥ 1.155.60 ॥
1.155.m:
I am born from your body, O God, your beloved son.
Whatever a father does for his son, do that, O Mahādeva!"

1.155.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
evametanna sandeho yathā vadasi śaṃkara ..
lalāṭāttvaṃ samutpannaḥ putraḥ putravatāṃ vara .. 61 ..
1.155.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
एवमेतन्न सन्देहो यथा वदसि शंकर ॥
ललाटात्त्वं समुत्पन्नः पुत्रः पुत्रवतां वर ॥ 61 ॥
1.155.m:
Āditya said:
"It is so; there is no doubt, just as you say, O Śaṅkara.
You were born from my forehead, a son, O best among those who have sons!

1.155.s:
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te mananā tvaṃ yamicchasi ..
durdeyaṃ cāpi te dāsye tripurāntaka sundara .. 62 ..
1.155.d:
वरं वरय भद्रं ते मनना त्वं यमिच्छसि ॥
दुर्देयं चापि ते दास्ये त्रिपुरान्तक सुन्दर ॥ 62 ॥
1.155.m:
Choose a boon—may you be well!—whatever you desire in your mind.
Even what is hard to give I will give to you, O handsome destroyer of Tripura!"

1.155.s:
.. mahādeva uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva anugrāhyosmi te yadi ..
prayaccha me varaṃ bhāno dehi bhaktiṃ mamācalām .. 63 ..
1.155.d:
॥ महादेव उवाच ॥ ॥
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव अनुग्राह्योस्मि ते यदि ॥
प्रयच्छ मे वरं भानो देहि भक्तिं ममाचलाम् ॥ 63 ॥
1.155.m:
Mahādeva said:
"If you are pleased with me, O God, if I am worthy of your favour,
grant me a boon, O Sun; give me unwavering devotion to you.

1.155.s:
devadānavagaṃdharvayakṣarakṣogaṇāṃstathā ..
nirjityāhaṃ yathā deva yugānte saṃhare prajām .. 64 ..
1.155.d:
देवदानवगंधर्वयक्षरक्षोगणांस्तथा ॥
निर्जित्याहं यथा देव युगान्ते संहरे प्रजाम् ॥ 64 ॥
1.155.m:
So that, having vanquished the hosts of gods, dānavas, gandharvas, yakṣas, and rākṣasas,
I may destroy the creatures at the end of the yuga, O God,

1.155.s:
tathā prayaccha me deva sthānaṃ ca paramaṃ vibho ..
yenāhaṃ hetisarvaṃ ca jaye deva jagatprabho .. 65 ..
1.155.d:
तथा प्रयच्छ मे देव स्थानं च परमं विभो ॥
येनाहं हेतिसर्वं च जये देव जगत्प्रभो ॥ 65 ॥
1.155.m:
so grant me, O God, a supreme station, O all-pervading one,
by which I may conquer every weapon, O God, Lord of the Universe!"

1.155.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasapannagān ..
hariṣyasi jagaccāpi yugānte tripurāntaka .. 66 ..
1.155.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
देवदानवगन्धर्वयक्षराक्षसपन्नगान् ॥
हरिष्यसि जगच्चापि युगान्ते त्रिपुरान्तक ॥ 66 ॥
1.155.m:
Āditya said:
"You shall take away the gods, dānavas, gandharvas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and serpents,
and the world as well, at the end of the yuga, O destroyer of Tripura!

1.155.s:
yadetatpūjitaṃ nityaṃ madrūpaṃ vyoma cotta mam ..
etattriśūlaṃ paramaṃ tava śastraṃ bhaviṣyati ..
īśāne ca tathā bhāge vyomno vāso bhaviṣyati .. 67 ..
1.155.d:
यदेतत्पूजितं नित्यं मद्रूपं व्योम चोत्त मम् ॥
एतत्त्रिशूलं परमं तव शस्त्रं भविष्यति ॥
ईशाने च तथा भागे व्योम्नो वासो भविष्यति ॥ 67 ॥
1.155.m:
This supreme ether, my form, which is constantly worshipped,
this shall become your supreme weapon, the trident.
And your abode shall be in the north-eastern part of the ether."

1.155.s:
.. mahādeva uvāca .. ..
evaṃ bhavatu me deva yaḥ prasādastvayā kṛtaḥ ..
kṛtakṛtyo'smi deveśa yanme devo varapradaḥ .. 68 .. ..
1.155.d:
॥ महादेव उवाच ॥ ॥
एवं भवतु मे देव यः प्रसादस्त्वया कृतः ॥
कृतकृत्योऽस्मि देवेश यन्मे देवो वरप्रदः ॥ 68 ॥ ॥
1.155.m:
Mahādeva said:
"Let it be so for me, O God, this grace that has been shown by you!
I have achieved my purpose, O Lord of the Gods, since the God has granted me a boon."

1.155.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharmanirupaṇaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 155 .. ..
traisuropākhyānavarṇanam
1.155.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे सौरधर्मनिरुपणं नाम पञ्चपञ्चाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ॥ 155 ॥ ॥
त्रैसुरोपाख्यानवर्णनम्
1.155.m:
Thus, in the sacred Bhaviṣyamahāpurāṇa, in the Brāhmaparvan, in the Saptamīkalpa, the one hundred and fifty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Determination of the Saura Duties.'
Account of the Narrative of the Three Gods

1.156.s:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
itthaṃ dattvā varaṃ bhānurīśvarāya viśāṃ pate ..
śālagrāmaṃ jagāmāśu varaṃ dātuṃ harernṛpa .. 1 ..
1.156.d:
॥ सुमन्तुरुवाच ॥ ॥
इत्थं दत्त्वा वरं भानुरीश्वराय विशां पते ॥
शालग्रामं जगामाशु वरं दातुं हरेर्नृप ॥ 1 ॥
1.156.m:
Sumantu said:
Having granted a boon in this manner to Īśvara, O lord of the people,
the Sun went swiftly to Śālagrāma to grant a boon to Hari, O king.

1.156.s:
dadarśa sa hariṃ tatra tapantaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ..
kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ śāntaṃ prajvalantaṃ svatejasā .. 2 ..
1.156.d:
ददर्श स हरिं तत्र तपन्तं परमं तपः ॥
कृष्णाजिनधरं शान्तं प्रज्वलन्तं स्वतेजसा ॥ 2 ॥
1.156.m:
There he saw Hari performing supreme asceticism,
wearing a black antelope skin, peaceful, blazing with his own splendour,

1.156.s:
pūjayantaṃ mahadvyoma cakrākāramanaupamam..
gandhamālyopahāraiśca nṛtyagītapravāditaiḥ .. 3 ..
1.156.d:
पूजयन्तं महद्व्योम चक्राकारमनौपमम्॥
गन्धमाल्योपहारैश्च नृत्यगीतप्रवादितैः ॥ 3 ॥
1.156.m:
worshipping the great, peerless ether in the form of a discus,
with offerings of incense and garlands, dances, songs, and instrumental music.

1.156.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya tadvyoma bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
jagāma śirasā bhūmiṃ hṛdi dhyāyandivākaram .. 4 ..
1.156.d:
एवं संपूज्य तद्व्योम भक्त्या श्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥
जगाम शिरसा भूमिं हृदि ध्यायन्दिवाकरम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.156.m:
Having thus worshipped that ether with devotion and faith,
he bowed his head to the earth, meditating upon the day-maker in his heart.

1.156.s:
viṣṇuṃ taṃ praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭo devo vibhāvasuḥ ..
uvāca viṣṇumāmaṃtrya paśya māmāgataṃ hare .. 5 ..
1.156.d:
विष्णुं तं प्रणतं दृष्ट्वा तुष्टो देवो विभावसुः ॥
उवाच विष्णुमामंत्र्य पश्य मामागतं हरे ॥ 5 ॥
1.156.m:
Seeing Viṣṇu thus prostrated, the god Vibhāvasu was pleased.
Addressing Viṣṇu, he said: "Behold, I have come, O Hari!"

1.156.s:
tadvākyaṃ keśavaḥ śrutvā śirasā ca mahīṃ gataḥ ..
namaste sarvadeveśa namaste gaganecara .. 6 ..
1.156.d:
तद्वाक्यं केशवः श्रुत्वा शिरसा च महीं गतः ॥
नमस्ते सर्वदेवेश नमस्ते गगनेचर ॥ 6 ॥
1.156.m:
Hearing his word, Keśava bowed his head to the earth:
"Salutations to you, O Lord of all gods! Salutations to you who move through the sky!

1.156.s:
jagatpate namaste'stu grahāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ ..
dāridryavyādhiduḥkhaghna namaste bhavanāśana .. 7 ..
1.156.d:
जगत्पते नमस्तेऽस्तु ग्रहाणां पतये नमः ॥
दारिद्र्यव्याधिदुःखघ्न नमस्ते भवनाशन ॥ 7 ॥
1.156.m:
Salutations to you, O Lord of the Universe! Salutations to the Lord of the planets!
O destroyer of poverty, disease, and sorrow, salutations to you, destroyer of worldly existence!

1.156.s:
ādityārka rave bhāno bhaga pūrṇa divākara ..
namaste sarvatattvajña sarvapāpavitarjita .. 8 ..
1.156.d:
आदित्यार्क रवे भानो भग पूर्ण दिवाकर ॥
नमस्ते सर्वतत्त्वज्ञ सर्वपापवितर्जित ॥ 8 ॥
1.156.m:
O Āditya, Arka, Ravi, Bhānu, Bhaga, complete one, day-maker,
salutations to you, who know all principles, free from all sin!

1.156.s:
prasīda me jagannātha haṃsānagha divaspate ..
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ trāhi deva vṛṣadhvaja .. 9 ..
1.156.d:
प्रसीद मे जगन्नाथ हंसानघ दिवस्पते ॥
संसारार्णवमग्नानां त्राहि देव वृषध्वज ॥ 9 ॥
1.156.m:
Be gracious to me, O Lord of the Universe, Swan, sinless one, Lord of the Sky!
Protect those sunken in the ocean of worldly existence, O God whose banner is a bull!

1.156.s:
putro'haṃ tava deveśa dvitīyo brāhmaṇo'nagha ..
piteva putrasya rave dehi kāmāñjagatpate .. 1.156.10 ..
1.156.d:
पुत्रोऽहं तव देवेश द्वितीयो ब्राह्मणोऽनघ ॥
पितेव पुत्रस्य रवे देहि कामाञ्जगत्पते ॥ 1.156.10 ॥
1.156.m:
I am your second son, O Lord of the Gods, a brāhmaṇa, O sinless one.
Like a father to his son, O Ravi, grant my desires, O Lord of the Universe!"

1.156.s:
viṣṇorvacanamākarṇya harṣaṃ prāpya divākaraḥ ..
uvāca kuruśārdūla harṣagadgadayā girā .. 11 ..
1.156.d:
विष्णोर्वचनमाकर्ण्य हर्षं प्राप्य दिवाकरः ॥
उवाच कुरुशार्दूल हर्षगद्गदया गिरा ॥ 11 ॥
1.156.m:
Hearing Viṣṇu's words, the day-maker experienced joy,
and spoke with a voice faltering with delight, O tiger of the Kurus:

1.156.s:
sādhu kṛṣṇa mahābāho tuṣṭohaṃ tava keśava ..
niśamya te parāṃ bhaktiṃ śraddhāṃ ca puruṣottama .. 12 ..
1.156.d:
साधु कृष्ण महाबाहो तुष्टोहं तव केशव ॥
निशम्य ते परां भक्तिं श्रद्धां च पुरुषोत्तम ॥ 12 ॥
1.156.m:
"Well done, O Kṛṣṇa of mighty arms! I am pleased with you, O Keśava,
having perceived your supreme devotion and faith, O Puruṣottama!

1.156.s:
varaṃ varaya tasmāttvaṃ vatsa yaṃ manasecchasi ..
varado' hamanuprāpto bhaktyākrāṃtastavānagha .. 13 ..
1.156.d:
वरं वरय तस्मात्त्वं वत्स यं मनसेच्छसि ॥
वरदो' हमनुप्राप्तो भक्त्याक्रांतस्तवानघ ॥ 13 ॥
1.156.m:
Therefore, choose a boon, child, whatever you desire in your mind.
I have arrived as a bestower of boons, won over by your devotion, O sinless one."

1.156.s:
niśamya vacanaṃ bhānorviṣṇurbhaktyā samanvitaḥ ..
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 14 ..
1.156.d:
निशम्य वचनं भानोर्विष्णुर्भक्त्या समन्वितः ॥
कृतांजलिपुटो भूत्वा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ 14 ॥
1.156.m:
Hearing the words of the Sun, Viṣṇu, filled with devotion,
joined his palms reverently and spoke these words:

1.156.s:
kṛtakṛtyo'smi deveśa nāsti dhanyataro mama ..
yasya me bhagavaṃstuṣṭo varadastvaṃ gataḥ svayam .. 15 ..
1.156.d:
कृतकृत्योऽस्मि देवेश नास्ति धन्यतरो मम ॥
यस्य मे भगवंस्तुष्टो वरदस्त्वं गतः स्वयम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.156.m:
"I have achieved my purpose, O Lord of the Gods; none is more fortunate than I,
with whom you, O Lord, are pleased, and have come yourself as a bestower of boons.

1.156.s:
yadi tuṣṭo mama vibhurbhaktyā krīto mayā yadi ..
prayaccha tvacalāṃ bhaktiṃ yathā śatruṃ parājaye ..
tathā mama varaṃ dehi sarvārāti vināśanam .. 16 ..
1.156.d:
यदि तुष्टो मम विभुर्भक्त्या क्रीतो मया यदि ॥
प्रयच्छ त्वचलां भक्तिं यथा शत्रुं पराजये ॥
तथा मम वरं देहि सर्वाराति विनाशनम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.156.m:
If the All-pervading Lord is pleased with me, if you have been bought by my devotion,
then grant me unwavering devotion, and so that I may vanquish the enemy,
give me a boon that destroys all adversaries,

1.156.s:
mama sthānaṃ ca paramaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam ..
lokānāṃ pālane yuktiṃ balaṃ vīryaṃ yaśaḥ sukham .. 17 ..
1.156.d:
मम स्थानं च परमं सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम् ॥
लोकानां पालने युक्तिं बलं वीर्यं यशः सुखम् ॥ 17 ॥
1.156.m:
and a supreme station of my own, revered by all the worlds,
the means for protecting the worlds, strength, valour, fame, and happiness."

1.156.s:
evamukto ravirbhaktyā viṣṇunā vākyamuttamam ..
uvāca kuruśārdūla gajatsannādayanniva..18..
1.156.d:
एवमुक्तो रविर्भक्त्या विष्णुना वाक्यमुत्तमम् ॥
उवाच कुरुशार्दूल गजत्सन्नादयन्निव॥18॥
1.156.m:
Addressed thus with supreme words by Viṣṇu with devotion,
Ravi spoke, O tiger of the Kurus, as if making the elephant trumpet:

1.156.s:
sādhu sādhu mahābāho brahmaṇastvaṃ jaghanyajaḥ ..
harasya agrajaścāpi sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ .. 19 ..
1.156.d:
साधु साधु महाबाहो ब्रह्मणस्त्वं जघन्यजः ॥
हरस्य अग्रजश्चापि सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः ॥ 19 ॥
1.156.m:
"Well done, well done, O mighty-armed one! You were born after Brahmā,
and you are the elder brother of Hara, revered by all the gods.

1.156.s:
bhaktaścāpi mamātyaṃtaṃ brahmaṇyaśca sadānagha ..
tasmāttavācalā bhaktirbhaviṣyati mamopari .. 1.156.20 ..
1.156.d:
भक्तश्चापि ममात्यंतं ब्रह्मण्यश्च सदानघ ॥
तस्मात्तवाचला भक्तिर्भविष्यति ममोपरि ॥ 1.156.20 ॥
1.156.m:
You are exceedingly devoted to me and ever benevolent to brāhmaṇas, O sinless one;
therefore, you shall have unwavering devotion toward me.

1.156.s:
etadeva mahadvyoma cakraṃ te prabhaviṣyati ..
sarvāyudhavaraṃ vīra sarvārātivināśanam ..
tathā sthānaṃ ca paramaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam .. 21 ..
1.156.d:
एतदेव महद्व्योम चक्रं ते प्रभविष्यति ॥
सर्वायुधवरं वीर सर्वारातिविनाशनम् ॥
तथा स्थानं च परमं सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.156.m:
This very great ether shall become your discus,
the best of all weapons, O hero, destroying all adversaries,
and likewise a supreme station, revered by all the worlds."

1.156.s:
itthaṃ bhānorvaraṃ prāpya harirdevo jagatpatiḥ ..
mahāprasādamityuktvā jagāma śirasā mahīm .. 22 ..
1.156.d:
इत्थं भानोर्वरं प्राप्य हरिर्देवो जगत्पतिः ॥
महाप्रसादमित्युक्त्वा जगाम शिरसा महीम् ॥ 22 ॥
1.156.m:
Having thus received the boon from the Sun, Lord Hari, the Lord of the Universe,
said, "Great is your grace," and bowed his head to the earth.

1.156.s:
bhāskaro'pi varaṃ dattvā keśavāyāmitaujase ..
jagāmāśu mahārāja svapuraṃ vibudhādhipaḥ ..23 ..
1.156.d:
भास्करोऽपि वरं दत्त्वा केशवायामितौजसे ॥
जगामाशु महाराज स्वपुरं विबुधाधिपः ॥23 ॥
1.156.m: The Sun also, having given the boon to Keśava of immeasurable splendour, / quickly departed to his own city, O great king, the lord of the gods.

1.156.s:
lokānāṃ pālane śaktiṃ balaṃ vīryaṃ yaśaḥ sukham ..
dattvā kṛṣṇāya deveśastathānyadapi kāṃkṣitam .. 24 ..
1.156.d:
लोकानां पालने शक्तिं बलं वीर्यं यशः सुखम् ॥
दत्त्वा कृष्णाय देवेशस्तथान्यदपि कांक्षितम् ॥ 24 ॥
1.156.m: Having granted to Kṛṣṇa power in protecting the worlds, strength, valour, fame, happiness, / and whatever else was desired, the lord of gods [departed].

1.156.s:
evaṃ brahmādayo devāḥ pūjayitvā divākaram ..
śaktimaṃto babhūvuste sargādīnāṃ pravartane .. 25 ..
1.156.d:
एवं ब्रह्मादयो देवाः पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् ॥
शक्तिमंतो बभूवुस्ते सर्गादीनां प्रवर्तने ॥ 25 ॥
1.156.m: Thus the gods, Brahmā and the others, having worshipped the Sun, / became endowed with power to initiate creation and the rest.

1.156.s:
iti te kathitaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
tridaivatyamupākhyānaṃ traisuraṃ lokapūjitam ..26..
1.156.d:
इति ते कथितं पुण्यमाख्यानं पापनाशनम् ॥
त्रिदैवत्यमुपाख्यानं त्रैसुरं लोकपूजितम् ॥26॥
1.156.m: Thus has been related to you the holy narrative that destroys sin, / the narrative of the three deities, concerning the three gods, worshipped by the world,

1.156.s:
stotratrayasamāyuktaṃ dharmakāmārthasādhanam ..
dharmyaṃ svargyaṃ tathā puṇyamārogyadhanadhānyadam .. 27 ..
1.156.d:
स्तोत्रत्रयसमायुक्तं धर्मकामार्थसाधनम् ॥
धर्म्यं स्वर्ग्यं तथा पुण्यमारोग्यधनधान्यदम् ॥ 27 ॥
1.156.m: joined with the triad of hymns, achieving dharma, pleasure, and wealth, / righteous, leading to heaven, sacred, and granting health, wealth, and grain.

1.156.s:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhetstotratrayaṃ ca yaḥ ..
so'gneyaṃ yānamārūḍho yāti bhānoḥ para padam .. 28 ..
1.156.d:
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं पठेत्स्तोत्रत्रयं च यः ॥
सोऽग्नेयं यानमारूढो याति भानोः पर पदम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.156.m: Whoever listens to this constantly, and whoever recites the triad of hymns, / mounted upon a fiery chariot, goes to the supreme abode of the Sun.

1.156.s:
aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamaśnute ..
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ prasādādbhāskarasya tu ..29..
1.156.d:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो धनमश्नुते ॥
विद्यार्थी लभते विद्यां प्रसादाद्भास्करस्य तु ॥29॥
1.156.m: A sonless man obtains a son; an impoverished man enjoys wealth; / a seeker of learning obtains learning by the grace of the Sun.

1.156.s:
tejasā ravisaṃkāśaḥ prabhayā pṛśnisannibhaḥ ..
modate suciraṃ kālaṃ jñānināmuttamo bhavet .. 1.156.30 ..
sūryāvatārakathāprastāvavarṇanam
1.156.d:
तेजसा रविसंकाशः प्रभया पृश्निसन्निभः ॥
मोदते सुचिरं कालं ज्ञानिनामुत्तमो भवेत् ॥ 1.156.30 ॥
सूर्यावतारकथाप्रस्ताववर्णनम्
1.156.m:
Resembling the sun in brilliance, equal to the speckled sky in radiance, / he rejoices for a very long time, and becomes foremost among the wise.
Description of the introduction to the story of the Sun's incarnation

1.157.s:
.. śatānīka uvāca .. ..
etanme kautukaṃ brahmanyadvaraṃ brahmaṇe raviḥ ..
dattavāṃstava putratvamanvaye kaśyapasya tu .. .. 1..
1.157.d:
॥ शतानीक उवाच ॥ ॥
एतन्मे कौतुकं ब्रह्मन्यद्वरं ब्रह्मणे रविः ॥
दत्तवांस्तव पुत्रत्वमन्वये कश्यपस्य तु ॥ ॥ 1॥
1.157.m: Śatānīka said: / This is my wonder, O holy one, that the Sun gave a boon to Brahmā: / 'I shall become your son in the lineage of Kaśyapa.'

1.157.s:
yāsyāmi dvijaśārdūla prapannatimirāpahaḥ ..
etanme mahadāścaryaṃ śaṃsa bhūmiṃ kathaṃ vrajet .. 2 ..
1.157.d:
यास्यामि द्विजशार्दूल प्रपन्नतिमिरापहः ॥
एतन्मे महदाश्चर्यं शंस भूमिं कथं व्रजेत् ॥ 2 ॥
1.157.m: 'I shall go, O tiger among the twice-born, dispelling darkness for those who seek refuge.' / Tell me of this great wonder: how could he descend to the earth?

1.157.s:
devādīnāṃ praṇetā yo yo bhuvi prasavo vibhuḥ ..
sa kathaṃ bhūtale vyoma janmabhāvaṃ gamiṣyati .. 3 ..
1.157.d:
देवादीनां प्रणेता यो यो भुवि प्रसवो विभुः ॥
स कथं भूतले व्योम जन्मभावं गमिष्यति ॥ 3 ॥
1.157.m: He who is the leader of the gods and others, he who is the all-pervading source of generation on earth, / how will he, who is the ether [itself], enter into the condition of birth on the surface of the earth?

1.157.s:
kimarthaṃ divyamātmānaṃ janmane sa niyokṣyati ..
yaścakraṃ vartayatyeko brahmādīnāṃ manoramam..4...
1.157.d:
किमर्थं दिव्यमात्मानं जन्मने स नियोक्ष्यति ॥
यश्चक्रं वर्तयत्येको ब्रह्मादीनां मनोरमम्॥4॥।
1.157.m: For what reason will he direct his divine self toward birth— / he who alone turns the delightful wheel of Brahmā and the other gods?

1.157.s:
sa janmani kathaṃ puṇyāṃ buddhiṃ cakre vidāṃvara ..
gopāyanaṃ yatkurute jagataḥ sarvalaukikam ..5 ..
1.157.d:
स जन्मनि कथं पुण्यां बुद्धिं चक्रे विदांवर ॥
गोपायनं यत्कुरुते जगतः सर्वलौकिकम् ॥5 ॥
1.157.m: How did he direct his holy mind toward birth, O best of the knowers, / he who effects universal protection of the world,

1.157.s:
gobhiḥ pālayate kṛtsnamātmano yaḥ svayaṃ raviḥ ...
mahābhūtāni bhūtātmā yaścakāra dadhāra ca .. 6 ..
1.157.d:
गोभिः पालयते कृत्स्नमात्मनो यः स्वयं रविः ॥।
महाभूतानि भूतात्मा यश्चकार दधार च ॥ 6 ॥
1.157.m: who himself as the Sun protects everything with his rays, / who, the self of beings, created and upheld the great elements?

1.157.s:
agarbhaḥ sa kathaṃ garbhamudare yācate vibhuḥ ..
yena gobhiḥ samākrāṃtā vipra lokāścaturdaśa .. 7 ...
1.157.d:
अगर्भः स कथं गर्भमुदरे याचते विभुः ॥
येन गोभिः समाक्रांता विप्र लोकाश्चतुर्दश ॥ 7 ॥।
1.157.m: How does he, without womb, all-pervading, ask for a womb in a belly, / he by whose rays, O Brahmin, the fourteen worlds are pervaded,

1.157.s:
sthāpitā jagato mārgāstrivargapravarāstrayaḥ ..
yo'ntakāle jagatpītvā kṛtvā vajramayaṃ vapuḥ .. 8 ..
1.157.d:
स्थापिता जगतो मार्गास्त्रिवर्गप्रवरास्त्रयः ॥
योऽन्तकाले जगत्पीत्वा कृत्वा वज्रमयं वपुः ॥ 8 ॥
1.157.m: by whom the three foremost paths of the threefold aim of life were established for the world, / who at the time of dissolution drinks up the world, making his body of adamantine strength,

1.157.s:
lokamekārṇavaṃ cakre dṛśyate svena karmaṇā ..
yaḥ purāṇe purāṇātmā tejasāṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ .. 9 ..
1.157.d:
लोकमेकार्णवं चक्रे दृश्यते स्वेन कर्मणा ॥
यः पुराणे पुराणात्मा तेजसां रूपमास्थितः ॥ 9 ॥
1.157.m: and turned the world into a single ocean, seen by his own deed, / who in the ancient times, the ancient self, assumed the form of lights,

1.157.s:
api sṛṣṭvā dvijaśreṣṭha yaḥ sasarja vasuṃdharām..
cakāra ca purā yaśca trailokyamidamavyayaḥ .. 1.157.10 ..
1.157.d:
अपि सृष्ट्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठ यः ससर्ज वसुंधराम्॥
चकार च पुरा यश्च त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्ययः ॥ 1.157.10 ॥
1.157.m: and who, having created [the worlds], O best of the twice-born, emitted the earth, / and who of old, imperishable, made these three worlds,

1.157.s:
dadau kṛtvā vasumatīṃ surāṇāṃ surasattamaḥ ..
yaḥ sthito hyanalaṃ pītvā saṃvatsaramayaśca yaḥ ..
pātālasthorṇavarasaṃ madhyatoyamayaṃ haviḥ .. 11 ...
1.157.d:
ददौ कृत्वा वसुमतीं सुराणां सुरसत्तमः ॥
यः स्थितो ह्यनलं पीत्वा संवत्सरमयश्च यः ॥
पातालस्थोर्णवरसं मध्यतोयमयं हविः ॥ 11 ॥।
1.157.m: and, best of the gods, having made the earth, gave it to the gods; / who stood drinking the fire, who consists of the year, / who, dwelling in the nether world, [takes] the essence of the ocean, the offering consisting of the waters in the midst;

1.157.s:
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ sahasraśaḥ ..
sahasracaraṇaṃ brahmanyamāhurvai yuge yuge .. 12 ..
1.157.d:
सहस्रशिरसं देवं सहस्राक्षं सहस्रशः ॥
सहस्रचरणं ब्रह्मन्यमाहुर्वै युगे युगे ॥ 12 ॥
1.157.m: whom they call the thousand-headed god, thousand-eyed in thousandfold ways, / thousand-footed, O holy one, age after age;

1.157.s:
mukhādyasya samutpanno vedhā lokapitāmahaḥ ..
hariśca vakṣaso yasya lalāṭādyasya śaṃkaraḥ .. 13 ..
1.157.d:
मुखाद्यस्य समुत्पन्नो वेधा लोकपितामहः ॥
हरिश्च वक्षसो यस्य ललाटाद्यस्य शंकरः ॥ 13 ॥
1.157.m: from whose mouth arose the Creator, grandfather of the world, / Hari from his chest, and from whose forehead Śaṃkara;

1.157.s:
yena te nihatā daityā maṃdehā nāma nāmataḥ ..
brahmādīnāṃ durādharṣo yaḥ sadā vighnanāśanaḥ ..14..
1.157.d:
येन ते निहता दैत्या मंदेहा नाम नामतः ॥
ब्रह्मादीनां दुराधर्षो यः सदा विघ्ननाशनः ॥14॥
1.157.m: by whom were slain those Daityas named Mandehas, / who is unconquerable by Brahmā and the others, who is ever the destroyer of obstacles;

1.157.s:
sarvadevamayaṃ kṛtvā sarvāyudhadharaṃ vapuḥ ..
ekacakrarathārūḍho garuḍāgrajasārathiḥ .. 15 ..
1.157.d:
सर्वदेवमयं कृत्वा सर्वायुधधरं वपुः ॥
एकचक्ररथारूढो गरुडाग्रजसारथिः ॥ 15 ॥
1.157.m: who made his body composed of all the gods, bearing all weapons, / mounted on a one-wheeled chariot, whose charioteer is Garuḍa's elder brother;

1.157.s:
karāṃte yo jagatsarvaṃ saha dānavarākṣasam ..
prakāśatamamaspṛṣṭaṃ vapuryasya sadā dvija .. 16 ..
1.157.d:
करांते यो जगत्सर्वं सह दानवराक्षसम् ॥
प्रकाशतममस्पृष्टं वपुर्यस्य सदा द्विज ॥ 16 ॥
1.157.m: at the end of whose rays the entire world, along with Dānavas and Rākṣasas, [is illumined], / whose body, O twice-born, is ever untouched by darkness, most luminous;

1.157.s:
pūrvā diśaṃ gato nityamudayācalamakramam ..
nāśayedyastu satataṃ tamo lokasya śāṃtaye .. 17 ..
1.157.d:
पूर्वा दिशं गतो नित्यमुदयाचलमक्रमम् ॥
नाशयेद्यस्तु सततं तमो लोकस्य शांतये ॥ 17 ॥
1.157.m: who, having gone constantly to the eastern quarter, without transgression to the mountain of sunrise, / continually destroys darkness for the peace of the world;

1.157.s:
nāśayitvā tamo yastu kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pravartayet ..
yoktrāṇi dakṣiṇādīkṣya musalolūkhalāni ca .. 18 ..
1.157.d:
नाशयित्वा तमो यस्तु क्रियाः सर्वाः प्रवर्तयेत् ॥
योक्त्राणि दक्षिणादीक्ष्य मुसलोलूखलानि च ॥ 18 ॥
1.157.m: who, having dispelled the darkness, sets all sacrificial rites in motion: / having observed the yokes, the sacrificial fees, the pestles and mortars,

1.157.s:
gārhapatyena vidhinā tadvaddhāryeṇa karmaṇā ..
agnimāhavanīṃ caiva vediṃ caiva kuśaṃ srucam ..
prokṣaṇīyavrataṃ caiva avabhṛthaṃ tathaiva ca .. 19 ..
1.157.d:
गार्हपत्येन विधिना तद्वद्धार्येण कर्मणा ॥
अग्निमाहवनीं चैव वेदिं चैव कुशं स्रुचम् ॥
प्रोक्षणीयव्रतं चैव अवभृथं तथैव च ॥ 19 ॥
1.157.m: according to the rule of the Gārhapatya fire, likewise by the rite to be maintained, / the fire and the Āhavanīya, the altar, the kuśa grass, and the ladle, / the vow of sprinkling, and likewise the final ablution;

1.157.s:
sarvānimāṃśca yaścakre havyabhāgapradānmukhe ..
havyādāṃśca surānyajñe kavyādāṃśca pitṝnapi .. 1.157.20 ..
1.157.d:
सर्वानिमांश्च यश्चक्रे हव्यभागप्रदान्मुखे ॥
हव्यादांश्च सुरान्यज्ञे कव्यादांश्च पितॄनपि ॥ 1.157.20 ॥
1.157.m: and who made all these as bestowers of shares of oblation in his mouth, / and the gods as eaters of oblations at the sacrifice, and the ancestors as eaters of funeral offerings;

1.157.s:
bhāgārthe madhudhānāya cakre yo yajñakarmaṇi ..
pūṣaṇaṃ ca sutaṃ somaṃ pavitrāmaraṇīmapi .. 21 ..
1.157.d:
भागार्थे मधुधानाय चक्रे यो यज्ञकर्मणि ॥
पूषणं च सुतं सोमं पवित्रामरणीमपि ॥ 21 ॥
1.157.m: who, in the sacrificial rite, made Pūṣan, Soma the son, / and the sacred fire-drill, for the sake of the share, for the honey-storing [rite];

1.157.s:
yajñāni ca dravyāṇi yajñāṃścāpi saṛtvijaḥ ..
sadasyānyajamānāṃśca medhāvinastathottamān.. 22 ..
1.157.d:
यज्ञानि च द्रव्याणि यज्ञांश्चापि सऋत्विजः ॥
सदस्यान्यजमानांश्च मेधाविनस्तथोत्तमान्॥ 22 ॥
1.157.m: and the sacrifices, the sacrificial substances, the sacrifices along with the priests, / the assembly members, and the sacrificers—the intelligent and the foremost—

1.157.s:
vibabhāja purā sarvaṃ pārameṣṭhayena karmaṇā ..
yugānurūpo yaḥ kṛtvā lokānanuvaraṃ kramāt .. 23 ..
1.157.d:
विबभाज पुरा सर्वं पारमेष्ठयेन कर्मणा ॥
युगानुरूपो यः कृत्वा लोकाननुवरं क्रमात् ॥ 23 ॥
1.157.m: all these he divided of old by his supreme sovereign act, / who, having adapted to the ages, [fashioned] the worlds according to an excellent sequence;

1.157.s:
kṣaṇānkalāśca kāṣṭhāśca kālavaikalyameva ca ..
muhūrtāstithayo māsāḥ pakṣāḥ saṃvatsarāstathā ..24..
1.157.d:
क्षणान्कलाश्च काष्ठाश्च कालवैकल्यमेव च ॥
मुहूर्तास्तिथयो मासाः पक्षाः संवत्सरास्तथा ॥24॥
1.157.m: who made the instants, kalās, kāṣṭhās, and the division of time, / muhūrtas, lunar days, months, fortnights, and years,

1.157.s:
ṛtavaḥ kālayogāśca pramāṇaṃ vividhaṃ nṛṣu ..
āyuḥ kṣetrāṇyapacayopacayāṃścaiva yo'karot .. 25 ..
1.157.d:
ऋतवः कालयोगाश्च प्रमाणं विविधं नृषु ॥
आयुः क्षेत्राण्यपचयोपचयांश्चैव योऽकरोत् ॥ 25 ॥
1.157.m: the seasons, conjunctions of time, various measures among men, / the lifespan, fields, and decrease and increase;

1.157.s:
sṛṣṭā lokāstrayonaṃtā yena jñānena vartmanā ..
sarva ,bhūtagaṇāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ sarvabhūtātmanā sadā .. 26 ..
1.157.d:
सृष्टा लोकास्त्रयोनंता येन ज्ञानेन वर्त्मना ॥
सर्व ,भूतगणाः सृष्टाः सर्वभूतात्मना सदा ॥ 26 ॥
1.157.m: by whom, through the path of knowledge, the three endless worlds were created, / all hosts of beings ever created by him who is the self of all beings;

1.157.s:
praṇāmatrayapūrveṇa yogena ramate ca yaḥ ..
yo gatāgatipotena trātāsti jagadīśvaraḥ .. 27..
1.157.d:
प्रणामत्रयपूर्वेण योगेन रमते च यः ॥
यो गतागतिपोतेन त्रातास्ति जगदीश्वरः ॥ 27॥
1.157.m: who delights in the yoga preceded by the three obeisances, / who, as a vessel for coming and going, is the protector, the lord of the world;

1.157.s:
yo gatirvṛṣayuktānāṃ gatiryo'pāpakarmaṇām ..
cāturvarṇyaprabhāvaśca vapurhotrasya rakṣitā .. 28 ..
1.157.d:
यो गतिर्वृषयुक्तानां गतिर्योऽपापकर्मणाम् ॥
चातुर्वर्ण्यप्रभावश्च वपुर्होत्रस्य रक्षिता ॥ 28 ॥
1.157.m: who is the goal of those endowed with righteousness, the goal of those who do no evil, / the splendour of the four varnas, the protector of the body of the sacrifice;

1.157.s:
dhātuvaidyasya yo vettā caturāśramasaṃśrayaḥ ..
digaṃbarānubhūtaśca vāyurvāyuvibhāvanaḥ .. 29 ..
1.157.d:
धातुवैद्यस्य यो वेत्ता चतुराश्रमसंश्रयः ॥
दिगंबरानुभूतश्च वायुर्वायुविभावनः ॥ 29 ॥
1.157.m: who is the knower of mineral medicine, the refuge of the four stages of life, / experienced by the space-clad [ascetics], the wind, the animator of the wind;

1.157.s:
agnīṣomātmakaṃ jyotiryogīśaḥ kṣaṇadāṃtakaḥ ..
yaḥ paraṃ śrūyate jyotiryaḥ paraṃ śrūyate tapaḥ .. 1.157.30 ..
1.157.d:
अग्नीषोमात्मकं ज्योतिर्योगीशः क्षणदांतकः ॥
यः परं श्रूयते ज्योतिर्यः परं श्रूयते तपः ॥ 1.157.30 ॥
1.157.m: the light consisting of fire and moon, the lord of yogins, the ender of night, / who is heard of as the supreme light, who is heard of as the supreme austerity;

1.157.s:
yaṃ paraṃ paramaṃ prāhuḥ paramātmānamacyutam ..
brahmādibhiḥ stuto devo yaśca daityāṃtakṛdvibhuḥ ..31..
1.157.d:
यं परं परमं प्राहुः परमात्मानमच्युतम् ॥
ब्रह्मादिभिः स्तुतो देवो यश्च दैत्यांतकृद्विभुः ॥31॥
1.157.m: whom they call the highest, supreme, imperishable, supreme self, / the god praised by Brahmā and the others, the all-pervading destroyer of the Daityas;

1.157.s:
yugāṃteṣvataṃko yastu yaśca lokāṃtakottamaḥ ..
seturyo lokasetūnāṃ madhye yo madhyakarmaṇām ..32..
1.157.d:
युगांतेष्वतंको यस्तु यश्च लोकांतकोत्तमः ॥
सेतुर्यो लोकसेतूनां मध्ये यो मध्यकर्मणाम् ॥32॥
1.157.m: who is the end of terror at the ends of the ages, the supreme ender of worlds, / the embankment of the world's embankments, the middle of those who perform intermediate acts;

1.157.s:
vettā yo vedaviduṣāṃ prabhuryaḥ prabhaviṣṇunām ..
saumyabhūtastu saumyānāmagnibhūtognivarcasām .. 33 ..
1.157.d:
वेत्ता यो वेदविदुषां प्रभुर्यः प्रभविष्णुनाम् ॥
सौम्यभूतस्तु सौम्यानामग्निभूतोग्निवर्चसाम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.157.m: the knower among the knowers of the Veda, the sovereign among the mighty, / benign among the benign, fire-like among those of fiery splendour;

1.157.s:
mānuṣāṇāṃ manobhūtastapobhūtastapasvinām ..
vinayo nayavṛttīnāṃ tejastejasvināmapi .. 34 ..
1.157.d:
मानुषाणां मनोभूतस्तपोभूतस्तपस्विनाम् ॥
विनयो नयवृत्तीनां तेजस्तेजस्विनामपि ॥ 34 ॥
1.157.m: consisting of the mind among mortals, consisting of austerity among ascetics, / discipline among those of prudent conduct, and splendour among the splendid.

1.157.s:
vigraho vigrahāṇāṃ ca gatirgatimatāmapi ..
ākāśaprasavo vāyurvāyuḥ prāṇo hutāśanaḥ ..
devāhutipradānodyatprāṇāgnistamanāśanaḥ .. 35 ..
1.157.d:
विग्रहो विग्रहाणां च गतिर्गतिमतामपि ॥
आकाशप्रसवो वायुर्वायुः प्राणो हुताशनः ॥
देवाहुतिप्रदानोद्यत्प्राणाग्निस्तमनाशनः ॥ 35 ॥
1.157.m: and the body of embodied forms, the motion of those who move, / space-born wind; wind is the breath, the fire, / the fire of breath that rises to offer oblations to the gods, destroying darkness.

1.157.s:
rasāddhi śoṇitaṃ bhavati śoṇitānmāṃsamucyate ..
māṃsānmajjāvasorjanma majjanosthīni janmataḥ .. 36 ..
1.157.d:
रसाद्धि शोणितं भवति शोणितान्मांसमुच्यते ॥
मांसान्मज्जावसोर्जन्म मज्जनोस्थीनि जन्मतः ॥ 36 ॥
1.157.m: For from chyle blood is produced, from blood flesh is said [to arise], / from flesh is the birth of marrow and fat, and from marrow bones are born.

1.157.s:
asthimajjñaḥ samabhavattato vai śukramādiśet ..
śukrādgarbhaḥ samabhavadrasamūlena karmaṇā ..
tatrāpaḥ prathamo bhāgaḥ sa saumyo rāśirucyate .. 37 ..
1.157.d:
अस्थिमज्ज्ञः समभवत्ततो वै शुक्रमादिशेत् ॥
शुक्राद्गर्भः समभवद्रसमूलेन कर्मणा ॥
तत्रापः प्रथमो भागः स सौम्यो राशिरुच्यते ॥ 37 ॥
1.157.m: From bone and marrow [semen] arose; one should point to semen as coming from that. / From semen the embryo arose through action rooted in chyle. / There water is the first portion; that is called the lunar mass.

1.157.s:
tataḥ kṣmāsaṃbhavo jñeyo dvitīyo rāśirucyate ..
śukraṃ somātmakaṃ vidyādātmarūpaṃ yadātmakam .. 38 ..
1.157.d:
ततः क्ष्मासंभवो ज्ञेयो द्वितीयो राशिरुच्यते ॥
शुक्रं सोमात्मकं विद्यादात्मरूपं यदात्मकम् ॥ 38 ॥
1.157.m: Then the earth-born is to be known, called the second mass. / One should know semen to be of the nature of Soma, and the form of the self to be of that nature;

1.157.s:
bhavo rasātmakasteṣāṃ vīryaṃ ca śaśipāvakam ..
kaphavarge bhavecchukraṃ pittavarge ca śoṇitam .. 39 ..
1.157.d:
भवो रसात्मकस्तेषां वीर्यं च शशिपावकम् ॥
कफवर्गे भवेच्छुक्रं पित्तवर्गे च शोणितम् ॥ 39 ॥
1.157.m: their existence consists of chyle, and their potency is moon and fire. / Semen belongs to the class of phlegm, and blood to the class of bile.

1.157.s:
kaphasya pṛthivī sthānaṃ pittaṃ nābhau pratiṣṭhitam ..
devasya madhyahṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ tu manasaḥ smṛtam ..
nābhikoṣṭhāṃtarasthaṃ tu tatra devo divākaraḥ ..1.157.40..
1.157.d:
कफस्य पृथिवी स्थानं पित्तं नाभौ प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
देवस्य मध्यहृदयं स्थानं तु मनसः स्मृतम् ॥
नाभिकोष्ठांतरस्थं तु तत्र देवो दिवाकरः ॥1.157.40॥
1.157.m: The earth is the seat of phlegm; bile is established in the navel. / The centre of the heart is recorded as the seat of the deity and of the mind; / situated between the navel and the cavity of the abdomen, there is the god who makes the day.

1.157.s:
manaḥ prajāpatirjñeyaḥ kaphaḥ somo vibhāvyate ..
pittamagniḥ smṛto yasmādagnīṣomātmakaṃ jagat .. 41 ..
1.157.d:
मनः प्रजापतिर्ज्ञेयः कफः सोमो विभाव्यते ॥
पित्तमग्निः स्मृतो यस्मादग्नीषोमात्मकं जगत् ॥ 41 ॥
1.157.m: Mind is to be known as Prajāpati; phlegm is conceived as Soma; / bile is recorded as fire, since the universe is composed of fire and Soma.

1.157.s:
evaṃ pravartite garbhe vardhiteṃ'budasannibhe ..
vāyuḥ praveśaṃ saṃcakre saṃgataḥ paramātmanā .. 42 ..
1.157.d:
एवं प्रवर्तिते गर्भे वर्धितेंऽबुदसन्निभे ॥
वायुः प्रवेशं संचक्रे संगतः परमात्मना ॥ 42 ॥
1.157.m: When the embryo has thus been initiated and has grown like a cloud, / the wind, united with the Supreme Self, entered [it].

1.157.s:
tatoṃ'gāni visṛjate bibharti parivartayan ..
prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca .. 43 ..
1.157.d:
ततोंऽगानि विसृजते बिभर्ति परिवर्तयन् ॥
प्राणोऽपानः समानश्च उदानो व्यान एव च ॥ 43 ॥
1.157.m: Then it brings forth the limbs, sustaining [them] as it turns about: / prāṇa, apāna, samāna, udāna, and vyāna.

1.157.s:
prāṇosya prathamaṃ sthānaṃ vardhayanparivartate ..
apānaṃ paścime kāya udānordhvaṃ śarīragaḥ ..
vyāno'tha vyāpako dehe samānaḥ sannivartate .. 44 ..
1.157.d:
प्राणोस्य प्रथमं स्थानं वर्धयन्परिवर्तते ॥
अपानं पश्चिमे काय उदानोर्ध्वं शरीरगः ॥
व्यानोऽथ व्यापको देहे समानः सन्निवर्तते ॥ 44 ॥
1.157.m: Prāṇa revolves making its first seat grow; / apāna resides in the lower part of the body, udāna moves upward in the body, / vyāna pervades the body, and samāna abides centrally.

1.157.s:
bhūtāvāptistatastasya jāyatīṃdriyagocarā ..
pṛthivī vāyurākāśa āpo jyotiśca paṃcamaḥ .. 45 ..
1.157.d:
भूतावाप्तिस्ततस्तस्य जायतींद्रियगोचरा ॥
पृथिवी वायुराकाश आपो ज्योतिश्च पंचमः ॥ 45 ॥
1.157.m: Then its attainment of the elements takes place within the range of the senses: / earth, wind, space, water, and light as the fifth.

1.157.s:
tasyeṃdriyāṇi piṣṭāni svaṃsvaṃ yogaṃ pracakramuḥ ..
pārthivaṃ dehamāhustu prāṇātmānaṃ ca mārutam .. 46 ..
1.157.d:
तस्येंद्रियाणि पिष्टानि स्वंस्वं योगं प्रचक्रमुः ॥
पार्थिवं देहमाहुस्तु प्राणात्मानं च मारुतम् ॥ 46 ॥
1.157.m: Its senses, finely fashioned, proceeded to their respective functions. / They declare the body to be made of earth, and wind to be the essence of the breaths.

1.157.s:
nidrā hyākāśayoniśca jalāśraye pravartate ..
jyotiścakṣuṣi tajjanma tadaṃśastāmasaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 47 ..
1.157.d:
निद्रा ह्याकाशयोनिश्च जलाश्रये प्रवर्तते ॥
ज्योतिश्चक्षुषि तज्जन्म तदंशस्तामसः स्मृतः ॥ 47 ॥
1.157.m: Sleep originates in space and operates based on water; / light is born in the eye, and its tamasic portion is recorded [there].

1.157.s:
grāmāśca viṣayāścaiva yasya vīryaṃ pravartitam..
evaṃ yaḥ sṛjate lokānsadevāsuramānavān .. 48 ..
1.157.d:
ग्रामाश्च विषयाश्चैव यस्य वीर्यं प्रवर्तितम्॥
एवं यः सृजते लोकान्सदेवासुरमानवान् ॥ 48 ॥
1.157.m: He whose potency initiated villages and realms, / who thus creates the worlds together with gods, asuras, and humans—

1.157.s:
sa kathaṃ devadeveśo garbhameṣyati cāṃśumān ..
yathodaramadityāstu yaḥ svayaṃ cāviśatpurā ..49..
1.157.d:
स कथं देवदेवेशो गर्भमेष्यति चांशुमान् ॥
यथोदरमदित्यास्तु यः स्वयं चाविशत्पुरा ॥49॥
1.157.m: how could that lord of the gods of gods, the ray-bearing [Sun], enter a womb, / just as anciently he entered the belly of Aditi of his own accord?

1.157.s:
evaṃ me saṃśayo brahmanneṣa me vismayo mahān ..
kathaṃ raviryayau garbhabhāvaṃ dvijavareti me .. 1.157.50 ..
1.157.d:
एवं मे संशयो ब्रह्मन्नेष मे विस्मयो महान् ॥
कथं रविर्ययौ गर्भभावं द्विजवरेति मे ॥ 1.157.50 ॥
1.157.m: Thus is my doubt, O brāhmaṇa, and this is my great wonder: / how did the Sun attain the state of an embryo, O best of the twice-born?

1.157.s:
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ pṛcche tvāmahaṃ bhāskarasya vai ..
bhānorutpattimāścaryaṃ hṛdi me parivartate .. 51 ..
1.157.d:
आश्चर्यं परमं पृच्छे त्वामहं भास्करस्य वै ॥
भानोरुत्पत्तिमाश्चर्यं हृदि मे परिवर्तते ॥ 51 ॥
1.157.m: I ask you about the supreme wonder concerning the Sun; / the wondrous birth of the Sun revolves in my heart.

1.157.s:
etadāścaryamākhyānaṃ kathayasva mahāmune ..
samākhyāhi balaṃ vīrya bhānoramitatejasaḥ .. 52 ..
sauradharmeṣu sūryotpattivarṇanam
1.157.d:
एतदाश्चर्यमाख्यानं कथयस्व महामुने ॥
समाख्याहि बलं वीर्य भानोरमिततेजसः ॥ 52 ॥
सौरधर्मेषु सूर्योत्पत्तिवर्णनम्
1.157.m:
Recount this wondrous narrative, O great sage; / describe the strength and power of the Sun of immeasurable splendour.
Description of the birth of the Sun in the Saura religion.

1.158.s:
sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
praśnabhāro mahāṃstāta tvayokto raśmimālini ..
yathāśakti tu vakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ bhānavaṃ yaśaḥ .. 1 ..
1.158.d:
सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
प्रश्नभारो महांस्तात त्वयोक्तो रश्मिमालिनि ॥
यथाशक्ति तु वक्ष्यामि श्रूयतां भानवं यशः ॥ 1 ॥
1.158.m: Sumaṃtu said: / A great burden of questions has been spoken by you, dear one, regarding the garlanded with rays; / yet according to my capacity I shall speak. Let the glory of the Sun be heard.

1.158.s:
bhānoḥ prabhāvaśravaṇe yasya te matirutthitā ..
haṃta bhānoḥ pravṛttiṃ ca śṛṇu divyāṃ mayeritām .. 2 ..
1.158.d:
भानोः प्रभावश्रवणे यस्य ते मतिरुत्थिता ॥
हंत भानोः प्रवृत्तिं च शृणु दिव्यां मयेरिताम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.158.m: Since your mind has been stirred to hear the power of the Sun, / ah, listen to the divine manifestation of the Sun uttered by me!

1.158.s:
sahasrāsyaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ sahasrakiraṇaṃ ca yam ..
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ sahasrakarama vyayam .. 3 ..
1.158.d:
सहस्रास्यं सहस्राक्षं सहस्रकिरणं च यम् ॥
सहस्रशिरसं देवं सहस्रकरम व्ययम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.158.m: The god who has a thousand faces, a thousand eyes, a thousand rays, / a thousand heads, a thousand hands, imperishable,

1.158.s:
sahasrajihvaṃ bhāsvaṃtaṃ sahasramukuṭaṃ prabhum ..
sahasradaṃ sahasrāriṃ sahasrabhujamavyayam .. 4 ..
1.158.d:
सहस्रजिह्वं भास्वंतं सहस्रमुकुटं प्रभुम् ॥
सहस्रदं सहस्रारिं सहस्रभुजमव्ययम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.158.m: a thousand tongues, radiant, a thousand crowns, the lord, / granting a thousandfold, having a thousand enemies, having a thousand arms, imperishable,

1.158.s:
savanaṃ bhavanaṃ caiva havyaṃ hotārameva ca ..
pātrāṇi samatītāni vedadīkṣī caruṃ śubham .. 5 ..
1.158.d:
सवनं भवनं चैव हव्यं होतारमेव च ॥
पात्राणि समतीतानि वेददीक्षी चरुं शुभम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.158.m: the soma pressing, the sacrificial chamber, the sacrificial offering, the hotṛ priest, / the vessels of the past, the one consecrated in the Vedas, the auspicious caru,

1.158.s:
śrotriyaṃ śūrpamusalaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam ..
adhvaryuṃ sāmagaṃ vipraṃ sadasyaṃ sadanaṃ tathā .. 6 ..
1.158.d:
श्रोत्रियं शूर्पमुसलं प्रोक्षणं दक्षिणायनम् ॥
अध्वर्युं सामगं विप्रं सदस्यं सदनं तथा ॥ 6 ॥
1.158.m: the learned brāhmaṇa, the winnowing basket and pestle, the sprinkling, the southern course of the sun, / the adhvaryu, the sāman-chanter, the brāhmaṇa, the attendee, and the seat,

1.158.s:
yūpaṃ samitsruvaṃ darvīṃ musalolūkhalāni ca ..
prāgvaṃśaṃ jayabhūtiṃ ca hotāraṃ cayanaṃ ca yat .. 7 ..
1.158.d:
यूपं समित्स्रुवं दर्वीं मुसलोलूखलानि च ॥
प्राग्वंशं जयभूतिं च होतारं चयनं च यत् ॥ 7 ॥
1.158.m: the sacrificial post, the kindling stick, the ladle, the spoon, the pestles and mortars, / the hall facing east, victorious prosperity, the hotṛ priest, and the piling [of the altar],

1.158.s:
rahasyāni pramāṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ..
pratiṣṭhitāni dārḍhyaṃ ca sthaṃḍilāni kuśāṃstathā .. 8 ..
1.158.d:
रहस्यानि प्रमाणानि स्थावराणि चराणि च ॥
प्रतिष्ठितानि दार्ढ्यं च स्थंडिलानि कुशांस्तथा ॥ 8 ॥
1.158.m: the secret teachings, the authorities, the motionless and the moving, / the established foundations, firmness, the sacrificial grounds, and the kuśa grass,

1.158.s:
maṃtrayajñavahaṃ vahnibhāgaṃ bhārgavameva ca ..
agrebhujī somabhujāṃ yaśca triṣu udāhṛtaḥ .. 9 ..
1.158.d:
मंत्रयज्ञवहं वह्निभागं भार्गवमेव च ॥
अग्रेभुजी सोमभुजां यश्च त्रिषु उदाहृतः ॥ 9 ॥
1.158.m: the bearer of mantras and sacrifices, the portion of fire, and Bhārgava, / the first eater among those who partake of soma, who is proclaimed in the three [worlds]—

1.158.s:
āyurvedavido viprā yajaṃte śāśvataṃ vibhum ..
tasya bhānoḥ sureśasya vīra caṃdanamālinaḥ .. 1.158.10 ..
1.158.d:
आयुर्वेदविदो विप्रा यजंते शाश्वतं विभुम् ॥
तस्य भानोः सुरेशस्य वीर चंदनमालिनः ॥ 1.158.10 ॥
1.158.m: the brāhmaṇas who know the Veda of longevity worship that eternal, omnipresent lord. / Of that Sun, the lord of gods, O hero, adorned with a garland of sandalwood,

1.158.s:
prāhurbhāvasahasrāṇi samatītānyanekaśaḥ ..
bhūyaścaiva bhaviṣyaṃti vinaśyaṃti dinedine .. 11 ..
1.158.d:
प्राहुर्भावसहस्राणि समतीतान्यनेकशः ॥
भूयश्चैव भविष्यंति विनश्यंति दिनेदिने ॥ 11 ॥
1.158.m: thousands of manifestations have passed away many times, / and more shall come to be, perishing day by day.

1.158.s:
yatpṛcchasi mahārāja puṇyāṃ divyāṃ kathāṃ śubhām ..
yadarthaṃ bhagavānbhānuḥ kaśyapasya suto'bhavat .. 12 ..
1.158.d:
यत्पृच्छसि महाराज पुण्यां दिव्यां कथां शुभाम् ॥
यदर्थं भगवान्भानुः कश्यपस्य सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 12 ॥
1.158.m: Since you ask, O great king, about that sacred, divine, auspicious story, / why the blessed Sun became the son of Kaśyapa,

1.158.s:
tāmahaṃ tvaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvamaśeṣataḥ ..
hitārthaṃ sarvamartyānāṃ lokānāṃ prabhavāya ca .. 13 ..
1.158.d:
तामहं त्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु सर्वमशेषतः ॥
हितार्थं सर्वमर्त्यानां लोकानां प्रभवाय च ॥ 13 ॥
1.158.m: I shall relate it to you; listen to all of it in full, / for the welfare of all mortals and for the emergence of the worlds.

1.158.s:
bahuśaḥ sarvabhūtātmā svayaṃ samabhijāyate ..
tathā samabhavaddevaḥ kaśyapasyāditeḥ sutaḥ .. 14 ..
1.158.d:
बहुशः सर्वभूतात्मा स्वयं समभिजायते ॥
तथा समभवद्देवः कश्यपस्यादितेः सुतः ॥ 14 ॥
1.158.m: Many times the Self of all beings is born of Himself; / thus did the god become the son of Kaśyapa and Aditi.

1.158.s:
tuṣṭo dattvā varaṃ vīra virañcasya mahātmanaḥ ..
yaṃ yaṃ janayate putramaditiḥ kaśyapādvibhoḥ .. 15 ..
1.158.d:
तुष्टो दत्त्वा वरं वीर विरञ्चस्य महात्मनः ॥
यं यं जनयते पुत्रमदितिः कश्यपाद्विभोः ॥ 15 ॥
1.158.m: Being pleased after granting a boon, O hero, to the great-souled Virañca: / whatever son Aditi bore from the lord Kaśyapa,

1.158.s:
sa sa yāti vināśaṃ vai tatkṣaṇādeva bhārata ..
dṛṣṭvā sutānnaśyamānānputraśokānvitā 'ditiḥ .. 16 ..
1.158.d:
स स याति विनाशं वै तत्क्षणादेव भारत ॥
दृष्ट्वा सुतान्नश्यमानान्पुत्रशोकान्विता ऽदितिः ॥ 16 ॥
1.158.m: each one went to destruction at that very moment, O descendant of Bharata. / Seeing her sons perishing, Aditi, filled with grief for her sons,

1.158.s:
jagāma kaśyapābhyāśe śokavyākulitekṣaṇā ..
sāpaśyattaṃ ca mārīcaṃ muniṃ dīptaṃ taponidhim .. 17 ..
1.158.d:
जगाम कश्यपाभ्याशे शोकव्याकुलितेक्षणा ॥
सापश्यत्तं च मारीचं मुनिं दीप्तं तपोनिधिम् ॥ 17 ॥
1.158.m: went near Kaśyapa, her eyes agitated with sorrow. / She saw that son of Marīci, the sage blazing, a treasury of ascetic power,

1.158.s:
ādyaṃ devaguruṃ vipraṃ divyaṃ triṣavaṇāṃbubhiḥ ..
tejasā vahnisaṃkāśaṃ sauraṃ vṛkasamaprabham .. 18 ..
1.158.d:
आद्यं देवगुरुं विप्रं दिव्यं त्रिषवणांबुभिः ॥
तेजसा वह्निसंकाशं सौरं वृकसमप्रभम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.158.m: the primal guru of the gods, the brāhmaṇa, divine with the waters of the three daily ablutions, / equal to fire in brilliance, solar, with lustre resembling the sun,

1.158.s:
nyastadaṇḍaśriyā yuktaṃ baddhakṛṣṇājināṃbaram ..
valkalājinasaṃvītaṃ pradīptaṃ brahmavarcasam .. 19 ..
1.158.d:
न्यस्तदण्डश्रिया युक्तं बद्धकृष्णाजिनांबरम् ॥
वल्कलाजिनसंवीतं प्रदीप्तं ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ॥ 19 ॥
1.158.m: endowed with the splendour of one who has laid down the staff, clad in an antelope skin tied as a garment, / wrapped in bark garments and deer hide, radiant with the splendour of sacred knowledge,

1.158.s:
hutāśamiva dīvyantaṃ tapantamiva bhāskaram ..
athāditiśca dṛṣṭvaivaṃ bhartāramamitaujasam .. 1.158.20 ..
1.158.d:
हुताशमिव दीव्यन्तं तपन्तमिव भास्करम् ॥
अथादितिश्च दृष्ट्वैवं भर्तारममितौजसम् ॥ 1.158.20 ॥
1.158.m: shining like the sacrificial fire, blazing like the Sun. / Then Aditi, seeing her husband of boundless splendour thus,

1.158.s:
śokagadgadayā vācā idaṃ vacanamabravīt ..
kimarthaṃ bhagavāndevo nirudyogastu tiṣṭhati .. 21 ..
1.158.d:
शोकगद्गदया वाचा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
किमर्थं भगवान्देवो निरुद्योगस्तु तिष्ठति ॥ 21 ॥
1.158.m: spoke this word in a voice choked with grief: / 'Why does the blessed lord remain inactive?

1.158.s:
jātojāto hi me putraḥ sadya eva vinaśyati ..
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasyāḥ kaśyapo munisattamaḥ .. 22 ..
1.158.d:
जातोजातो हि मे पुत्रः सद्य एव विनश्यति ॥
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्याः कश्यपो मुनिसत्तमः ॥ 22 ॥
1.158.m: For each son born to me perishes immediately.' / Hearing her words, Kaśyapa, the best of sages,

1.158.s:
cakāra gamane buddhiṃ brahmalokaṃ prati prabho ..
sa gatvā brahmabhavanaṃ nānābhāvasamanvitam .. 23 ..
1.158.d:
चकार गमने बुद्धिं ब्रह्मलोकं प्रति प्रभो ॥
स गत्वा ब्रह्मभवनं नानाभावसमन्वितम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.158.m:
resolved to go to the world of Brahmā, O lord.
Having gone to the abode of Brahmā, filled with varied aspects,

1.158.s:
tadvākya muktaṃ taṃ sarvaṃ yaduktaṃ tasya jāyayā ..
kaśyapasya vacaḥ śrutvā kañjajo vākyamabravīt .. 24 ..
1.158.d:
तद्वाक्य मुक्तं तं सर्वं यदुक्तं तस्य जायया ॥
कश्यपस्य वचः श्रुत्वा कञ्जजो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥ 24 ॥
1.158.m:
all those words that had been spoken by his wife were spoken by him.
Having heard Kaśyapa's speech, the lotus-born [Brahmā] spoke these words:

1.158.s:
putra gacchāma sadanaṃ bhānoḥ paramadurlabham..
ityuktvā yānamāruhya āgneyaṃ padmalocanaḥ .. 25 ..
1.158.d:
पुत्र गच्छाम सदनं भानोः परमदुर्लभम्॥
इत्युक्त्वा यानमारुह्य आग्नेयं पद्मलोचनः ॥ 25 ॥
1.158.m:
"Son, let us go to the most inaccessible abode of the Sun."
Having said this, the lotus-eyed one mounted a fiery vehicle,

1.158.s:
vedhā jagāma bhavanamādityasya mahātmanaḥ ..
aditiḥ kaśyapo brahmā jagmurvipulamāśritāḥ .. 26 ..
1.158.d:
वेधा जगाम भवनमादित्यस्य महात्मनः ॥
अदितिः कश्यपो ब्रह्मा जग्मुर्विपुलमाश्रिताः ॥ 26 ॥
1.158.m:
and the creator went to the abode of the great-souled Āditya.
Aditi, Kaśyapa, and Brahmā set out, relying upon that vast [abode].

1.158.s:
te muhūrtena saṃprāptāḥ sūryalokaṃ suvarcasam ..
divyakāmagamairyānairyathārhaṃ kurunandana .. 27 ..
1.158.d:
ते मुहूर्तेन संप्राप्ताः सूर्यलोकं सुवर्चसम् ॥
दिव्यकामगमैर्यानैर्यथार्हं कुरुनन्दन ॥ 27 ॥
1.158.m:
Within a moment they reached the splendid world of Sūrya
by means of celestial vehicles that moved at will as was appropriate, O scion of the Kurus,

1.158.s:
ādityaṃ praṣṭumicchaṃti tejasāṃ rāśimuttamam ..
gacchantaste ca vistīrṇāmādityasya parāṃ sabhām .. 28 ..
1.158.d:
आदित्यं प्रष्टुमिच्छंति तेजसां राशिमुत्तमम् ॥
गच्छन्तस्ते च विस्तीर्णामादित्यस्य परां सभाम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.158.m:
desiring to inquire of Āditya, that supreme mass of splendor.
And as they went to the vast, supreme assembly of Āditya,

1.158.s:
ṣaṭpadodgītaninadāṃ sābhagaistu samīritām ..
kratavo bahvṛcamukhāḥ proktāḥ puṇyavadakṣarāḥ .. 29 ..
1.158.d:
षट्पदोद्गीतनिनदां साभगैस्तु समीरिताम् ॥
क्रतवो बह्वृचमुखाः प्रोक्ताः पुण्यवदक्षराः ॥ 29 ॥
1.158.m:
which resonated with the hum of bees and was animated by the fortunate ones,
where sacrifices, spoken with verses from the Ṛgveda as their head, had sacred syllables,

1.158.s:
tuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣavyāghraṃ vitateṣu ca karmasu ..
yajñasandhau vedavidāṃ padakramavidāṃ tathā .. 1.158.30 ..
1.158.d:
तुष्टुवुः पुरुषव्याघ्रं विततेषु च कर्मसु ॥
यज्ञसन्धौ वेदविदां पदक्रमविदां तथा ॥ 1.158.30 ॥
1.158.m:
they praised the tiger among men while rites were being performed,
at the junction of sacrifices, of those who know the Vedas and those who know the Pada and Krama texts;

1.158.s:
ghoṣeṇa paramarṣīṇāṃ sarvaṃ tatra nināditam ..
yajñasaṃstavavidbhiśca śikṣāvidbhistathā dvijaiḥ .. 31 ..
1.158.d:
घोषेण परमर्षीणां सर्वं तत्र निनादितम् ॥
यज्ञसंस्तवविद्भिश्च शिक्षाविद्भिस्तथा द्विजैः ॥ 31 ॥
1.158.m:
everything there was made to resound with the roar of supreme sages,
and by twice-born ones who know the praises of sacrifice and know phonetics,

1.158.s:
aṣṭādaśapurāṇajñaiḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaiḥ ..
mīmāṃsāhetuvādajñaiḥ sarvavādaviśāradaiḥ .. 32 ..
1.158.d:
अष्टादशपुराणज्ञैः सर्वविद्याविशारदैः ॥
मीमांसाहेतुवादज्ञैः सर्ववादविशारदैः ॥ 32 ॥
1.158.m:
who know the eighteen Purāṇas, proficient in all branches of learning,
who know Mīmāṃsā and dialectics, and are proficient in all doctrines,

1.158.s:
lokāyatikamukhyaiśca tuṣṭuvuḥ sūryamīritam ..
tatratatra ca viprendrān niyatāñchaṃsitavratān..33..
1.158.d:
लोकायतिकमुख्यैश्च तुष्टुवुः सूर्यमीरितम् ॥
तत्रतत्र च विप्रेन्द्रान् नियताञ्छंसितव्रतान्॥33॥
1.158.m:
and by the foremost of Lokāyata thinkers, they praised the Sun as he was described.
And here and there Kaśyapa and the others saw chiefs of the twice-born,

1.158.s:
japahomaparānyogyāndadṛśuḥ kaśyapādayaḥ ..
tasyāṃ sabhāyāmāste sa raśmimālī divākaraḥ .. 34 ..
1.158.d:
जपहोमपरान्योग्यान्ददृशुः कश्यपादयः ॥
तस्यां सभायामास्ते स रश्मिमाली दिवाकरः ॥ 34 ॥
1.158.m:
restrained, renowned for their vows, devoted to recitation and oblations, well-qualified.
In that assembly sat the sun, garlanded with rays,

1.158.s:
surāsuraguruḥ śrīmāñchuśubhe vīra māyayā ..
upāsate ca tatraiva prajānāṃ patimīśvaram .. 35 ..
1.158.d:
सुरासुरगुरुः श्रीमाञ्छुशुभे वीर मायया ॥
उपासते च तत्रैव प्रजानां पतिमीश्वरम् ॥ 35 ॥
1.158.m:
the glorious teacher of gods and asuras, shining with wonder, O hero.
And there they worshipped that lord, the master of creatures:

1.158.s:
dakṣaḥ pracetāḥ pulaho marīciśca dvijottamaḥ ..
bhṛguratrirvaśiṣṭhaśca gautamo nāradastathā .. 36 ..
1.158.d:
दक्षः प्रचेताः पुलहो मरीचिश्च द्विजोत्तमः ॥
भृगुरत्रिर्वशिष्ठश्च गौतमो नारदस्तथा ॥ 36 ॥
1.158.m:
Dakṣa, Pracetas, Pulaha, and Marīci, the best of the twice-born,
Bhṛgu, Atri, Vasiṣṭha, Gautama, and Nārada,

1.158.s:
divyā ātmāṃtarikṣaṃ ca vāyustejobalaṃ mahī ..
śabdaḥ sparśaḥ svarūpaṃ ca rasagandhau tathaiva ca .. 37 ..
1.158.d:
दिव्या आत्मांतरिक्षं च वायुस्तेजोबलं मही ॥
शब्दः स्पर्शः स्वरूपं च रसगन्धौ तथैव च ॥ 37 ॥
1.158.m:
the celestial beings, the self, the atmosphere, wind, fire, strength, earth,
sound, touch, visible form, taste, and smell likewise,

1.158.s:
prakṛtiśca vikārāśca yaccānyatkāraṇaṃ mahat ..
sāṃgopāgāśca catvāro vedā lokapate tathā .. 38 ..
1.158.d:
प्रकृतिश्च विकाराश्च यच्चान्यत्कारणं महत् ॥
सांगोपागाश्च चत्वारो वेदा लोकपते तथा ॥ 38 ॥
1.158.m:
Prakṛti, its evolutes, and whatever other great primal cause exists,
and the four Vedas along with their auxiliary and secondary limbs, O lord of the world,

1.158.s:
lavāśca ṛtavaścaiva saṃkalpapraṇavāstathā ..
ete cānye ca bahavo bhānumaṃtamupāsate .. 39 ..
1.158.d:
लवाश्च ऋतवश्चैव संकल्पप्रणवास्तथा ॥
एते चान्ये च बहवो भानुमंतमुपासते ॥ 39 ॥
1.158.m:
fractions of time, the seasons, intentions, and the praṇava—
these and many others attend upon the radiant Sun:

1.158.s:
artho dharmaśca kāmaśca mokṣaśca saviśeṣataḥ ..
dveṣo harṣaśca mohaśca matsaro māna eva ca .. 1.158.40 ..
1.158.d:
अर्थो धर्मश्च कामश्च मोक्षश्च सविशेषतः ॥
द्वेषो हर्षश्च मोहश्च मत्सरो मान एव च ॥ 1.158.40 ॥
1.158.m:
wealth, righteousness, desire, and liberation above all,
hatred, joy, delusion, envy, and pride,

1.158.s:
vṛko viṣṇusutaḥ putraḥ puṣpajo dhiṣaṇastathā ..
māheśvarastathā sauro viṭapo vikacastathā .. 41 ..
1.158.d:
वृको विष्णुसुतः पुत्रः पुष्पजो धिषणस्तथा ॥
माहेश्वरस्तथा सौरो विटपो विकचस्तथा ॥ 41 ॥
1.158.m:
Vṛka, Viṣṇu's son, the son, Puṣpaja, and Dhiṣaṇa,
Māheśvara, Saura, Viṭapa, and Vikaca,

1.158.s:
māruto viśvakarmā ca aśvi nāvanyavāhanau ..
evamuktaḥ suvacanairbhānunā prabhaviṣṇunā .. 42 ..
1.158.d:
मारुतो विश्वकर्मा च अश्वि नावन्यवाहनौ ॥
एवमुक्तः सुवचनैर्भानुना प्रभविष्णुना ॥ 42 ॥
1.158.m:
Māruta, Viśvakarman, and the two Aśvins whose mounts are different.
Having been addressed thus with fine words by the mighty Sun,

1.158.s:
jagāma kaśyapo vīra sahādityā svamāśramam ..
aditirdevamātā ca taṃ garbhaṃ nidadhe svayam .. 43 ..
1.158.d:
जगाम कश्यपो वीर सहादित्या स्वमाश्रमम् ॥
अदितिर्देवमाता च तं गर्भं निदधे स्वयम् ॥ 43 ॥
1.158.m:
Kaśyapa, O hero, together with Aditi, returned to his own hermitage.
And Aditi, mother of the gods, herself bore that embryo,

1.158.s:
bhūtātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam ..
pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu pravṛtto garbha uttamaḥ .. 44 ..
1.158.d:
भूतात्मानं महात्मानं दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् ॥
पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु प्रवृत्तो गर्भ उत्तमः ॥ 44 ॥
1.158.m:
the self of beings, the great-souled one, for a thousand celestial years.
When the thousand years were completed, that supreme embryo was activated,

1.158.s:
surāṇāṃ śaraṇaṃ devaścāsurāṇāṃ vināśanaḥ ..
garbhasthena tu tenaiva paritrātaḥ sutastathā .. 45 ..
1.158.d:
सुराणां शरणं देवश्चासुराणां विनाशनः ॥
गर्भस्थेन तु तेनैव परित्रातः सुतस्तथा ॥ 45 ॥
1.158.m:
a god who is the refuge of the suras and the destroyer of the asuras;
and while yet in the womb, the son was protected by him alone,

1.158.s:
ādadānastu tejāṃsi trailokyasya narādhipa ..
tasmiñjāte tu deveśe trailokyasya sukhāvahe .. 46 ..
1.158.d:
आददानस्तु तेजांसि त्रैलोक्यस्य नराधिप ॥
तस्मिञ्जाते तु देवेशे त्रैलोक्यस्य सुखावहे ॥ 46 ॥
1.158.m:
taking away the splendors of the three worlds, O king.
And when that lord of gods was born, who brings happiness to the three worlds,

1.158.s:
prahatya daityasaṃghāṃśca surāṇāṃ nādavardhane ..
abhavatparamānandaḥ sarveṣāṃ tatra tasthuṣām .. 47 .. ..
sūryāvatāravarṇanam
1.158.d:
प्रहत्य दैत्यसंघांश्च सुराणां नादवर्धने ॥
अभवत्परमानन्दः सर्वेषां तत्र तस्थुषाम् ॥ 47 ॥ ॥
सूर्यावतारवर्णनम्
1.158.m:
striking down the hosts of Daityas and swelling the cheers of the suras,
there was supreme joy for all who stood there.
Description of the Incarnation of the Sun

1.159.s:
sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
dakṣaḥ prajāpatiścaiva namaskāraṃ cakāra ha ..
vidyotamāno vapuṣā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ .. 1 ..
1.159.d:
सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
दक्षः प्रजापतिश्चैव नमस्कारं चकार ह ॥
विद्योतमानो वपुषा सर्वाभरणभूषितः ॥ 1 ॥
1.159.m: Sumantu said: / Dakṣa Prajāpati made obeisance, / shining in form, adorned with all ornaments;

1.159.s:
upātiṣṭhata deveśaṃ bhānuṃ carṣigaṇaiḥ saha ..
tato gaṃdharvamukhyeṣu praṇadatsu vihā yasi ..
bahubhiḥ saha gaṃdharvaiḥ pragāyatsu mahīpate .. 2 ..
1.159.d:
उपातिष्ठत देवेशं भानुं चर्षिगणैः सह ॥
ततो गंधर्वमुख्येषु प्रणदत्सु विहा यसि ॥
बहुभिः सह गंधर्वैः प्रगायत्सु महीपते ॥ 2 ॥
1.159.m: along with hosts of sages he approached the Sun, the lord of gods. / Then, as foremost Gandharvas were sounding forth in the sky / and singing aloud with many Gandharvas, O king,

1.159.s:
evaṃ te devagaṃdharvā upāgāyaṃta bhaktitaḥ ..
utpannaṃ dvādaśātmānaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram .. 3 ..
1.159.d:
एवं ते देवगंधर्वा उपागायंत भक्तितः ॥
उत्पन्नं द्वादशात्मानं भास्करं वारितस्करम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.159.m: the celestial Gandharvas thus sang praise with devotion / to the twelve-formed Sun who had arisen, the stealer of waters:

1.159.s:
indro vivasvānpūṣā ca tvaṣṭā ca savitā tathā ..
bhargoṃ'śumānaryamārkaḥ pṛśnirmārtaṃḍa eva ca ..
ityekādaśa evaite dvādaśo viṣṇurucyate .. 4 ..
1.159.d:
इन्द्रो विवस्वान्पूषा च त्वष्टा च सविता तथा ॥
भर्गोंऽशुमानर्यमार्कः पृश्निर्मार्तंड एव च ॥
इत्येकादश एवैते द्वादशो विष्णुरुच्यते ॥ 4 ॥
1.159.m: Indra, Vivasvat, Pūṣan, Tvaṣṭṛ, Savitṛ, / Bharga, Aṃśumat, Aryaman, Arka, Pṛśni, and Mārtaṇḍa— / these are the eleven, and Viṣṇu is said to be the twelfth.

1.159.s:
evaṃ dvādaśadhā jātamaṃśumaṃtaṃ mahādbhutam ..
stuvanti devatāḥ sarve gatāśca tarasā mahīm .. 5 ..
1.159.d:
एवं द्वादशधा जातमंशुमंतं महाद्भुतम् ॥
स्तुवन्ति देवताः सर्वे गताश्च तरसा महीम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.159.m: To him, the wonderfully majestic ray-possessing one, born thus twelvefold, / all the deities sang praises and swiftly went to the earth:

1.159.s:
mṛgavyādhaśca śarvaśca mṛgāṃkāṃko mahāyaśāḥ ..
ajaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ patiḥ kācaḥ paraṃtapaḥ .. 6 ..
1.159.d:
मृगव्याधश्च शर्वश्च मृगांकांको महायशाः ॥
अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यः पतिः काचः परंतपः ॥ 6 ॥
1.159.m: Mṛgavyādha, Śarva, the renowned one marked by the moon, / Ajaikapād, Ahirbudhnya, Pati, Kāca, scorcher of foes,

1.159.s:
damanaśceśvaraścaiva kapālī ca viśāṃpate ..
sthāṇurbhagaśca bhagavānrudrāścaite'vatasthire .. 7 ..
1.159.d:
दमनश्चेश्वरश्चैव कपाली च विशांपते ॥
स्थाणुर्भगश्च भगवान्रुद्राश्चैतेऽवतस्थिरे ॥ 7 ॥
1.159.m: Damana, Īśvara, and Kapālin, O ruler of the people, / Sthāṇu, and the blessed Bhaga—these Rudras took their positions;

1.159.s:
aśvinau vasavaścāṣṭau garuḍaśca mahābalaḥ ..
viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca tasthuḥ prāṃjalayo nṛpa .. 8 ..
1.159.d:
अश्विनौ वसवश्चाष्टौ गरुडश्च महाबलः ॥
विश्वेदेवाश्च साध्याश्च तस्थुः प्रांजलयो नृप ॥ 8 ॥
1.159.m: the two Aśvins, the eight Vasus, and the mighty Garuḍa, / the Viśvedevas and the Sādhyas stood with folded palms, O king;

1.159.s:
nāgarājo mahārāja vāsukiḥ prāṃjaliḥ sthitaḥ ..
anye ca bahavo nāgā rākṣasāśca mahābalāḥ .. 9 ..
1.159.d:
नागराजो महाराज वासुकिः प्रांजलिः स्थितः ॥
अन्ये च बहवो नागा राक्षसाश्च महाबलाः ॥ 9 ॥
1.159.m: the serpent-king Vāsuki stood with folded palms, O great king, / and many other serpents and mighty rākṣasas;

1.159.s:
tārkṣyaścāriṣṭanemiśca garuḍaśca mahābalaḥ ..
aruṇaścāruṇiścaiva tatra prāṃjalayaḥ sthitāḥ ..1.159.10..
1.159.d:
तार्क्ष्यश्चारिष्टनेमिश्च गरुडश्च महाबलः ॥
अरुणश्चारुणिश्चैव तत्र प्रांजलयः स्थिताः ॥1.159.10॥
1.159.m: Tārkṣya, Ariṣṭanemi, the mighty Garuḍa, / Aruṇa, and Āruṇi stood there with folded palms.

1.159.s:
pitāmahaśca bhagavānsvayamāgamya lokakṛt ..
prāha devaguruḥ śrīmāntsuraiḥ sarvairmaharṣibhiḥ ..11..
1.159.d:
पितामहश्च भगवान्स्वयमागम्य लोककृत् ॥
प्राह देवगुरुः श्रीमान्त्सुरैः सर्वैर्महर्षिभिः ॥11॥
1.159.m: And the blessed Pitāmaha, the creator of the worlds, having come in person, / the glorious teacher of the gods, spoke along with all the suras and great sages:

1.159.s:
yasmātprekṣayate sarvaṃ prabhaviṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ..
tasmāllokeśvaraḥ śrīmānvivasvāṃśca bhavatviti .. 12 ..
1.159.d:
यस्मात्प्रेक्षयते सर्वं प्रभविष्णुः सनातनः ॥
तस्माल्लोकेश्वरः श्रीमान्विवस्वांश्च भवत्विति ॥ 12 ॥
1.159.m: "Because the eternal mighty one observes everything, / therefore may he, the glorious master of the world, be called Vivasvat.

1.159.s:
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ gaṃdharvoragarakṣasām ..
yasmādayamādidevastasmādāditya eva hi .. 13 ..
1.159.d:
देवदानवयक्षाणां गंधर्वोरगरक्षसाम् ॥
यस्मादयमादिदेवस्तस्मादादित्य एव हि ॥ 13 ॥
1.159.m: Because he is the first deity of gods, dānavas, and yakṣas, / of gandharvas, uragas, and rakṣases, he is indeed Āditya."

1.159.s:
evamuktvā tu bhagavānsārdhaṃ devarṣibhiḥ prabhuḥ ..
namaskṛtvā susaṃpūjya yayau tatsadanaṃ prati .. 14 ..
1.159.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तु भगवान्सार्धं देवर्षिभिः प्रभुः ॥
नमस्कृत्वा सुसंपूज्य ययौ तत्सदनं प्रति ॥ 14 ॥
1.159.m: Having spoken thus, the blessed lord together with the celestial sages, / having bowed and properly worshipped him, went to his own abode.

1.159.s:
yā gatiryajñaśīlānāṃ yā gatiḥ puṇyakarmaṇām..
yā gatiḥ siddhayogānāṃ yā gatiśca mahātmanām .. 15 ..
1.159.d:
या गतिर्यज्ञशीलानां या गतिः पुण्यकर्मणाम्॥
या गतिः सिद्धयोगानां या गतिश्च महात्मनाम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.159.m: He who is the destination of those devoted to sacrifice, the destination of those of virtuous deeds, / the destination of those accomplished in yoga, and the destination of the great-souled,

1.159.s:
yasyāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ samabhūddevasattamam...
yaṃ prāpya śāśvataṃ viprā nāvartaṃte bhavārṇave .. 16 ..
1.159.d:
यस्याष्टगुणमैश्वर्यं समभूद्देवसत्तमम्॥।
यं प्राप्य शाश्वतं विप्रा नावर्तंते भवार्णवे ॥ 16 ॥
1.159.m: whose eightfold sovereignty was supreme among the gods, / having attained whom, the eternal one, the twice-born do not return to the ocean of existence,

1.159.s:
vālakhilyādayo ye ca sarvāśramanivāsinaḥ ..
sevaṃte yaṃ yatātmāno duścaraṃ vratamāsthitāḥ..17..
1.159.d:
वालखिल्यादयो ये च सर्वाश्रमनिवासिनः ॥
सेवंते यं यतात्मानो दुश्चरं व्रतमास्थिताः॥17॥
1.159.m: whom the Vālakhilyas and others, dwellers in all hermitage stages, / self-restrained and having undertaken arduous vows, attend upon.

1.159.s:
yo'naṃta iva nāgeṣu yasya te sarvayoginaḥ ..
sahasramūrdhā raktākṣaḥ śeṣādibhiranuttamaiḥ ... .. 16 ..
1.159.d:
योऽनंत इव नागेषु यस्य ते सर्वयोगिनः ॥
सहस्रमूर्धा रक्ताक्षः शेषादिभिरनुत्तमैः ॥॥। 16 ॥
