तानि साक्षात्प्रगृह्णाति तद्भक्त्या सततं रविः ॥ 6 ॥
1.164.m: One who produces flowers himself and worships Sūrya himself— / Ravi constantly receives them directly through his devotion.

1.164.s:
yastvārāmaṃ raveḥ kuryādāmrabilvādiśobhitam..
jātīvijayarājārkakaravīraiḥ sakuṃkumaiḥ ..7..
1.164.d:
यस्त्वारामं रवेः कुर्यादाम्रबिल्वादिशोभितम्॥
जातीविजयराजार्ककरवीरैः सकुंकुमैः ॥7॥
1.164.m: One who makes a garden for Ravi adorned with mango, bilva, and other trees, / with jātī, vijayā, rājārka, oleander, saffron,

1.164.s:
punnāganāgabakulairaśokatilacaṃpakaiḥ ..
agastikadalīkhaṃḍaistasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 8 ..
1.164.d:
पुन्नागनागबकुलैरशोकतिलचंपकैः ॥
अगस्तिकदलीखंडैस्तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ॥ 8 ॥
1.164.m: punnāga, nāga, bakula, aśoka, tila, and campaka, / with agasti and groves of plantain trees—hear the fruit of his merit:

1.164.s:
yāvaddhi patraṃ kusumaṃ bījaṃ sūtaphalāni ca ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate .. 9 ..
1.164.d:
यावद्धि पत्रं कुसुमं बीजं सूतफलानि च ॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि सूरलोके महीयते ॥ 9 ॥
1.164.m: As long as there are leaves, blossoms, seeds, and produced fruits, / for that many thousands of years he is exalted in the realm of Sūra.

1.164.s:
saghṛtaṃ guggulaṃ dadyādrājanvā kaṃduruṃ tathā ..
caturvedigṛhe janma prāpnoti satataṃ sukhī .. 1.164.10 ..
1.164.d:
सघृतं गुग्गुलं दद्याद्राजन्वा कंदुरुं तथा ॥
चतुर्वेदिगृहे जन्म प्राप्नोति सततं सुखी ॥ 1.164.10 ॥
1.164.m: One who offers guggulu with clarified butter, O king, or kunduru, / obtains birth in the home of a knower of the four Vedas, continuously happy.

1.164.s:
kṛṣṇāguruṃ ca karpūradhūpaṃ dadyāddivākare ..
nairaṃtaryeṇa yastasya rājanpuṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 11 ..
1.164.d:
कृष्णागुरुं च कर्पूरधूपं दद्याद्दिवाकरे ॥
नैरंतर्येण यस्तस्य राजन्पुण्यफलं शृणु ॥ 11 ॥
1.164.m: One who offers black agallochum and camphor incense to the Maker of Day / uninterruptedly—O king, hear the meritorious fruit of that man:

1.164.s:
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca ..
bhuktvā sūryapure bhogāṃstasyāṃte kṣmādhipo bhavet .. 12 ..
1.164.d:
कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि कल्पकोटिशतानि च ॥
भुक्त्वा सूर्यपुरे भोगांस्तस्यांते क्ष्माधिपो भवेत् ॥ 12 ॥
1.164.m: Having enjoyed pleasures in Sūrya's city for thousands of crores of kalpas / and hundreds of crores of kalpas, at the end of that he becomes an earthly ruler.

1.164.s:
gugguluṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ yakṣo gṛhṇāti śabdakṛt ..
yakṣāhvayasya dānena tasya loke mahīyate .. 13 ..
1.164.d:
गुग्गुलुं घृतसंयुक्तं यक्षो गृह्णाति शब्दकृत् ॥
यक्षाह्वयस्य दानेन तस्य लोके महीयते ॥ 13 ॥
1.164.m: The yakṣa named Śabdakṛt receives guggulu mixed with clarified butter; / by giving what bears the yakṣa's name, he is exalted in that deity's realm.

1.164.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśau kṛṣṇa saptamyāṃ yaḥ sājyaṃ gugguluṃ dahet ..
sa cāsau sauramāsādya varṣāṇāṃ ca daśārbudam .. 14 ..
1.164.d:
कृष्णांशौ कृष्ण सप्तम्यां यः साज्यं गुग्गुलुं दहेत् ॥
स चासौ सौरमासाद्य वर्षाणां च दशार्बुदम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.164.m: One who burns guggulu with clarified butter on the dark seventh to the dark-rayed [sun], / he reaches the solar realm for a billion years.

1.164.s:
devadāruṃ nameruṃ ca śrīvāsaṃ kuṃduruṃ tathā ..
śrīphalaṃ cājyasaṃyuktaṃ dagdhvāśrayamavāpnuyāt .. 15 ..
1.164.d:
देवदारुं नमेरुं च श्रीवासं कुंदुरुं तथा ॥
श्रीफलं चाज्यसंयुक्तं दग्ध्वाश्रयमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 15 ॥
1.164.m: Having burned deodar, nameru, śrīvāsa, kunduru, / and śrīphala mixed with clarified butter, one attains refuge.

1.164.s:
evaṃ saugadhikaṃ rūpaṃ ṣaṭsahasraguṇottaram..
aguruṃ daśasāhasraṃ saghṛtaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet ..16..
1.164.d:
एवं सौगधिकं रूपं षट्सहस्रगुणोत्तरम्॥
अगुरुं दशसाहस्रं सघृतं द्विगुणं भवेत् ॥16॥
1.164.m: Such a fragrant form is six thousand times superior; / agallochum is ten thousand times, and with clarified butter it becomes double.

1.164.s:
anaṃtaphaladaṃ devaṃ sadā kuṃdurukāmukam..
dvisahasrapalānāṃ tu mahiṣākṣasya gugguloḥ ..17..
1.164.d:
अनंतफलदं देवं सदा कुंदुरुकामुकम्॥
द्विसहस्रपलानां तु महिषाक्षस्य गुग्गुलोः ॥17॥
1.164.m: To the god who grants endless fruits and ever delights in kunduru, / if of two thousand palas of mahiṣākṣa guggulu,

1.164.s:
dagdhvārdhamavimiśrasya sūryatulyaḥ prajāyate ..
śodhayetpāpasaṃyuktaṃ puruṣaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 18 ..
1.164.d:
दग्ध्वार्धमविमिश्रस्य सूर्यतुल्यः प्रजायते ॥
शोधयेत्पापसंयुक्तं पुरुषं नात्र संशयः ॥ 18 ॥
1.164.m: one burns half, unadulterated, he becomes equal to Sūrya; / it purifies a person laden with sin—there is no doubt of this.

1.164.s:
kṛṣṇāgurubhavaṃ dhūpaṃ tuṣāgniriva kāṃcanam ..
yoṃtaḥpuragṛhaṃ gandhaiḥ sugandhaiḥ pravilepayet .. 19 ..
1.164.d:
कृष्णागुरुभवं धूपं तुषाग्निरिव कांचनम् ॥
योंतःपुरगृहं गन्धैः सुगन्धैः प्रविलेपयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
1.164.m: As fire on husk burns gold, one who with fragrances / of black agallochum incense anoints the inner sanctum,

1.164.s:
kapāṭadvārakuḍyāditiryagūrdhvaṃ savedikam ..
vāsayetpuṣpamālābhirdhūpaiścāpi sugaṃdhibhiḥ .. 1.164.20 ..
1.164.d:
कपाटद्वारकुड्यादितिर्यगूर्ध्वं सवेदिकम् ॥
वासयेत्पुष्पमालाभिर्धूपैश्चापि सुगंधिभिः ॥ 1.164.20 ॥
1.164.m: and the door leaves, doorways, walls, and so on, horizontally and vertically, along with the altar platform, / and perfumes it with flower garlands and fragrant incenses—

1.164.s:
tasya puṇyaṃ yathāvattu yuvayorvacmi kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
āpūrayandiśaḥ sarvā nānāgaṃdha samanvitaiḥ .. 21 ..
1.164.d:
तस्य पुण्यं यथावत्तु युवयोर्वच्मि कृत्स्नशः ॥
आपूरयन्दिशः सर्वा नानागंध समन्वितैः ॥ 21 ॥
1.164.m: I tell the two of you in full the merit of that man as it truly is: / filling all directions with diverse fragrances,

1.164.s:
kalpakoṭiśataṃ divyaṃ tejasā vahnisannibhaḥ ..
śakravatprajvalandevaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 22 ..
1.164.d:
कल्पकोटिशतं दिव्यं तेजसा वह्निसन्निभः ॥
शक्रवत्प्रज्वलन्देवः सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 22 ॥
1.164.m: like fire in radiance, blazing like Śakra, he is exalted / as a divine being in Sūrya's realm for a hundred crores of divine kalpas.

1.164.s:
tasyāṃte dharmaśeṣeṇa trailokyā dhipatirbhavet..
śatāvṛtaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādevaṃ gandhairbhagālayam.. 23 ..
1.164.d:
तस्यांते धर्मशेषेण त्रैलोक्या धिपतिर्भवेत्॥
शतावृतं तु यः कुर्यादेवं गन्धैर्भगालयम्॥ 23 ॥
1.164.m: At the end of that, by the residue of his righteousness, he becomes the sovereign of the three worlds. / But one who treats Bhaga's shrine thus with fragrances a hundred times over,

1.164.s:
sa sarvaśarmasaṃyuktaḥ sūryatulyaparākramaḥ ..
sūryaloke vaseddevo yuvābhyāṃ saṃprapū jitaḥ .. 24 ..
1.164.d:
स सर्वशर्मसंयुक्तः सूर्यतुल्यपराक्रमः ॥
सूर्यलोके वसेद्देवो युवाभ्यां संप्रपू जितः ॥ 24 ॥
1.164.m: endowed with all happiness and equal in prowess to Sūrya, / shall dwell as a god in Sūrya's realm, thoroughly worshipped by the two of you.

1.164.s:
tadvacchuklaiśca saṃvītaṃ paṭṭasūtrairvinirmitam ..
dattvopavītaṃ sūryāya bhavedvedāṃgapāragaḥ .. 25 ..
1.164.d:
तद्वच्छुक्लैश्च संवीतं पट्टसूत्रैर्विनिर्मितम् ॥
दत्त्वोपवीतं सूर्याय भवेद्वेदांगपारगः ॥ 25 ॥
1.164.m: Similarly, by offering a sacred thread woven from white silk threads / to Sūrya, one becomes a master of the Vedāṅgas.

1.164.s:
vāsāṃsi suvicitrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate ..
truṭimātraṃ tu yo dadyādūrṇāvastraṃ sapaṃkajam.. 26 ..
1.164.d:
वासांसि सुविचित्राणि सूरलोके महीयते ॥
त्रुटिमात्रं तु यो दद्यादूर्णावस्त्रं सपंकजम्॥ 26 ॥
1.164.m: One who presents variegated garments is honored in the realm of Sūra; / but one who gives even a minute piece of woolen cloth with a lotus design

1.164.s:
bhāskarasyottamāṃgeṣu tasya puṇyaṃ bravīmyaham ..
indrasyārdhāsane tiṣṭhedyāvadrindrāścaturdaśa .. 27 ..
1.164.d:
भास्करस्योत्तमांगेषु तस्य पुण्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥
इन्द्रस्यार्धासने तिष्ठेद्यावद्रिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ॥ 27 ॥
1.164.m: for the head of Bhāskara, I shall declare his merit: / he shall sit on half of Indra's throne as long as the fourteen Indras reign.

1.164.s:
evaṃ vittānusāreṇa sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ samāsataḥ ..
sarveṣāṃ hemapātrāṇāṃ mukuṭānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ .. 28 ..
1.164.d:
एवं वित्तानुसारेण सर्वं ज्ञेयं समासतः ॥
सर्वेषां हेमपात्राणां मुकुटानां च सर्वशः ॥ 28 ॥
1.164.m: In this way, according to one's wealth, everything is to be known in brief, / regarding all golden vessels and diadems in every manner.

1.164.s:
arkapatrapuṭaṃ cūrṇaṃ madhuparṇasamanvitam..
yo nivedayate'rkāya so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..29..
1.164.d:
अर्कपत्रपुटं चूर्णं मधुपर्णसमन्वितम्॥
यो निवेदयतेऽर्काय सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥29॥
1.164.m: One who offers a cup of arkapatra powder accompanied by madhuparṇa / to Arka, obtains the fruit of an Aśvamedha sacrifice.

1.164.s:
śālitaṃḍulaprasthasya kuryādannaṃ susaṃskatam ..
sūryāya ca caruṃ dattvā saptamyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ..1.164.30..
1.164.d:
शालितंडुलप्रस्थस्य कुर्यादन्नं सुसंस्कतम् ॥
सूर्याय च चरुं दत्त्वा सप्तम्यां तु विशेषतः ॥1.164.30॥
1.164.m: One should prepare well-cooked food from a prastha of winter-rice grains, / and offering caru to Sūrya, especially on the seventh lunar day,

1.164.s:
saṃyāvaṃ kṛśaraṃ pūpaṃ pāyasaṃ yāvakaṃ tathā ..
dadhyodanarasālānnamodakānguḍapūpakān .. 31 ..
1.164.d:
संयावं कृशरं पूपं पायसं यावकं तथा ॥
दध्योदनरसालान्नमोदकान्गुडपूपकान् ॥ 31 ॥
1.164.m: along with saṃyāva, kṛśara, cakes, pāyasa, and barley meal, / curd rice, spiced rice, modakas, and jaggery cakes—

1.164.s:
yāvaṃtastaṇḍulāstasminnaivedye parisaṃkhyayā ..
tāvadvarṣa sahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate .. 32..
1.164.d:
यावंतस्तण्डुलास्तस्मिन्नैवेद्ये परिसंख्यया ॥
तावद्वर्ष सहस्राणि सूरलोके महीयते ॥ 32॥
1.164.m: as many grains of rice as are counted in that food offering, / for that many thousands of years he is exalted in the realm of Sūra.

1.164.s:
guḍakhaṃḍakṛtānāṃ ca bhakṣyāṇāṃ vinivedane ..
ghṛtena plāvitānāṃ ca phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ labhet .. 33 ..
1.164.d:
गुडखंडकृतानां च भक्ष्याणां विनिवेदने ॥
घृतेन प्लावितानां च फलं शतगुणं लभेत् ॥ 33 ॥
1.164.m: And in the offering of edible delicacies made of molasses and candied sugar, / saturated with clarified butter, one obtains a hundredfold fruit.

1.164.s:
rasāla khādyakādyānāṃ bhakṣyāṇāṃ phalamiṣyate ..
tadardhaṃ salilasyāpi vāsitasya nivedayet .. 34 ..
1.164.d:
रसाल खाद्यकाद्यानां भक्ष्याणां फलमिष्यते ॥
तदर्धं सलिलस्यापि वासितस्य निवेदयेत् ॥ 34 ॥
1.164.m: Such is the fruit desired for edible treats, spiced dishes, and other food; / one should offer fragrant water of half that quantity.

1.164.s:
yathākālopalabdhāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca ..
nivedyārkāya paramaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnoti pūjanāt .. 35 ..
1.164.d:
यथाकालोपलब्धानि भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च ॥
निवेद्यार्काय परमं स्थानं प्राप्नोति पूजनात् ॥ 35 ॥
1.164.m: Having offered various kinds of edible foods obtained according to the season / to Arka, one attains the supreme abode through that worship.

1.164.s:
prajvālya ghṛtadīpaṃ tu bhāskarasyālaye śubham ..
āgneyaṃ yānamāruhya gacchetsaumanasaṃ puram.. 36 ..
1.164.d:
प्रज्वाल्य घृतदीपं तु भास्करस्यालये शुभम् ॥
आग्नेयं यानमारुह्य गच्छेत्सौमनसं पुरम्॥ 36 ॥
1.164.m: Having lit an auspicious lamp with clarified butter in the temple of Bhāskara, / he mounts a chariot of fire and goes to the city of Saumanasa.

1.164.s:
yaḥ kuryātkārtike māsi śobhanāṃ dīpamālikām..
saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vāmāvāsyāyāmathāpi vā .. 37 ..
1.164.d:
यः कुर्यात्कार्तिके मासि शोभनां दीपमालिकाम्॥
सप्तम्यामथ षष्ठ्यां वामावास्यायामथापि वा ॥ 37 ॥
1.164.m: One who arranges a beautiful row of lamps in the month of Kārtika, / whether on the seventh, or on the sixth, or even on the new moon day,

1.164.s:
bhāskarāyutasaṃkāśastejasā bhāsayandiśaḥ ..
divyābharaṇasaṃpannaḥ kulamuddhṛtya sarvaśaḥ .. 38 ..
1.164.d:
भास्करायुतसंकाशस्तेजसा भासयन्दिशः ॥
दिव्याभरणसंपन्नः कुलमुद्धृत्य सर्वशः ॥ 38 ॥
1.164.m: resembling ten thousand suns, illuminating the directions with brilliance, / adorned with divine ornaments, having delivered his lineage entirely,

1.164.s:
yāvatpradīpasaṃkhyānaṃ ghṛtenāpūrya bodhitam..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate .. 39 ..
1.164.d:
यावत्प्रदीपसंख्यानं घृतेनापूर्य बोधितम्॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 39 ॥
1.164.m: as many as the number of lamps lit and filled with clarified butter, / for that many thousands of years he is exalted in the realm of Sūrya.

1.164.s:
dīpavṛkṣamathodbodhya parvasvāyataneṣu vai ..
pūrvasmāddviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 1.164.40 ..
1.164.d:
दीपवृक्षमथोद्बोध्य पर्वस्वायतनेषु वै ॥
पूर्वस्माद्द्विगुणं पुण्यं लभते नात्र संशयः ॥ 1.164.40 ॥
1.164.m: Moreover, having lit a lamp-tree in temples on festival days, / he obtains twice the merit mentioned before, there is no doubt of this.

1.164.s:
dīpavṛkṣaṃ samudbodhya bhāskarāyataneṣu bhoḥ ..
sarvalohamayaṃ vīra raviloke mahīyate .. 41 ..
1.164.d:
दीपवृक्षं समुद्बोध्य भास्करायतनेषु भोः ॥
सर्वलोहमयं वीर रविलोके महीयते ॥ 41 ॥
1.164.m: Having illuminated a lamp-tree made entirely of metal in the temples of Bhāskara, / O hero, he is exalted in the realm of Ravi.

1.164.s:
śirasā dhārayeddīpaṃ bhāskarasyāgrato niśi ..
lalāṭe caiva hastābhyāṃ samudyuktastatho rasi .. 42 ..
1.164.d:
शिरसा धारयेद्दीपं भास्करस्याग्रतो निशि ॥
ललाटे चैव हस्ताभ्यां समुद्युक्तस्तथो रसि ॥ 42 ॥
1.164.m: One should bear a lamp on one's head before Bhāskara at night, / and on the forehead, and intently with both hands, as well as upon the chest.

1.164.s:
bhāskarāyutasaṃkāśo vimānairarkasannibhaiḥ ..
kalpāyutaśataṃ caiva sūryaloke mahīyate .. 43 ..
1.164.d:
भास्करायुतसंकाशो विमानैरर्कसन्निभैः ॥
कल्पायुतशतं चैव सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 43 ॥
1.164.m: resplendent like ten thousand suns, in celestial chariots resembling the sun, / he is honoured in the world of the sun for a hundred tens of thousands of kalpas.

1.164.s:
annadātā tu yo vīra vīraloke mahī yate ..
bhāskarasyāgrato dattvā darpaṇaṃ nirmalaṃ śubham .. 44 ..
1.164.d:
अन्नदाता तु यो वीर वीरलोके मही यते ॥
भास्करस्याग्रतो दत्त्वा दर्पणं निर्मलं शुभम् ॥ 44 ॥
1.164.m: And he who gives food, O hero, is honoured in the world of heroes. / Having presented a clean, auspicious mirror before the sun,

1.164.s:
paryaṃke śobhitaṃ kṛtvā śvetamālyaiḥ sacandanaiḥ ..
vṛkārkanirmalaḥ śrīmāndivyābharaṇa rūpadhṛk ..
kalpāyutasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate .. 45 ..
1.164.d:
पर्यंके शोभितं कृत्वा श्वेतमाल्यैः सचन्दनैः ॥
वृकार्कनिर्मलः श्रीमान्दिव्याभरण रूपधृक् ॥
कल्पायुतसहस्राणि सूरलोके महीयते ॥ 45 ॥
1.164.m: having adorned it on a couch with white garlands and sandalwood, / pure like the morning sun, glorious, wearing divine ornaments and forms, / he is honoured in the world of the sun for thousands of tens of thousands of kalpas.

1.164.s:
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ bhaktyā śraddadhāno ravernaraḥ ..
aśvamedhasahasrasya sukhena labhate phalam.. .. 46 ..
1.164.d:
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं भक्त्या श्रद्दधानो रवेर्नरः ॥
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य सुखेन लभते फलम्॥ ॥ 46 ॥
1.164.m: A faithful person who circumambulates the sun with devotion / easily obtains the fruit of a thousand horse sacrifices.

1.164.s:
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ yastu namaskāraṃ prayojayet ..
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ sakalaṃ vindate phalam .. 47 ..
1.164.d:
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं यस्तु नमस्कारं प्रयोजयेत् ॥
राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां सकलं विन्दते फलम् ॥ 47 ॥
1.164.m: One who performs circumambulation and offers bow / obtains the complete fruit of both the Rājasūya and horse sacrifices.

1.164.s:
namaskāraḥ smṛto yajñaḥ sarvayajño ttamottamaḥ ..
namaskṛtvā sahasrāṃśumaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 48 ..
1.164.d:
नमस्कारः स्मृतो यज्ञः सर्वयज्ञो त्तमोत्तमः ॥
नमस्कृत्वा सहस्रांशुमश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥ 48 ॥
1.164.m: A bow is considered a sacrifice, the best among all sacrifices; / having bowed to the thousand-rayed one, one obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

1.164.s:
praṇamya daṃḍavadbhūmau namaskāreṇa yo'rcayet ..
sa yāṃ gatimavāpnoti na tāṃ kratu śatairapi .. 49 ..
1.164.d:
प्रणम्य दंडवद्भूमौ नमस्कारेण योऽर्चयेत् ॥
स यां गतिमवाप्नोति न तां क्रतु शतैरपि ॥ 49 ॥
1.164.m: Prostrating like a stick upon the ground, he who worships with a bow / reaches a destination that cannot be attained even with hundreds of sacrifices.

1.164.s:
sarvayajñopavāsepu sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam ..
abhijñāpyopahāreṇa pūjayā phalamaśnute .. 1.164.50 ..
1.164.d:
सर्वयज्ञोपवासेपु सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्फलम् ॥
अभिज्ञाप्योपहारेण पूजया फलमश्नुते ॥ 1.164.50 ॥
1.164.m: Whatever fruit is attained in all sacrifices, fasts, and all holy sites, / he enjoys that fruit through worship, having honoured [the sun] with an offering.

1.164.s:
śvetaṃ mahādhvajaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā cāpaṃ ca raṃgakam ..
kiṃkiṇījālanirghoṣaṃ mayūracchatrabhūṣitam ..
yastvaryamṇe naro dadyācchraddhayā parayānvitaḥ .. 51 ..
1.164.d:
श्वेतं महाध्वजं कृत्वा कृत्वा चापं च रंगकम् ॥
किंकिणीजालनिर्घोषं मयूरच्छत्रभूषितम् ॥
यस्त्वर्यम्णे नरो दद्याच्छ्रद्धया परयान्वितः ॥ 51 ॥
1.164.m: Having made a white, great banner and an arch with colours, / resounding with a network of jingling bells, adorned with a peacock-feather parasol, / whichever man offers it to Aryaman filled with supreme faith,

1.164.s:
sa śatena vimānānāṃ sarvadeva namaskṛtaḥ ..
manvantaraśataṃ deva modate divi devavat .. 52 ..
1.164.d:
स शतेन विमानानां सर्वदेव नमस्कृतः ॥
मन्वन्तरशतं देव मोदते दिवि देववत् ॥ 52 ॥
1.164.m: he, bowed to by all the gods, with a hundred celestial chariots, / rejoices in heaven like a god for a hundred manvantaras, O king.

1.164.s:
dhvajamālākulaṃ kuryādyaḥ prāṃteṣu bhagālayam..
mahādhvajāṣṭakaṃ cāpi digvidikṣu nivedayet .. 53 ..
1.164.d:
ध्वजमालाकुलं कुर्याद्यः प्रांतेषु भगालयम्॥
महाध्वजाष्टकं चापि दिग्विदिक्षु निवेदयेत् ॥ 53 ॥
1.164.m: He who fills the perimeter of Bhaga’s temple with rows of banners / and dedicates eight great banners in the cardinal and intermediate directions,

1.164.s:
sa vimānasahasreṇa dhvajamālākulena tu ..
kalpāyutaśataṃ divyaṃ modete divi sūravat .. 54 ..
1.164.d:
स विमानसहस्रेण ध्वजमालाकुलेन तु ॥
कल्पायुतशतं दिव्यं मोदेते दिवि सूरवत् ॥ 54 ॥
1.164.m: he, with a thousand celestial chariots crowded with rows of banners, / rejoices in heaven like the sun for a divine hundred tens of thousands of kalpas.

1.164.s:
śatacandrāṃśuvimalaṃ muktādāmopaśobhitam ..
maṇidaṃḍamayaṃ chatraṃ dadyādvā kāṃcanādikam .. 55 ..
1.164.d:
शतचन्द्रांशुविमलं मुक्तादामोपशोभितम् ॥
मणिदंडमयं छत्रं दद्याद्वा कांचनादिकम् ॥ 55 ॥
1.164.m: He who offers a parasol pure as the rays of a hundred moons, adorned with strings of pearls, / with a handle made of jewels, or made of gold and other materials,

1.164.s:
sa dhāryamāṇacchatreṇa hemadaṃḍopaśobhinā ..
modate sūryaloke tu vimānavaramā sthitaḥ .. 56 ..
1.164.d:
स धार्यमाणच्छत्रेण हेमदंडोपशोभिना ॥
मोदते सूर्यलोके तु विमानवरमा स्थितः ॥ 56 ॥
1.164.m: he, with a parasol being held over him, resplendent with a gold shaft, / rejoices in the world of the sun, seated upon a supreme celestial chariot.

1.164.s:
tatastasmāccyuto lokānnisargādbhuvamāgataḥ ..
bhuṅkte samudraparyaṃtāmekacchatrāṃ vasundharām .. 57 ..
1.164.d:
ततस्तस्माच्च्युतो लोकान्निसर्गाद्भुवमागतः ॥
भुङ्क्ते समुद्रपर्यंतामेकच्छत्रां वसुन्धराम् ॥ 57 ॥
1.164.m: Then, falling from that world and arriving on earth in the course of time, / he enjoys the earth bounded by the oceans under a single royal parasol.

1.164.s:
yaḥ śṛṃkhalāsamāyuktāṃ mahāghaṇṭāṃ mahāsvanām ..
kāṃsyalohamayīṃ vāpi nibadhnīyādbhagālaye .. 58 ..
1.164.d:
यः शृंखलासमायुक्तां महाघण्टां महास्वनाम् ॥
कांस्यलोहमयीं वापि निबध्नीयाद्भगालये ॥ 58 ॥
1.164.m: He who fastens in the temple of Bhaga a great bell of loud sound, / fitted with chains, made of bell-metal or iron,

1.164.s:
śobhanaḥ syānnaraḥ śrīmānbhagasyātīva vallabhaḥ ..
sūryatulyabalo bhūtvā sūryaloke mahīyate .. 59 ..
1.164.d:
शोभनः स्यान्नरः श्रीमान्भगस्यातीव वल्लभः ॥
सूर्यतुल्यबलो भूत्वा सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 59 ॥
1.164.m: that man will be splendid, glorious, and exceedingly dear to Bhaga; / having attained strength equal to the sun, he is honoured in the world of the sun.

1.164.s:
bherīmṛdaṃgapaṭahajharjharīmardalādikam ..
daśakāṃsyādivāditraṃ yo bhagāya nivedayet .. 1.164.60 ..
1.164.d:
भेरीमृदंगपटहझर्झरीमर्दलादिकम् ॥
दशकांस्यादिवादित्रं यो भगाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 1.164.60 ॥
1.164.m: He who presents to Bhaga kettledrums, mṛdaṅgas, paṭahas, jharjharīs, mardalas, / and other instruments such as ten kinds of brass cymbals,

1.164.s:
sa vimānairmahābhāgervaṃśavīṇāyutasvanaiḥ ..
yugāntakaśataṃ divyaṃ bhagaloke mahīyate .. 61 ..
1.164.d:
स विमानैर्महाभागेर्वंशवीणायुतस्वनैः ॥
युगान्तकशतं दिव्यं भगलोके महीयते ॥ 61 ॥
1.164.m: he, accompanied by splendid celestial chariots resounding with tens of thousands of flutes and vīṇās, / is honoured in the world of Bhaga for a divine hundred cosmic ages.

1.164.s:
susaṃgītakadānena savādyena viśeṣataḥ ..
yatheṣṭaṃ bhāskare loke modate kālamakṣayam .. 62 ..
1.164.d:
सुसंगीतकदानेन सवाद्येन विशेषतः ॥
यथेष्टं भास्करे लोके मोदते कालमक्षयम् ॥ 62 ॥
1.164.m: By donating exquisite music, especially with instruments, / he rejoices according to his desire in the world of the sun for inexhaustible time.

1.164.s:
mahāmahāsvanaṃ dattvā śaṃkhayugmaṃ bhagālaye ..
yugakoṭiśataṃ divyaṃ bhagaloke mahīyate .. 63 ..
1.164.d:
महामहास्वनं दत्त्वा शंखयुग्मं भगालये ॥
युगकोटिशतं दिव्यं भगलोके महीयते ॥ 63 ॥
1.164.m: Having offered a pair of conches of very great sound in the temple of Bhaga, / he is honoured in the world of Bhaga for a divine hundred crores of cosmic ages.

1.164.s:
vimānaṃ bahuvarṇābhaṃ madhye paṃkajabhūṣitam ..
vicitramekavarṇaṃ vāsanavastropakalpitam .. 64 ..
1.164.d:
विमानं बहुवर्णाभं मध्ये पंकजभूषितम् ॥
विचित्रमेकवर्णं वासनवस्त्रोपकल्पितम् ॥ 64 ॥
1.164.m: A canopy of many colours, adorned in the middle with a lotus, / variegated or of a single colour, fashioned from fine cloths,

1.164.s:
kiṃkiṇījālasaṃpannaṃ varṇakaiścopaśobhitam ..
puṣpamālāprabhaṃ vāpi ghaṃṭācāmarabhūṣitam .. 65 ..
1.164.d:
किंकिणीजालसंपन्नं वर्णकैश्चोपशोभितम् ॥
पुष्पमालाप्रभं वापि घंटाचामरभूषितम् ॥ 65 ॥
1.164.m: furnished with a network of jingling bells, embellished with colours, / or radiant like a flower garland, adorned with bells and chowries—

1.164.s:
bhagasyopari yo dadyātsarvaratnopaśobhitam ..
dukūlapaṭṭadevāṃgairvastrairvā varṇakānvitaiḥ .. 66 ..
1.164.d:
भगस्योपरि यो दद्यात्सर्वरत्नोपशोभितम् ॥
दुकूलपट्टदेवांगैर्वस्त्रैर्वा वर्णकान्वितैः ॥ 66 ॥
1.164.m: he who offers it above Bhaga, adorned with all jewels, / made of dukūla, silk, fine devāṅga fabrics, or cloths endowed with colours,

1.164.s:
paṭṭādivastrataṃtūnāṃ parisaṃkhyā tu yā bhavet ..
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate .. 67 ..
1.164.d:
पट्टादिवस्त्रतंतूनां परिसंख्या तु या भवेत् ॥
तावद्युगसहस्राणि सूरलोके महीयते ॥ 67 ॥
1.164.m: for as many threads as there are in those silk and other cloths, / for that many thousands of cosmic ages he is honoured in the world of the sun.

1.164.s:
bhagāhutyā jagatsarvaṃ sṛṣṭidvāreṇa dhāryate ..
agnivartmā vacasyukto hyagnirasyātmajaḥ sadā .. 68 ..
1.164.d:
भगाहुत्या जगत्सर्वं सृष्टिद्वारेण धार्यते ॥
अग्निवर्त्मा वचस्युक्तो ह्यग्निरस्यात्मजः सदा ॥ 68 ॥
1.164.m: By the offering to Bhaga the entire world is sustained through the path of creation; / he whose path is fire is declared in Vedic text, and fire is always his son.

1.164.s:
yastvagnikāryaṃ(ya?) vidhivatkuryānnityaṃ bhagālaye ..
bhagamuddiśya rājeṃdra sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 69 ..
1.164.d:
यस्त्वग्निकार्यं(य?) विधिवत्कुर्यान्नित्यं भगालये ॥
भगमुद्दिश्य राजेंद्र स याति परमां गतिम् ॥ 69 ॥
1.164.m: He who duly performs the daily fire-rite in the temple of Bhaga / dedicated to Bhaga, O king of kings, goes to the supreme state.

1.164.s:
sarvānnaṃ yāvakopetaṃ yastu nityavidhiṃ haret ..
puṣpadhūpajalopetaṃ kālekāle viśeṣataḥ .. 1.164.70 ..
1.164.d:
सर्वान्नं यावकोपेतं यस्तु नित्यविधिं हरेत् ॥
पुष्पधूपजलोपेतं कालेकाले विशेषतः ॥ 1.164.70 ॥
1.164.m: He who brings all kinds of food along with barley gruel as a daily rite, / accompanied by flowers, incense, and water, especially at the proper times,

1.164.s:
mahāśvetādimātṝṇāṃ trikalpānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ..
yaḥ kṛtvā sakṛdapyevaṃ sarvadikṣu baliṃ haret ..
sa naraśca sahasrāṇi śāṃḍileyapure vaset .. 71 ..
1.164.d:
महाश्वेतादिमातॄणां त्रिकल्पानां च सर्वशः ॥
यः कृत्वा सकृदप्येवं सर्वदिक्षु बलिं हरेत् ॥
स नरश्च सहस्राणि शांडिलेयपुरे वसेत् ॥ 71 ॥
1.164.m: having done so even once and presented an offering in all directions / to the mothers headed by Mahāśvetā and to the three Kalpas entirely, / that man shall dwell for thousands [of years] in the realm of Śāṇḍileya.

1.164.s:
saurasaṃdhyābaliṃ kṛtvā dināṃte satataṃ raveḥ ..
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ bhagaloke mahīyate .. 72 ..
1.164.d:
सौरसंध्याबलिं कृत्वा दिनांते सततं रवेः ॥
वर्षायुतशतं साग्रं भगलोके महीयते ॥ 72 ॥
1.164.m: Having constantly made the solar twilight offering to the sun at the end of the day, / he is honoured in the world of Bhaga for a full hundred tens of thousands of years.

1.164.s:
dadhyodanapayobhiryaḥ pūritaṃ pātramāvṛtam ..
puṣpadhūpārcitaṃ caiva vitānopari śobhitam .. 73 ..
1.164.d:
दध्योदनपयोभिर्यः पूरितं पात्रमावृतम् ॥
पुष्पधूपार्चितं चैव वितानोपरि शोभितम् ॥ 73 ॥
1.164.m: He who covers a vessel filled with curd, boiled rice, and milk, / worshipped with flowers and incense, adorned above with a canopy,

1.164.s:
śirasā dhārayetpātraṃ śanairgacchetpradakṣiṇam ..
ravyāyatanaparyaṃte śaṃkhavīṇādinisvanaiḥ .. 74 ..
1.164.d:
शिरसा धारयेत्पात्रं शनैर्गच्छेत्प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
रव्यायतनपर्यंते शंखवीणादिनिस्वनैः ॥ 74 ॥
1.164.m: should carry the vessel on his head and slowly circumambulate / the perimeter of the sun’s temple to the sounds of conches, vīṇās, and other instruments,

1.164.s:
darpaṇairdhūpamālābhirgeyanṛtyādiśobhitam ..
bhānorhi smṛtiśīlaśca tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 75 ..
1.164.d:
दर्पणैर्धूपमालाभिर्गेयनृत्यादिशोभितम् ॥
भानोर्हि स्मृतिशीलश्च तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ॥ 75 ॥
1.164.m: adorned with mirrors, rows of incense, singing, dancing, and the like, / constantly remembering the sun—hear the meritorious fruit of that!

1.164.s:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ tathā ..
tapastaptaṃ mahattena bhavedevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 76 ..
1.164.d:
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु दिव्यं वर्षशतं तथा ॥
तपस्तप्तं महत्तेन भवेदेवं न संशयः ॥ 76 ॥
1.164.m: He has performed great austerity for a divine thousand years / and a divine hundred years; thus it will be without doubt.

1.164.s:
bhagabhaktiprasannātmā yadyapi syātsa pāpakṛt ..
bhagaloke vasennityaṃ bhagānucaratāṃ gataḥ .. 77 ..
1.164.d:
भगभक्तिप्रसन्नात्मा यद्यपि स्यात्स पापकृत् ॥
भगलोके वसेन्नित्यं भगानुचरतां गतः ॥ 77 ॥
1.164.m: His mind serene through devotion to Bhaga, even if he were an evildoer, / he would dwell eternally in Bhaga's world, having become an attendant of Bhaga.

1.164.s:
kṛṣṇāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhīṃ naktena yaśca kṛṣṇāṃ ca saptamīm ..
iha bhogānavāpnoti paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim .. 78 ..
1.164.d:
कृष्णां तु षष्ठीं नक्तेन यश्च कृष्णां च सप्तमीम् ॥
इह भोगानवाप्नोति परत्र च शुभां गतिम् ॥ 78 ॥
1.164.m: And he who observes the dark sixth and the dark seventh with a nocturnal meal / obtains pleasures in this world and an auspicious state in the next.

1.164.s:
yobdamekaṃ tu kurvīta naktaṃ bhagadine naraḥ ..
brahmacārī jitakrodho bhagārcanaparo naraḥ ..
ayācitātparaṃ naktaṃ tasmannāktena vartayet .. 79..
1.164.d:
योब्दमेकं तु कुर्वीत नक्तं भगदिने नरः ॥
ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधो भगार्चनपरो नरः ॥
अयाचितात्परं नक्तं तस्मन्नाक्तेन वर्तयेत् ॥ 79॥
1.164.m: A man who observes a nocturnal meal for one year on the day of Bhaga, / chaste, his anger conquered, intent on the worship of Bhaga, / since a nocturnal meal is superior to eating unasked food, he should sustain himself with a nocturnal meal.

1.164.s:
devaistu bhuktaṃ madhyāhne pūrvāhṇe ṛṣibhistathā ..
aparāhṇe tu pitṛbhiḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ guhyakādibhiḥ .. 1.164.80 ..
1.164.d:
देवैस्तु भुक्तं मध्याह्ने पूर्वाह्णे ऋषिभिस्तथा ॥
अपराह्णे तु पितृभिः संध्यायां गुह्यकादिभिः ॥ 1.164.80 ॥
1.164.m: Eating is done by the gods at midday, and by the sages in the morning, / by the ancestors in the afternoon, and by the Guhyakas and others at twilight.

1.164.s:
sarvā velā hyatikramya saurāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ param ..
bhuṃjāno naktakāle tu sūryabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ .. 81 ..
1.164.d:
सर्वा वेला ह्यतिक्रम्य सौराणां भोजनं परम् ॥
भुंजानो नक्तकाले तु सूर्यभक्तिपरायणः ॥ 81 ॥
1.164.m: Surpassing all these times, the eating of the Sauras is supreme: / eating at the time of the nocturnal meal, devoted to the worship of the sun,

1.164.s:
bhagalokamavāpnoti sumanāḥ sumanovrataḥ ..
bhuktvā saumanasām̐llokānrā jā bhavati bhūtale ..82..
1.164.d:
भगलोकमवाप्नोति सुमनाः सुमनोव्रतः ॥
भुक्त्वा सौमनसाम्̐ल्लोकान्रा जा भवति भूतले ॥82॥
1.164.m: cheerful and keeping the vow of cheerfulness, he reaches the world of Bhaga; / having enjoyed the pleasant worlds, he becomes a king upon earth.

1.164.s:
haviṣyabhojanaṃ snānamāhārasya ca lāghavam ..
agnikāryamadhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhojī samācaret.. 83 ..
1.164.d:
हविष्यभोजनं स्नानमाहारस्य च लाघवम् ॥
अग्निकार्यमधःशय्यां नक्तभोजी समाचरेत्॥ 83 ॥
1.164.m: Eating havis-food, bathing, lightness of nourishment, / the fire-rite, and sleeping on the ground—one who eats a nocturnal meal should practice these.

1.164.s:
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prayatnena kṛtvā naktaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
naro mārgaśire māsi aṃśumāniti pūjayeta ..84..
1.164.d:
कृष्णषष्ठ्यां प्रयत्नेन कृत्वा नक्तं विधानतः ॥
नरो मार्गशिरे मासि अंशुमानिति पूजयेत ॥84॥
1.164.m: Having diligently observed the nocturnal meal on the dark sixth according to rule, / a man in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa should worship him saying: 'To the Radiant One.'

1.164.s:
vidhivatprāśya gomūtramanāhāro niśi svapet..
atirātrasya yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 85 ..
1.164.d:
विधिवत्प्राश्य गोमूत्रमनाहारो निशि स्वपेत्॥
अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाप्नोति मानवः ॥ 85 ॥
1.164.m: Having duly consumed cow urine, he should sleep at night without food; / that man obtains the fruit of the Atirātra sacrifice.

1.164.s:
puṣyepyevaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ bhānumaṃtamuśaṃti ca ..
vājapeyaphalaṃ prāpya ghṛtaṃ prāśya labhennaraḥ .. 86 ..
1.164.d:
पुष्येप्येवं सहस्रांशुं भानुमंतमुशंति च ॥
वाजपेयफलं प्राप्य घृतं प्राश्य लभेन्नरः ॥ 86 ॥
1.164.m: In Puṣya also, they declare [the worship of] the thousand-rayed Bhānu similarly; / having consumed clarified butter, a man obtains the fruit of the Vājapeya sacrifice.

1.164.s:
māghe divākaraṃ nāma kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ narottama ..
niśi pītvā tu gokṣīraṃ gomedhaphalamāpnuyāt .. 87 ..
1.164.d:
माघे दिवाकरं नाम कृष्णषष्ठ्यां नरोत्तम ॥
निशि पीत्वा तु गोक्षीरं गोमेधफलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 87 ॥
1.164.m: In Māgha, [worshipping] the one named Divākara on the dark sixth, O best of men, / and drinking cow's milk at night, he would obtain the fruit of a Gomedha sacrifice.

1.164.s:
mārtaṃḍaṃ phālgune māsi pūjayitvā gavāṃ payaḥ ..
pibettataḥ sūryaloke modate so'yutāyutam ..88..
1.164.d:
मार्तंडं फाल्गुने मासि पूजयित्वा गवां पयः ॥
पिबेत्ततः सूर्यलोके मोदते सोऽयुतायुतम् ॥88॥
1.164.m: Having worshipped Mārtaṇḍa in the month of Phālguna, he should drink / cow's milk; then he rejoices in the world of Sūrya for myriad upon myriad [of years].

1.164.s:
caitre māsi vivasvaṃtaṃ pūjayitvā subhaktimān ..
haviṣyāśī sūryaloke'psarobhiḥ saha modate..89..
1.164.d:
चैत्रे मासि विवस्वंतं पूजयित्वा सुभक्तिमान् ॥
हविष्याशी सूर्यलोकेऽप्सरोभिः सह मोदते॥89॥
1.164.m: In the month of Caitra, having worshipped Vivasvat with sincere devotion, / eating sacrificial food, he rejoices in the world of Sūrya together with the apsarases.

1.164.s:
vaiśākhe caṇḍakiraṇaṃ pūjayecca payovrataḥ..
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ modate sūryasaṃnidhau..1.164.90..
1.164.d:
वैशाखे चण्डकिरणं पूजयेच्च पयोव्रतः॥
वर्षाणामयुतं साग्रं मोदते सूर्यसंनिधौ॥1.164.90॥
1.164.m: In Vaiśākha, observing the milk-fast, one should worship the fierce-rayed [Sun]; / he rejoices in the presence of Sūrya for fully ten thousand years.

1.164.s:
jyeṣṭhe divaspatiṃ pūjya gavāṃ śṛṃgodakaṃ pibet..
gavāṃ koṭipradānasya nikhilaṃ phalamā pnuyāt ..91..
1.164.d:
ज्येष्ठे दिवस्पतिं पूज्य गवां शृंगोदकं पिबेत्॥
गवां कोटिप्रदानस्य निखिलं फलमा प्नुयात् ॥91॥
1.164.m: In Jyeṣṭha, having worshipped Divaspati, he should drink water [poured over] a cow's horn; / he obtains the entire fruit of donating ten million cows.

1.164.s:
āṣāḍhe tvarkanāmānamiṣṭvā prāśya ca gomayam ..
prayātyarkasalokaṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ ca śataṃśatam..92..
1.164.d:
आषाढे त्वर्कनामानमिष्ट्वा प्राश्य च गोमयम् ॥
प्रयात्यर्कसलोकं तु वर्षाणां च शतंशतम्॥92॥
1.164.m: In Āṣāḍha, having sacrificed to the one named Arka and consumed cow dung, / he goes to the world of Arka for hundreds of hundreds of years.

1.164.s:
śrāvaṇe'ryamanāmānaṃ pūjayitvā payaḥ pibet ..
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ modate bhāskarālaye .. 93 ..
1.164.d:
श्रावणेऽर्यमनामानं पूजयित्वा पयः पिबेत् ॥
वर्षाणामयुतं साग्रं मोदते भास्करालये ॥ 93 ॥
1.164.m: In Śrāvaṇa, having worshipped the one named Aryaman, he should drink milk; / he rejoices in the abode of Bhāskara for fully ten thousand years.

1.164.s:
māsi bhādrapade ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhāskaraṃ nāma pūjayet ..
bhāskaraṃ paṃcagavyasya sarvamedhaphalaṃ labhet..94..
1.164.d:
मासि भाद्रपदे षष्ठ्यां भास्करं नाम पूजयेत् ॥
भास्करं पंचगव्यस्य सर्वमेधफलं लभेत्॥94॥
1.164.m: In the month of Bhādrapada, on the sixth, one should worship the one named Bhāskara; / [drinking] the five bovine products [for] Bhāskara, he obtains the fruit of a Sarvamedha sacrifice.

1.164.s:
māsi cāśvayuje ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhagākhyaṃ nāma pūjayet ..
palagomūtrabhukcaiva aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..95..
1.164.d:
मासि चाश्वयुजे षष्ठ्यां भगाख्यं नाम पूजयेत् ॥
पलगोमूत्रभुक्चैव अश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥95॥
1.164.m: And in the month of Āśvayuja, on the sixth, one should worship the one named Bhaga; / consuming a pala of cow's urine, he obtains the fruit of an Aśvamedha sacrifice.

1.164.s:
māse tu kārtike ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śakrākhyaṃ nāma pūjayet ..
dūrvāṃkuraṃ sakṛtprāśya rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet..96..
1.164.d:
मासे तु कार्तिके षष्ठ्यां शक्राख्यं नाम पूजयेत् ॥
दूर्वांकुरं सकृत्प्राश्य राजसूयफलं लभेत्॥96॥
1.164.m: In the month of Kārtika, on the sixth, one should worship the one named Śakra; / having tasted a sprout of dūrvā grass just once, he obtains the fruit of a Rājasūya sacrifice.

1.164.s:
varṣāṃte bhojayedviprānsūryabhaktiparāyaṇān..
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ vajreṇa ca pariplutam..97..
1.164.d:
वर्षांते भोजयेद्विप्रान्सूर्यभक्तिपरायणान्॥
पायसं मधुसंयुक्तं वज्रेण च परिप्लुतम्॥97॥
1.164.m: At the end of the year, he should feed brāhmaṇas who are devoted to the worship of Sūrya / with rice pudding mixed with honey and drenched in clarified butter.

1.164.s:
śaktyā hiraṇyavāsāṃsi bhaktyā tebhyo nivedayet ..
nivedayecca sūryāya kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ ca payasvinīm .. 98 ..
1.164.d:
शक्त्या हिरण्यवासांसि भक्त्या तेभ्यो निवेदयेत् ॥
निवेदयेच्च सूर्याय कृष्णां गां च पयस्विनीम् ॥ 98 ॥
1.164.m: According to his capacity, he should present them with golden garments out of devotion; / and he should present to Sūrya a black, milk-yielding cow.

1.164.s:
varṣamekaṃ ca deve vai nairaṃtaryeṇa yo nayet ..
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ..99..
1.164.d:
वर्षमेकं च देवे वै नैरंतर्येण यो नयेत् ॥
कृष्णषष्ठीव्रतं भक्त्या तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ॥99॥
1.164.m: Whoever passes a single year without interruption for the god, / observing the votive observance of the dark sixth with devotion, hear the meritorious fruit of that:

1.164.s:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ ..
modate sūryaloke tu sa naraḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ..1.164.100..
1.164.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वकामसमन्वितः ॥
मोदते सूर्यलोके तु स नरः शाश्वतीः समाः॥1.164.100॥
1.164.m: Liberated from all sins and endowed with all desires, / that man rejoices in the world of Sūrya for everlasting years.

1.164.s:
puṇyeṣvahaḥsu sarveṣu viṣuvadgrahaṇādiṣu ..
dānopavāsahomādyairakṣayaṃ khaga jāyate ..101..
1.164.d:
पुण्येष्वहःसु सर्वेषु विषुवद्ग्रहणादिषु ॥
दानोपवासहोमाद्यैरक्षयं खग जायते ॥101॥
1.164.m: On all auspicious days, at the equinoxes, eclipses, and so forth, / [the merit generated] by gifts, fasts, oblations, and other [rites] becomes imperishable, O bird.

1.164.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ityuktavānpurā bhānuraruṇāya viśāṃpate..
kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham .. 102 ..
1.164.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
इत्युक्तवान्पुरा भानुररुणाय विशांपते॥
कृष्णषष्ठीव्रतं पुण्यं सर्वपापभयापहम् ॥ 102 ॥
1.164.m: Sumantu said: / Thus the Sun formerly spoke to Aruṇa, O lord of the people, / [about] the meritorious votive observance of the dark sixth, which removes the fear of all sins.

1.164.s:
kṛtvedaṃ puruṣo bhaktyā bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ ..
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ bhānoramitatejasaḥ ..103..
ubhayasaptamīvarṇanam
1.164.d:
कृत्वेदं पुरुषो भक्त्या भास्करस्य महात्मनः ॥
प्रयाति परमं स्थानं भानोरमिततेजसः ॥103॥
उभयसप्तमीवर्णनम्
1.164.m:
A man having performed this with devotion to the great-souled Bhāskara / goes to the supreme abode of Bhānu of boundless splendor.
Description of the Seventh Lunar Day in Both Fortnights

1.165.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ahaṃ te saṃpravakṣyāmi sūryasyavrattamuttamam..
dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāṃ pratipādanamuttamam..1..
1.165.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
अहं ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि सूर्यस्यव्रत्तमुत्तमम्॥
धर्मकामार्थमोक्षाणां प्रतिपादनमुत्तमम्॥1॥
1.165.m: Sumantu said: / I will fully declare to you the supreme votive observance of Sūrya, / the excellent teacher of righteousness, pleasure, wealth, and liberation.

1.165.s:
pauṣamāse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam..
jiteṃdriyaḥ satyavādī śāligodhūmagorasaiḥ ..2..
1.165.d:
पौषमासे तु संप्राप्ते यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम्॥
जितेंद्रियः सत्यवादी शालिगोधूमगोरसैः ॥2॥
1.165.m: When the month of Pauṣa has arrived, he who takes a nocturnal meal / with senses conquered and speaking the truth, [eating] śāli rice, wheat, and dairy foods,

1.165.s:
pakṣayoḥ saptamīṃ yatnādupavāsena yāpayet ..
trisaṃdhyamarcayedbhānuṃ śāṃḍileyaṃ ca suvrata..3..
1.165.d:
पक्षयोः सप्तमीं यत्नादुपवासेन यापयेत् ॥
त्रिसंध्यमर्चयेद्भानुं शांडिलेयं च सुव्रत॥3॥
1.165.m: should diligently spend the seventh [lunar day] of both fortnights with fasting; / O performer of good vows, he should worship Bhānu and Śāṇḍileya at the three twilights;

1.165.s:
adhaḥśāyī bhavennityaṃ sarvabhogaviva rjitaḥ ..
māsi pūrṇe tu saptamyāṃ ghṛtādibhirariṃdama .. 4 ..
1.165.d:
अधःशायी भवेन्नित्यं सर्वभोगविव र्जितः ॥
मासि पूर्णे तु सप्तम्यां घृतादिभिररिंदम ॥ 4 ॥
1.165.m: he should always sleep on the ground, free from all sense-pleasures. / When the month is completed, on the seventh [lunar day], with clarified butter and other [substances], O subduer of foes,

1.165.s:
kṛtvā snānaṃ mahāpūjāṃ sūryadevasya bhāsta..
naivedyaṃ modakaprasthaṃ kṣīraṃ siddhaṃ nivedayet ..5..
1.165.d:
कृत्वा स्नानं महापूजां सूर्यदेवस्य भास्त॥
नैवेद्यं मोदकप्रस्थं क्षीरं सिद्धं निवेदयेत् ॥5॥
1.165.m: having performed the bath and the great worship of the sun-god, O radiant one, / he should offer as a food-offering a prastha of modakas and prepared milk-rice;

1.165.s:
bhojayecca dvijānaṣṭau bhagārcā śubhalakṣaṇām ..
gāṃ ca dattvā mahārāja kapilāṃ bhāskarāya tu ..6..
1.165.d:
भोजयेच्च द्विजानष्टौ भगार्चा शुभलक्षणाम् ॥
गां च दत्त्वा महाराज कपिलां भास्कराय तु ॥6॥
1.165.m: and he should feed eight twice-born [men], [performing] the worship of Bhaga with auspicious marks, / and having given a brown cow to Bhāskara, O great king.

1.165.s:
ya evaṃ kurute puṇyaṃ sūryasya vratamuttamam..
tasya puṇya phalaṃ vacmi sarvakāmasamanvitam..7..
1.165.d:
य एवं कुरुते पुण्यं सूर्यस्य व्रतमुत्तमम्॥
तस्य पुण्य फलं वच्मि सर्वकामसमन्वितम्॥7॥
1.165.m: Whoever thus performs the meritorious, supreme votive observance of Sūrya, / I declare his meritorious fruit, which is accompanied by all desires:

1.165.s:
sūryakoṭipratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ..
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇairmahāvibhavasaṃyutaiḥ ..8..
1.165.d:
सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः ॥
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णैर्महाविभवसंयुतैः ॥8॥
1.165.m: in celestial chariots resembling ten million suns, fulfilling all desires, / crowded with hosts of apsarases, endowed with great splendor,

1.165.s:
saṃgītanṛtyavādyādyairgaṃdharvagaṇaśobhitaiḥ ..
dodhūyamānaścamaraiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ..9..
1.165.d:
संगीतनृत्यवाद्याद्यैर्गंधर्वगणशोभितैः ॥
दोधूयमानश्चमरैः स्तूयमानः सुरासुरैः ॥9॥
1.165.m: resplendent with hosts of gandharvas, with song, dance, instrumental music, and the like, / fanned by chowries, praised by gods and asuras,

1.165.s:
sahasrakiraṇābhāsaḥ sauraiḥ sūryasamanvitaiḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatrāste raviraṃśumān..1.165.10..
1.165.d:
सहस्रकिरणाभासः सौरैः सूर्यसमन्वितैः ॥
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्रास्ते रविरंशुमान्॥1.165.10॥
1.165.m: shining like a thousand rays, accompanied by Saura [worshippers] and suns, / he goes to the supreme abode where the ray-bearing Sun resides.

1.165.s:
romasaṃkhyā tu yā tasyāstatprasūtiḥ kuleṣu ca ..
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate ..11..
1.165.d:
रोमसंख्या तु या तस्यास्तत्प्रसूतिः कुलेषु च ॥
तावद्युगसहस्राणि सूरलोके महीयते ॥11॥
1.165.m: As many hairs as there are on her and on her progeny in his family, / for that many thousands of yugas he is honored in the world of the Sun.

1.165.s:
triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhogānbhuktvā yathepsitān ..
jñānayogaṃ samāsādya punareva pramucyate .. 12 ..
1.165.d:
त्रिःसप्तकुलजैः सार्धं भोगान्भुक्त्वा यथेप्सितान् ॥
ज्ञानयोगं समासाद्य पुनरेव प्रमुच्यते ॥ 12 ॥
1.165.m: Having enjoyed desires as he wishes together with those born in thrice-seven families, / having attained the discipline of knowledge, he is liberated once again.

1.165.s:
yogādduḥkhāṃtamāpnoti jñānayogaṃ pravartate ..
sauradharmādbhavejjñānaṃ sauradharmo bhagārcanāt.. .. 13 ..
1.165.d:
योगाद्दुःखांतमाप्नोति ज्ञानयोगं प्रवर्तते ॥
सौरधर्माद्भवेज्ज्ञानं सौरधर्मो भगार्चनात्॥ ॥ 13 ॥
1.165.m: From yoga he attains the end of suffering; the discipline of knowledge begins; / from Saura duty knowledge arises; Saura duty arises from the worship of Bhaga.

1.165.s:
ityevaṃ te samākhyātaṃ bhavārṇavavyapohanam..
sauramokṣakramopāyaṃ sūrāśrayaniṣevaṇam .. 14 ..
1.165.d:
इत्येवं ते समाख्यातं भवार्णवव्यपोहनम्॥
सौरमोक्षक्रमोपायं सूराश्रयनिषेवणम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.165.m: In this way has been proclaimed to you the removal of the ocean of existence, / the means for the sequence of Saura liberation, [which is] resort to the shelter of the Sun.

1.165.s:
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
piṇyākaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ bhuṃjānaḥ sa jitendriyaḥ .. 15 ..
1.165.d:
माघमासे तु संप्राप्ते यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ॥
पिण्याकं घृतसंयुक्तं भुंजानः स जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 15 ॥
1.165.m: When the month of Māgha has arrived, he who takes a nocturnal meal, / eating oilcake mixed with clarified butter, self-controlled,

1.165.s:
sopavāsaśca saptamyāṃ bhavedubhayapakṣayoḥ ..
ghṛtābhiṣekamaṣṭamyāṃ kuryādbhānornarādhipa ..
gāṃ ca dayāddineśāya taruṇīṃ nīlasaṃnibhām.. 16 ..
1.165.d:
सोपवासश्च सप्तम्यां भवेदुभयपक्षयोः ॥
घृताभिषेकमष्टम्यां कुर्याद्भानोर्नराधिप ॥
गां च दयाद्दिनेशाय तरुणीं नीलसंनिभाम्॥ 16 ॥
1.165.m: and fasts on the seventh of both fortnights; / he should perform an ablution with clarified butter for Bhānu on the eighth, O lord of men, / and give to the lord of the day a young cow resembling a dark-blue [cloud].

1.165.s:
indranīlapratīkāśairvimānaiḥ śikhisaṃyutaiḥ ..
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ bhogānbhuṃkte yathepsitān .. 17 ..
1.165.d:
इन्द्रनीलप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः शिखिसंयुतैः ॥
गत्वादित्यपुरं रम्यं भोगान्भुंक्ते यथेप्सितान् ॥ 17 ॥
1.165.m: In celestial chariots resembling sapphires and endowed with peacocks, / having gone to the delightful city of Āditya, he enjoys pleasures as he desires.

1.165.s:
rājeṃdra phālgune māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
śyāmākakṣīranīvārairjitakrodho jitendriyaḥ .. 18 ..
1.165.d:
राजेंद्र फाल्गुने मासि यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ॥
श्यामाकक्षीरनीवारैर्जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 18 ॥
1.165.m: O lord of kings, he who takes a nocturnal meal in the month of Phālguna / with śyāmāka grain, milk, and wild rice, having conquered anger and subdued the senses,

1.165.s:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vāpyatha saptamyāmupavāsaparo naraḥ ..
aṣṭamyāṃ tu mahāsnānaṃ pañcagavyaghṛtādibhiḥ ..19..
1.165.d:
षष्ठ्यां वाप्यथ सप्तम्यामुपवासपरो नरः ॥
अष्टम्यां तु महास्नानं पञ्चगव्यघृतादिभिः ॥19॥
1.165.m: a man devoted to fasting on the sixth or on the seventh; / and on the eighth, a great bath with the five bovine products, clarified butter, and so forth,

1.165.s:
valmīkajādimṛdbhiśca gomūtraśakṛdādibhiḥ..
tvagbhiśca kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ snāpayitvā pramārjayet ..1.165.20..
1.165.d:
वल्मीकजादिमृद्भिश्च गोमूत्रशकृदादिभिः॥
त्वग्भिश्च क्षीरवृक्षाणां स्नापयित्वा प्रमार्जयेत् ॥1.165.20॥
1.165.m: and with clays born of anthills and the like, cow's urine, cow dung, and the like, / and with the barks of milky trees, having bathed [the image], he should wipe it dry.

1.165.s:
saurabheyīṃ tato dadyādraktābhāṃ raktamāline ..
padmarāgapratīkāśairvimānairhastisaṃyutaiḥ ..
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ .. 21 ..
1.165.d:
सौरभेयीं ततो दद्याद्रक्ताभां रक्तमालिने ॥
पद्मरागप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैर्हस्तिसंयुतैः ॥
गत्वादित्यपुरं रम्यं मोदते शाश्वतीः समाः ॥ 21 ॥
1.165.m: Then he should give to the red-garlanded [deity] a red-hued cow. / In celestial chariots resembling rubies and accompanied by elephants, / having gone to the delightful city of Āditya, he rejoices for everlasting years.

1.165.s:
māsi caitre tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
śālyannaṃ pāyasairyuktaṃ bhuñjānaśca jitendriyaḥ ..
bhānave pāṭalāṃ dadyādvaiṣṇavīṃ taruṇīṃ nṛpa .. 22 ..
1.165.d:
मासि चैत्रे तु संप्राप्ते यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ॥
शाल्यन्नं पायसैर्युक्तं भुञ्जानश्च जितेन्द्रियः ॥
भानवे पाटलां दद्याद्वैष्णवीं तरुणीं नृप ॥ 22 ॥
1.165.m: When the month of Caitra has arrived, he who takes a nocturnal meal, / eating śāli rice combined with milk-porridge, and self-controlled, / should give to Bhānu a young, pink cow dedicated to Viṣṇu, O king.

1.165.s:
puṣparāga prabhairyānairnānāhaṃsādiyāyibhiḥ ..
gacchetsūryapuraṃ ramyaṃ modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ..23..
1.165.d:
पुष्पराग प्रभैर्यानैर्नानाहंसादियायिभिः ॥
गच्छेत्सूर्यपुरं रम्यं मोदते शाश्वतीः समाः ॥23॥
1.165.m: In vehicles having the radiance of topazes, drawn by various swans and other [birds], / he goes to the delightful city of Sūrya and rejoices for everlasting years.

1.165.s:
vaiśākhe vīramāse tu yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
sūrye khaṃḍājya saṃmiśraṃ sakṛddadyānnivedanam .. 24 ..
1.165.d:
वैशाखे वीरमासे तु यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ॥
सूर्ये खंडाज्य संमिश्रं सकृद्दद्यान्निवेदनम् ॥ 24 ॥
1.165.m: In Vaiśākha, the heroic month, whoever observes the nocturnal meal, / should offer once to the Sun an offering mixed with candied sugar and clarified butter.

1.165.s:
gāṃ ca dadyānmahārāja bhāskarāya śubhānana ..
sāmānyaṃ ca vidhiṃ kuryātprayukto yo mayā tava .. 25 ..
1.165.d:
गां च दद्यान्महाराज भास्कराय शुभानन ॥
सामान्यं च विधिं कुर्यात्प्रयुक्तो यो मया तव ॥ 25 ॥
1.165.m: And he should give a cow to the Sun, O great king with auspicious face; / and he should perform the general ritual which was enjoined by me upon you.

1.165.s:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśairyānairbarhiṇavāhanaiḥ ..
aṇimādiguṇairyuktaḥ sūryavadvicareddivi .. 26 ..
1.165.d:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशैर्यानैर्बर्हिणवाहनैः ॥
अणिमादिगुणैर्युक्तः सूर्यवद्विचरेद्दिवि ॥ 26 ॥
1.165.m: In vehicles resembling pure crystal, with peacocks for their mounts, / endowed with qualities such as animan, he wanders in the sky like the Sun.

1.165.s:
saṃprāpte śrāvaṇe māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
kṣīraṣaṣṭikabhaktena sarvasattvahite rataḥ .. 27 ..
1.165.d:
संप्राप्ते श्रावणे मासि यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ॥
क्षीरषष्टिकभक्तेन सर्वसत्त्वहिते रतः ॥ 27 ॥
1.165.m: When the month of Śrāvaṇa arrives, whoever observes the nocturnal meal / with boiled sixty-day rice cooked in milk, devoted to the welfare of all beings,

1.165.s:
pītavarṇāṃ ca gāṃ dadyādbhāskarāya mahātmane ..
sāmānyamakhilaṃ kuryādvidhānaṃ yatprakīrtitam ..28..
1.165.d:
पीतवर्णां च गां दद्याद्भास्कराय महात्मने ॥
सामान्यमखिलं कुर्याद्विधानं यत्प्रकीर्तितम् ॥28॥
1.165.m: and gives a yellow cow to the great-souled Sun, / should perform the entire general ritual that has been proclaimed.

1.165.s:
sa vicitrairmahāyānairhaṃsasārasagāmibhiḥ ..
gatvādityapuraṃ śrīmānpūrvoktaṃ labhate phalam .. 29 ..
1.165.d:
स विचित्रैर्महायानैर्हंससारसगामिभिः ॥
गत्वादित्यपुरं श्रीमान्पूर्वोक्तं लभते फलम् ॥ 29 ॥
1.165.m: He, magnificent, having gone to the city of Āditya in wondrous great vehicles / drawn by geese and sarus cranes, attains the aforementioned fruit.

1.165.s:
vīra bhādrapade māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
hutaśeṣahaviṣyāśī vṛkṣamūlamupāśritaḥ .. 1.165.30 ..
1.165.d:
वीर भाद्रपदे मासि यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ॥
हुतशेषहविष्याशी वृक्षमूलमुपाश्रितः ॥ 1.165.30 ॥
1.165.m: O hero, whoever observes the nocturnal meal in the month of Bhādrapada, / eating sacrificial remnants of havis food, taking shelter at the base of a tree,

1.165.s:
svapyādāyatane rātrau sarvabhūtānukampakaḥ ..
dadyādgāṃ rohiṇīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ bhāskarāya mahātmane .. 31 ..
1.165.d:
स्वप्यादायतने रात्रौ सर्वभूतानुकम्पकः ॥
दद्याद्गां रोहिणीं श्रेष्ठां भास्कराय महात्मने ॥ 31 ॥
1.165.m: should sleep at night in a temple, showing compassion to all beings; / he should give an excellent red-brown cow to the great-souled Sun.

1.165.s:
niśākarakaraprakhyairvajravaidūryasannibhaiḥ ..
cakravākasamāyuktairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ .. 32 ..
1.165.d:
निशाकरकरप्रख्यैर्वज्रवैदूर्यसन्निभैः ॥
चक्रवाकसमायुक्तैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः ॥ 32 ॥
1.165.m: In celestial chariots resembling the rays of the moon, looking like diamond and beryl, / fitted with ruddy geese, granting all desires,

1.165.s:
gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ surāsurasuvanditam..
modate sa mahābhāgo yāvadā bhūtasaṃplavam .. 33 ..
1.165.d:
गत्वादित्यपुरं रम्यं सुरासुरसुवन्दितम्॥
मोदते स महाभागो यावदा भूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.165.m: having gone to the delightful city of Āditya, praised by gods and asuras, / that highly fortunate one rejoices until the dissolution of all beings.

1.165.s:
śrīmānāśvayuje māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
mitāśanaṃ prabhuñjāno jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ .. 34 ..
1.165.d:
श्रीमानाश्वयुजे मासि यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ॥
मिताशनं प्रभुञ्जानो जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 34 ॥
1.165.m: In the month of Āśvayuja, the fortunate one who observes the nocturnal meal, / eating moderate food, having subdued anger and conquered his senses,

1.165.s:
dadyādgāṃ padmavarṇābhāṃ ,bhānave'mitatejase ..
divyābharaṇasaṃpannāṃ taruṇīṃ ca payasvinīm ..35..
1.165.d:
दद्याद्गां पद्मवर्णाभां ,भानवेऽमिततेजसे ॥
दिव्याभरणसंपन्नां तरुणीं च पयस्विनीम् ॥35॥
1.165.m: should give a cow having the color of a lotus to the Sun of immeasurable brilliance, / adorned with divine ornaments, young and rich in milk.

1.165.s:
svastimauktikasaṃkāśairiṃdranīlopaśobhitaiḥ ..
jīvo jīvakasaṃyuktavimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ..
gacchedbhānusalokatvaṃ bhuñjānaḥ sa jitendriyaḥ .. 36 ..
1.165.d:
स्वस्तिमौक्तिकसंकाशैरिंद्रनीलोपशोभितैः ॥
जीवो जीवकसंयुक्तविमानैः सार्वकामिकैः ॥
गच्छेद्भानुसलोकत्वं भुञ्जानः स जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 36 ॥
1.165.m: In celestial chariots resembling pearls and Svastika symbols, adorned with sapphires, / having jīvañjīvaka birds, granting all desires, / he who has subdued his senses, enjoying himself, goes to the world of the Sun.

1.165.s:
divākarāya gāṃ dadyājvalanārkasamaprabhām ..
pūrvoktaṃ ca vidhiṃ kuryātsūrya tulyo bhavennaraḥ .. 37 ..
1.165.d:
दिवाकराय गां दद्याज्वलनार्कसमप्रभाम् ॥
पूर्वोक्तं च विधिं कुर्यात्सूर्य तुल्यो भवेन्नरः ॥ 37 ॥
1.165.m: He should give to the maker of day a cow possessing radiance equal to fire and the sun, / and should perform the previously described rite; the man becomes equal to the Sun.

1.165.s:
kālānalaśikhaprakhyairmahāyānairnagopamaiḥ ..
mahāsiṃhakṛtāropaiḥ sūryavanmodate sukhī .. 38 ..
1.165.d:
कालानलशिखप्रख्यैर्महायानैर्नगोपमैः ॥
महासिंहकृतारोपैः सूर्यवन्मोदते सुखी ॥ 38 ॥
1.165.m: In great vehicles resembling the flames of the fire of destruction, like mountains, / mounted with great lions, happy, he rejoices like the Sun.

1.165.s:
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam ..
yaccānnaṃ payasā yuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ sa jitendriyaḥ ..39..
1.165.d:
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि यः कुर्यान्नक्तभोजनम् ॥
यच्चान्नं पयसा युक्तं भुञ्जानः स जितेन्द्रियः ॥39॥
1.165.m: In the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, whoever observes the nocturnal meal, / eating food prepared with milk, with senses conquered,

1.165.s:
prayacchedgāṃ tathā raktāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitām ..
sūryāya kuruśārdūla vidhiṃ cāpi samācaret .. 1.165.40 ..
1.165.d:
प्रयच्छेद्गां तथा रक्तां नानालंकारभूषिताम् ॥
सूर्याय कुरुशार्दूल विधिं चापि समाचरेत् ॥ 1.165.40 ॥
1.165.m: should likewise give a red cow adorned with various ornaments / to the Sun, O tiger of the Kurus, and perform the ritual as well.

1.165.s:
sitapadmanibhairyānaiḥ śvetāśvarathasaṃyutaiḥ ..
gatvā tatra pure ramye prabhayā parayānvitaḥ .. 41 ..
1.165.d:
सितपद्मनिभैर्यानैः श्वेताश्वरथसंयुतैः ॥
गत्वा तत्र पुरे रम्ये प्रभया परयान्वितः ॥ 41 ॥
1.165.m: In vehicles resembling white lotuses, joined with chariots drawn by white horses, / having gone there to that lovely city, endowed with supreme radiance,

1.165.s:
ahiṃsāsatyavacanamasteyaṃ kṣāṃtirārjavam ..
triṣavaṇāgnihavanaṃ bhūśayyā naktabhojanam .. 42 ..
1.165.d:
अहिंसासत्यवचनमस्तेयं क्षांतिरार्जवम् ॥
त्रिषवणाग्निहवनं भूशय्या नक्तभोजनम् ॥ 42 ॥
1.165.m: non-violence, truthful speech, non-stealing, forbearance, uprightness, / offering into the fires at the three twilight ablutions, sleeping on the ground, the nocturnal meal—

1.165.s:
pakṣayorubhayormārge saptamyāṃ kurunaṃdana ..
etānguṇānsamāśritya kurvāṇo vratamutta mam .. 43 ..
1.165.d:
पक्षयोरुभयोर्मार्गे सप्तम्यां कुरुनंदन ॥
एतान्गुणान्समाश्रित्य कुर्वाणो व्रतमुत्त मम् ॥ 43 ॥
1.165.m: in both fortnights in Mārgaśīrṣa on the seventh lunar day, O son of the Kurus, / relying on these virtues, one who performs this excellent votive observance

1.165.s:
saptamyobhayavikhyātaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham ..
sarvarogapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ..44..
1.165.d:
सप्तम्योभयविख्यातं सर्वपापभयापहम् ॥
सर्वरोगप्रशमनं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥44॥
1.165.m: known as the observance of both seventh lunar days, removes the fear of all sins, / cures all diseases, and grants the fruits of all desires.

1.165.s:
ityevamādīnniyamāṃścaretsūryavratī sadā..
ya icchedvipulaṃ sthānaṃ bhānoramitatejasaḥ ..45.. ..
1.165.d:
इत्येवमादीन्नियमांश्चरेत्सूर्यव्रती सदा॥
य इच्छेद्विपुलं स्थानं भानोरमिततेजसः ॥45॥ ॥
1.165.m: One who observes the votive observance of the Sun should always practice such rules and others, / whoever desires the expansive abode of the Sun of immeasurable brilliance.

1.165.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpa ubhayasaptamīvarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 165 .. cha
sauradharme nikṣubhāvratavarṇanam
1.165.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्प उभयसप्तमीवर्णनं नाम पंचषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ॥ 165 ॥ छ
सौरधर्मे निक्षुभाव्रतवर्णनम्
1.165.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Observance of Both Seventh Lunar Days' in the ritual of the seventh lunar day of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious and great Bhaviṣyapurāṇa.
In the solar religion: description of the Nikṣubhā votive observance

1.166.s:
..sumaṃturuvāca ..
sūryabhaktā tu yā nārī dhruvaṃ sā puruṣo bhavet..
strī putramuttamaṃ sā cetkāṃkṣate śṛṇu tadvratam.. 1 ..
1.166.d:
॥सुमंतुरुवाच ॥
सूर्यभक्ता तु या नारी ध्रुवं सा पुरुषो भवेत्॥
स्त्री पुत्रमुत्तमं सा चेत्कांक्षते शृणु तद्व्रतम्॥ 1 ॥
1.166.m: Sumantu said: / A woman who is devoted to the Sun will certainly become a man. / If a woman desires an excellent son, listen to that votive observance

1.166.s:
nikṣubhārkākhyamākhyātaṃ sadā prītivivardhanam ..
aviyogakaraṃ vīra dharmakāmārthasādhakam .. 2 ..
1.166.d:
निक्षुभार्काख्यमाख्यातं सदा प्रीतिविवर्धनम् ॥
अवियोगकरं वीर धर्मकामार्थसाधकम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.166.m: named Nikṣubhārka, declared to ever increase affection, / causing non-separation, O hero, accomplishing dharma, desire, and wealth.

1.166.s:
saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā saṃkrāṃtau ca raverdine ..
haviṣā havirhomaṃ tu sopavāsaḥ samācaret .. 3 ..
1.166.d:
सप्तम्यामथ षष्ठ्यां वा संक्रांतौ च रवेर्दिने ॥
हविषा हविर्होमं तु सोपवासः समाचरेत् ॥ 3 ॥
1.166.m: On the seventh lunar day, or on the sixth, or at a solar transit, or on a Sunday, / keeping a fast, one should perform the offering of oblation with havis food.

1.166.s:
nikṣubhāṃ kāṃsyaniṣpannāṃ kṛtvā svarṇamayīṃ śubhām ..
rājatīṃ vātha vā varṣaṃ snāpayecca ghṛtādibhiḥ ..4..
1.166.d:
निक्षुभां कांस्यनिष्पन्नां कृत्वा स्वर्णमयीं शुभाम् ॥
राजतीं वाथ वा वर्षं स्नापयेच्च घृतादिभिः ॥4॥
1.166.m: Having made [an image of] Nikṣubhā out of bell-metal, or an auspicious golden one, / or of silver, one should bathe it with clarified butter and other substances for a year.

1.166.s:
gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya vastrayu gmaiśca śobhanaiḥ ..
bhakṣyabhojyairaśeṣaiśca vitānadhvajacāmaraiḥ .. 5 ..
1.166.d:
गंधमाल्यैरलंकृत्य वस्त्रयु ग्मैश्च शोभनैः ॥
भक्ष्यभोज्यैरशेषैश्च वितानध्वजचामरैः ॥ 5 ॥
1.166.m: Having adorned it with perfumes and garlands, and with pairs of beautiful garments, / with all kinds of edible and consumable foods, and with canopies, banners, and chowries,
one should also feed the Sun's devotees, who are cloaked in white garments. / Having made it in the center of the temple, one should arrange the idol.

1.166.s:
kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ vitānacchatraśobhitam ..
dhvajaśaṃkhādivibhavairbhagasyāyatanaṃ nayet .. 7 ..
1.166.d:
कृत्वा शिरसि तत्पात्रं वितानच्छत्रशोभितम् ॥
ध्वजशंखादिविभवैर्भगस्यायतनं नयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
1.166.m: Having placed that vessel upon the head, adorned with canopies and royal parasols, / with the splendor of banners, conchs, and other instruments, one should carry it to the temple of Bhaga.
One should offer this votive observance of Nikṣubhā and the Sun, the lord of day; / one should set the vessel, endowed with splendor, upon the pedestal.

1.166.s:
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya raviṃ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ..
samāpya tadvrataṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇuyātpha lamaśnute .. 9 ..
1.166.d:
प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य रविं प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ॥
समाप्य तद्व्रतं पुण्यं शृणुयात्फ लमश्नुते ॥ 9 ॥
1.166.m: Having circumambulated the Sun, bowed down, and asked for pardon, / completing that meritorious votive observance, one who hears [this] enjoys the fruit.

1.166.s:
dvādaśādityasaṃkāśairmahāyānairnagopamaiḥ ..
yatheṣṭaṃ bhānave loke sauraiḥ sārdhaṃ pramodate .. 1.166.10 ..
1.166.d:
द्वादशादित्यसंकाशैर्महायानैर्नगोपमैः ॥
यथेष्टं भानवे लोके सौरैः सार्धं प्रमोदते ॥ 1.166.10 ॥
1.166.m: In great vehicles resembling the twelve Ādityas, like mountains, / he rejoices according to his desire in the world of the Sun together with the Sauras.

1.166.s:
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi varṣakoṭiśatāni ca ..
naṃdate'sau mahābhāga viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 11 ..
1.166.d:
वर्षकोटिसहस्राणि वर्षकोटिशतानि च ॥
नंदतेऽसौ महाभाग विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥ 11 ॥
1.166.m: For thousands of crores of years and hundreds of crores of years, / that highly fortunate one rejoices, [and then] is honored in the world of Viṣṇu.

1.166.s:
tataḥ karmaviśeṣeṇa sarvakāmasamanvitam ..
brahmalokaṃ samāsādya paraṃ sukhamavāpnuyāt.. 12 ..
1.166.d:
ततः कर्मविशेषेण सर्वकामसमन्वितम् ॥
ब्रह्मलोकं समासाद्य परं सुखमवाप्नुयात्॥ 12 ॥
1.166.m: Then, through the distinction of his actions, having attained the world of Brahmā / endowed with all desires, he obtains supreme happiness.
Falling from the world of Brahmā, glorious, well worshipped by the gods, / reverenced by gods and asuras, he attains Prajāpati.

1.166.s:
lokāniha ciraṃ bhuktvā somaloke mahīyate ..
somādeṃdraṃ punarlokamāsādyeṃdrapatirbhavet .. 14 ..
1.166.d:
लोकानिह चिरं भुक्त्वा सोमलोके महीयते ॥
सोमादेंद्रं पुनर्लोकमासाद्येंद्रपतिर्भवेत् ॥ 14 ॥
1.166.m: Having enjoyed these worlds for a long time, he is honored in the world of Soma; / from Soma's world, having reached the world of Indra again, he becomes a lord of Indra's station.

1.166.s:
iṃdralokācca gaṃdharvalokaṃ prāpya sa modate ..
tatastaddharmaśeṣeṇa bhavatyādityabhāvitaḥ .. 15 ..
1.166.d:
इंद्रलोकाच्च गंधर्वलोकं प्राप्य स मोदते ॥
ततस्तद्धर्मशेषेण भवत्यादित्यभावितः ॥ 15 ॥
1.166.m: And from the world of Indra, having reached the world of the gandharvas, he rejoices; / then, through the remainder of that merit, he becomes devoted to the Sun.

1.166.s:
svakarmabhāvanodyogātpunaḥ prārabhate śubham ..
śubhācca punaretyeha sa yātyatisahasraśaḥ .. 16 ..
1.166.d:
स्वकर्मभावनोद्योगात्पुनः प्रारभते शुभम् ॥
शुभाच्च पुनरेत्येह स यात्यतिसहस्रशः ॥ 16 ॥
1.166.m: From the exertion of cultivating his own actions, he undertakes auspicious deeds once more; / and from auspicious action, returning here, he journeys through thousands [of births].

1.166.s:
yāvannāpnoti maraṇaṃ tāvadbhramati karmaṇā ..
sunirvedātsavairāgyaṃ vairāgyājjñānasaṃbhavaḥ .. 17 ..
1.166.d:
यावन्नाप्नोति मरणं तावद्भ्रमति कर्मणा ॥
सुनिर्वेदात्सवैराग्यं वैराग्याज्ज्ञानसंभवः ॥ 17 ॥
1.166.m: As long as he does not attain [true end of] death, so long does he wander through action. / From profound disillusionment comes dispassion; from dispassion arises knowledge.

From knowledge yoga proceeds; through yoga he reaches the end of suffering.
Description of the Nikṣubhārka votive observance

1.167.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ cāpyatha saptamyāṃ niyatā brahmacāriṇī ..
varṣamekaṃ na bhuṃkte yā mahābhāgajigīṣayā .. 1 ..
1.167.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
षष्ठ्यां चाप्यथ सप्तम्यां नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी ॥
वर्षमेकं न भुंक्ते या महाभागजिगीषया ॥ 1 ॥
1.167.m: Sumantu said: / On the sixth or on the seventh lunar day, restrained, celibate, / she who does not eat for one year, desiring to conquer misfortune,

1.167.s:
varṣāṃti pratimāṃ kṛtvā nikṣubhāṃketi viśrutām .!
snānādyaṃ ca vidhiṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktaṃ labhate guṇam..2..
1.167.d:
वर्षांति प्रतिमां कृत्वा निक्षुभांकेति विश्रुताम् ।!
स्नानाद्यं च विधिं कृत्वा पूर्वोक्तं लभते गुणम्॥2॥
1.167.m: Having made an image celebrated as Nikṣubhārka at the year's end, / and having performed the rite beginning with bathing, she obtains the previously mentioned benefit.

1.167.s:
jāṃbūnadamayairyānaiścaturdvārairalaṃkṛte ..
gatvādityapure ramye aśeṣaṃ viṃdate phalam .. 3 ..
1.167.d:
जांबूनदमयैर्यानैश्चतुर्द्वारैरलंकृते ॥
गत्वादित्यपुरे रम्ये अशेषं विंदते फलम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.167.m: Adorned with four gates and chariots made of Jāmbūnada gold, / having gone to the delightful city of Āditya, she attains complete fruit.

1.167.s:
saurādisarvalokeṣu bhogānbhuktvā yathepsitān ..
kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ patimāpnuyāt .. 4 ..
1.167.d:
सौरादिसर्वलोकेषु भोगान्भुक्त्वा यथेप्सितान् ॥
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्राजानं पतिमाप्नुयात् ॥ 4 ॥
1.167.m: Having enjoyed desired pleasures in all worlds beginning with the world of Sūrya, / arriving in due course in this world, she would obtain a king as husband.

1.167.s:
yā nāryupavasedevaṃ kṛṣṇāmekāṃ tu saptamīm ..
sā gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ bhānoramitatejasaḥ .. 5 ..
1.167.d:
या नार्युपवसेदेवं कृष्णामेकां तु सप्तमीम् ॥
सा गच्छेत्परमं स्थानं भानोरमिततेजसः ॥ 5 ॥
1.167.m: A woman who fasts thus on a single dark saptamī, / goes to the supreme station of the Sun of boundless radiance.

1.167.s:
varṣāṃte pratimāṃ kṛtvā śālipiṣṭamayīṃ śubhām ..
pītānulepanairmālyaiḥ pītavastraiśca pūjayet ..
pūrvoktamakhilaṃ kṛtvā bhāskarāya nivedayet .. 6 ..
1.167.d:
वर्षांते प्रतिमां कृत्वा शालिपिष्टमयीं शुभाम् ॥
पीतानुलेपनैर्माल्यैः पीतवस्त्रैश्च पूजयेत् ॥
पूर्वोक्तमखिलं कृत्वा भास्कराय निवेदयेत् ॥ 6 ॥
1.167.m: Having made an auspicious image out of rice flour at the end of the year, / she should worship it with yellow ointments, garlands, and yellow garments; / having done everything previously stated, she should offer it to Bhāskara.
With seven terrible celestial chariots having the luster of elephants and gold, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred crore years.

1.167.s:
sauralokādilokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānnarādhipa ..
kramādāgatya loke'sminya theṣṭaṃ viṃdate patim ..
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ dhanadhānyasamanvitam .. 8 ..
1.167.d:
सौरलोकादिलोकेषु भुक्त्वा भोगान्नराधिप ॥
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्य थेष्टं विंदते पतिम् ॥
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्नं धनधान्यसमन्वितम् ॥ 8 ॥
1.167.m: Having enjoyed pleasures in worlds beginning with the world of Sūrya, O ruler of men, / and arriving in due course in this world, she finds a husband of her liking, / endowed with all auspicious marks and accompanied by wealth and grain.

1.167.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yā nārī tu dṛḍhavratā ..
.. 9 .. varṣāṃte sarvagaṃdhāḍhyaṃ nikṣubhārkaṃ nivedayet ..
1.167.d:
कृष्णपक्षे तु सप्तम्यां या नारी तु दृढव्रता ॥
॥ 9 ॥ वर्षांते सर्वगंधाढ्यं निक्षुभार्कं निवेदयेत् ॥
1.167.m: A woman steadfast in her vow, on the saptamī of the dark fortnight, / at the end of the year should offer Nikṣubhārka rich in all fragrances,
having fed a Maga woman with gold, jewels, and pearls.

1.167.d:
सुविचित्रैर्महायानैर्दिव्यगंधर्वशोभितैः॥
सा वै युगसहस्राणि सूरलोके नराधिप ॥11॥
1.167.m: In wondrous great vehicles adorned by divine Gandharvas, / she truly [dwells] in the world of Sūrya for thousands of yugas, O ruler of men.

1.167.s:
yatheṣṭaṃ bhānave loke bhogānbhuktvā tu kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
kramādāgatya lokesminrājantaṃ viṃdate patim ..12..
1.167.d:
यथेष्टं भानवे लोके भोगान्भुक्त्वा तु कृत्स्नशः ॥
क्रमादागत्य लोकेस्मिन्राजन्तं विंदते पतिम् ॥12॥
1.167.m: Having fully enjoyed pleasures at will in the world of the Sun, / arriving in due course in this world, she obtains a radiant king as husband.

1.167.s:
evaṃ yā kurute rājanvrataṃ pāpabhayāpaham ..
nikṣubhārkamidaṃ puṇyaṃ sā yāti paramaṃ padam .. 13 ..
1.167.d:
एवं या कुरुते राजन्व्रतं पापभयापहम् ॥
निक्षुभार्कमिदं पुण्यं सा याति परमं पदम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.167.m: A woman who performs this vow that removes fear of sin, O king, / this meritorious Nikṣubhārka vow, goes to the supreme abode.

1.167.s:
varṣamekaṃ mahābāho śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ ..
varṣāṃte vai bhojayedvīra dāṃpatyaṃ bhojakeṣu vai ..14..
1.167.d:
वर्षमेकं महाबाहो श्रद्धया परयान्वितः ॥
वर्षांते वै भोजयेद्वीर दांपत्यं भोजकेषु वै ॥14॥
1.167.m: Endowed with supreme faith for one year, O mighty-armed one, / at the end of the year, O hero, one should feed a married couple among the Bhojakas.

1.167.s:
bhojayitvā tu dāṃpatyaṃ bhogakānāṃ mahābalaiḥ ..
pūjayedgaṃdhamālyaistu vāsobhiḥ kurunaṃdana .. 15 ..
1.167.d:
भोजयित्वा तु दांपत्यं भोगकानां महाबलैः ॥
पूजयेद्गंधमाल्यैस्तु वासोभिः कुरुनंदन ॥ 15 ॥
1.167.m: Having fed the couple among the Bhojakas, O descendant of Kuru, / one should worship them with mighty [devotion] using perfumes, garlands, and garments.

1.167.s:
kṛtvā tāmramaye pātre vajrapūrṇairalaṃkṛtam ..
nikṣubhārkaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ dattvā tābhyāṃ tu śaktitaḥ .. 16 ..
1.167.d:
कृत्वा ताम्रमये पात्रे वज्रपूर्णैरलंकृतम् ॥
निक्षुभार्कं तु सौवर्णं दत्त्वा ताभ्यां तु शक्तितः ॥ 16 ॥
1.167.m: Having placed in a copper vessel [an image] adorned with diamonds, / and having given golden Nikṣubhā and Arka to the two of them according to one's capacity—

1.167.s:
nikṣubhā bhojikā jñeyā bhojako'rkaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
tasmāttau pūjayetsaurīśvaravacchraddhayānvitaḥ .. 17 ..
kāmapradastrīvratavarṇanam
1.167.d:
निक्षुभा भोजिका ज्ञेया भोजकोऽर्कः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
तस्मात्तौ पूजयेत्सौरीश्वरवच्छ्रद्धयान्वितः ॥ 17 ॥
कामप्रदस्त्रीव्रतवर्णनम्
1.167.m:
Nikṣubhā should be known as the Bhojikā, and Arka is proclaimed as the Bhojaka; / therefore, endowed with faith, one should worship the two like the lord and lady of Sūrya.
Description of the women's votive observance fulfilling desires

1.168.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ekabhaktena yā nārī kārttikaṃ kṣapayennṛpa ..
kṣamāhiṃsādiniyamaiḥ saṃyatā brahmacāriṇī ..1..
1.168.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
एकभक्तेन या नारी कार्त्तिकं क्षपयेन्नृप ॥
क्षमाहिंसादिनियमैः संयता ब्रह्मचारिणी ॥1॥
1.168.m: Sumantu said: / A woman who passes Kārttika on a single meal a day, O king, / practicing celibacy, restrained by the rules of forbearance, non-violence, and so forth,

1.168.s:
guḍājyamiśraṃ śālyannaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet ..
pakṣayorubhayostāta śradayā parayānvitā .. 2 ..
1.168.d:
गुडाज्यमिश्रं शाल्यन्नं भास्कराय निवेदयेत् ॥
पक्षयोरुभयोस्तात श्रदया परयान्विता ॥ 2 ॥
1.168.m: should offer cooked śāli-rice mixed with jaggery and ghee to Bhāskara / in both fortnights, dear one, endowed with supreme faith.

1.168.s:
puṣpāṇāṃ karavīrāṇāṃ guggulaṃ sājyamādiśet ..
saptamyāṃ tāta ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai upavāsaratirbhavet .. 3 ..
1.168.d:
पुष्पाणां करवीराणां गुग्गुलं साज्यमादिशेत् ॥
सप्तम्यां तात षष्ठ्यां वै उपवासरतिर्भवेत् ॥ 3 ॥
1.168.m: She should assign oleander flowers and guggulu with ghee; / on the saptamī and on the ṣaṣṭhī, dear one, she should be devoted to fasting.

1.168.s:
iṃdranīlapratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ..
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūraloke mahīyate .. 4 ..
1.168.d:
इंद्रनीलप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः ॥
वर्षायुतशतं साग्रं सूरलोके महीयते ॥ 4 ॥
1.168.m: In celestial chariots fulfilling all desires, resembling sapphires, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred myriad years.

1.168.s:
tathā ca sarvalokeṣu bhogamāsādya yatnataḥ ..
kramādāgatya loke'sminyatheṣṭaṃ viṃdate patim .. 5 ..
1.168.d:
तथा च सर्वलोकेषु भोगमासाद्य यत्नतः ॥
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्यथेष्टं विंदते पतिम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.168.m: And likewise, having carefully attained enjoyment in all worlds, / arriving in due course in this world, she finds a husband to her liking.

1.168.s:
ityevaṃ sarvayajñeṣu vidhistulyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
ekabhaktopavāsasya phalaṃ ca sadṛśaṃ bhavet .. 6 ..
1.168.d:
इत्येवं सर्वयज्ञेषु विधिस्तुल्यः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
एकभक्तोपवासस्य फलं च सदृशं भवेत् ॥ 6 ॥
1.168.m: In this way, the rule is proclaimed identical in all sacrifices, / and the fruit of eating one meal a day and fasting is similar.

1.168.s:
kṣamā satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ śaucamiṃdriyanigrahaḥ ..
sūryapūjāgnihavanaṃ saṃtoṣaḥ steyavarjanam..7..
1.168.d:
क्षमा सत्यं दया दानं शौचमिंद्रियनिग्रहः ॥
सूर्यपूजाग्निहवनं संतोषः स्तेयवर्जनम्॥7॥
1.168.m: Forbearance, truth, compassion, charity, purity, restraint of the senses, / worship of Sūrya, offering in fire, contentment, and abstention from theft—

1.168.s:
sarvavrateṣvayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo daśadhā smṛtaḥ ..
niḥśeṣamahaṃ vakṣyāmi māsānmāsavrataṃ prati .. 8 ..
1.168.d:
सर्वव्रतेष्वयं धर्मः सामान्यो दशधा स्मृतः ॥
निःशेषमहं वक्ष्यामि मासान्मासव्रतं प्रति ॥ 8 ॥
1.168.m: this tenfold duty is remembered as common to all votive observances. / I shall tell without remainder the month-by-month votive observance.

1.168.s:
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi vyomapṛṣṭhe vinirmitam ..
gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya śubhānanamanaupamam.. 9 ..
1.168.d:
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि व्योमपृष्ठे विनिर्मितम् ॥
गंधमाल्यैरलंकृत्य शुभाननमनौपमम्॥ 9 ॥
1.168.m: In the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, having adorned [an image] fashioned on the surface of the sky, / with a lovely face and peerless, with perfumes and garlands,

1.168.s:
tāmrapātrādikaiścaivāpyapsarogaṇasevitaiḥ ..
sumerau daśasāhasre sūryaloke mahīyate .. 1.168.10 ..
1.168.d:
ताम्रपात्रादिकैश्चैवाप्यप्सरोगणसेवितैः ॥
सुमेरौ दशसाहस्रे सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 1.168.10 ॥
1.168.m: with copper vessels and the like, attended by hosts of apsarases, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya upon Sumeru for ten thousand [years].

1.168.s:
sarvadevakadaṃbeṣu saṃprāpya vimalāṃ śriyam ..
kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ patimāpnuyāt ..
puṣpairamumalaṃkṛtya bhānave vinivedayet .. 11 ..
1.168.d:
सर्वदेवकदंबेषु संप्राप्य विमलां श्रियम् ॥
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्राजानं पतिमाप्नुयात् ॥
पुष्पैरमुमलंकृत्य भानवे विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
1.168.m: Attaining spotless fortune among all the assemblies of the gods, / arriving in due course in this world, she would obtain a king as husband. / Having adorned this with flowers, one should present it to the Sun.

1.168.s:
gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya śubhānanamanaupa mam ..
tāmrapātrādikāṃsyaṃ vā kṛtvā tatra nivedayet .. 12 ..
1.168.d:
गंधमाल्यैरलंकृत्य शुभाननमनौप मम् ॥
ताम्रपात्रादिकांस्यं वा कृत्वा तत्र निवेदयेत् ॥ 12 ॥
1.168.m: Having adorned with perfumes and garlands [an image] of lovely face and peerless, / having placed it in a copper or bell-metal vessel, she should present it there.

1.168.s:
mahāpuṣpakayānena divyagaṃdhapravāhinā ..
sumerau daśasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ..13..
1.168.d:
महापुष्पकयानेन दिव्यगंधप्रवाहिना ॥
सुमेरौ दशसाहस्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥13॥
1.168.m: In a great celestial flower-chariot wafting divine fragrance, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya upon Sumeru for ten thousand [years].

1.168.s:
bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānsarvalokeṣu bhārata ..
saṃprāpyaitaṃ kramāllokaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vidate patim..14..
1.168.d:
भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान्भोगान्सर्वलोकेषु भारत ॥
संप्राप्यैतं क्रमाल्लोकं यथेष्टं विदते पतिम्॥14॥
1.168.m: Having enjoyed vast pleasures in all worlds, O descendant of Bharata, / arriving in due course in this world, she finds a husband to her liking.

1.168.s:
māghe rathamaśvayujaṃ dīpamālyavibhūṣitam..
piṣṭasānusamā yuktaṃ kṛtvāyatanamānayet..15..
1.168.d:
माघे रथमश्वयुजं दीपमाल्यविभूषितम्॥
पिष्टसानुसमा युक्तं कृत्वायतनमानयेत्॥15॥
1.168.m: In Māgha, having made a chariot yoked with horses, adorned with lamps and garlands, / accompanied by a peak of flour, she should bring it to the temple.

1.168.s:
mahārathopamairyānaiḥ śvetāśvavarasaṃyutaiḥ ..
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate..16..
1.168.d:
महारथोपमैर्यानैः श्वेताश्ववरसंयुतैः ॥
वर्षायुतशतं साग्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते॥16॥
1.168.m: In celestial chariots resembling great chariots, accompanied by excellent white horses, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred myriad years.

1.168.s:
sarvāmarāṇāṃ lokeṣu prāpya bhogānyathepsitān..
kramādāgatya loke'sminyatheṣṭaṃ patimāpnuyāt ..17..
1.168.d:
सर्वामराणां लोकेषु प्राप्य भोगान्यथेप्सितान्॥
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्यथेष्टं पतिमाप्नुयात् ॥17॥
1.168.m: Having attained desired pleasures in the worlds of all the immortals, / arriving in due course in this world, she would obtain a husband to her liking.

1.168.s:
pratimāṃ phālgune māsi kṛtvā piṣṭamayī raveḥ ..
gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya sthāpayedbhāskarā laye..18..
1.168.d:
प्रतिमां फाल्गुने मासि कृत्वा पिष्टमयी रवेः ॥
गंधमाल्यैरलंकृत्य स्थापयेद्भास्करा लये॥18॥
1.168.m: Having made an image of the Sun out of flour in the month of Phālguna, / and adorned it with perfumes and garlands, she should install it in the temple of Bhāskara.

1.168.s:
yānairapratimairdivyairgītanādasamākulaiḥ..
sumerau daśasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ..19..
1.168.d:
यानैरप्रतिमैर्दिव्यैर्गीतनादसमाकुलैः॥
सुमेरौ दशसाहस्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥19॥
1.168.m: In peerless divine chariots filled with the sound of songs, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya upon Sumeru for ten thousand [years].

1.168.s:
sarvābhimataloke'sminprāpya bhogānyathepsitān..
punaretya imaṃ lokaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ viṃdate patim ..1.168.20..
1.168.d:
सर्वाभिमतलोकेऽस्मिन्प्राप्य भोगान्यथेप्सितान्॥
पुनरेत्य इमं लोकं यथेष्टं विंदते पतिम् ॥1.168.20॥
1.168.m: Having attained desired pleasures in this world of all desired things, / returning again to this world, she finds a husband to her liking.

1.168.s:
kṛtvāruṇaṃ tathā caitre gaṃdhamālyopaśobhitam ..
sthāpya pātre yathokte tu bhāskarāya nivedayet ..21..
1.168.d:
कृत्वारुणं तथा चैत्रे गंधमाल्योपशोभितम् ॥
स्थाप्य पात्रे यथोक्ते तु भास्कराय निवेदयेत् ॥21॥
1.168.m: Likewise having made Aruṇa in Caitra, beautified with perfumes and garlands, / and placing him in the vessel as prescribed, she should present him to Bhāskara.

1.168.s:
śaradiṃdupratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ..
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 22..
1.168.d:
शरदिंदुप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः ॥
वर्षायुतशतं साग्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 22॥
1.168.m: In celestial chariots fulfilling all desires, resembling the autumn moon, / she is honored in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred myriad years.

1.168.s:
karmakṣayādihāgatya putrapautrasamanvitam ..
abhīṣṭaṃ patimāsādya labhedbhogāntsudurlabhān .. 23 ..
1.168.d:
कर्मक्षयादिहागत्य पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितम् ॥
अभीष्टं पतिमासाद्य लभेद्भोगान्त्सुदुर्लभान् ॥ 23 ॥
1.168.m: Arriving here upon the exhaustion of her karma, united with sons and grandsons, / having obtained a cherished husband, she would attain pleasures very difficult to attain.

1.168.s:
taṃḍulāḍhakapiṣṭena kṛtvā vai meruparvatam ..
nikṣubhārkasamāyuktaṃ sarvadhātuvibhūṣitam .. 24
1.168.d:
तंडुलाढकपिष्टेन कृत्वा वै मेरुपर्वतम् ॥
निक्षुभार्कसमायुक्तं सर्वधातुविभूषितम् ॥ 24
1.168.m: Having fashioned Mount Meru with an āḍhaka measure of rice flour, / accompanied by Nikṣubhā and Arka, decorated with all minerals,

1.168.s:
nānālaṃkārasaṃpannaṃ nānāmālyavibhūṣitam ..
sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃ sthāpayedbhāskarālaye .. 25 ..
1.168.d:
नानालंकारसंपन्नं नानामाल्यविभूषितम् ॥
सर्वरत्नसमायुक्तं स्थापयेद्भास्करालये ॥ 25 ॥
1.168.m: endowed with various ornaments, decorated with various garlands, / accompanied by all jewels, she should install it in the abode of Bhāskara.

1.168.s:
mahadvyomavrataṃ hyetadvaiśākhe yaḥ samācaret ..
nānāvidhaiśca yānaistu sūryaloke mahīyate .. 26 ..
1.168.d:
महद्व्योमव्रतं ह्येतद्वैशाखे यः समाचरेत् ॥
नानाविधैश्च यानैस्तु सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 26 ॥
1.168.m: One who performs this great sky-vow in Vaiśākha, / is honored in the world of Sūrya with various vehicles.

1.168.s:
saurādisarvalokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānaśeṣataḥ ..
kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ patimāpnuyāt .. 27 ..
1.168.d:
सौरादिसर्वलोकेषु भुक्त्वा भोगानशेषतः ॥
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्राजानं पतिमाप्नुयात् ॥ 27 ॥
1.168.m: Having enjoyed completely all pleasures in worlds beginning with the world of Sūrya, / arriving in due course in this world, she would obtain a king as husband.

1.168.s:
dvitīyaṃ ca tathā padmamāṣāḍhe piṣṭamuttamam ..
sarvabījarasaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu śubhralakṣaṇam ..
nānākeśaragaṃdhāḍhayaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam .. 28 ..
1.168.d:
द्वितीयं च तथा पद्ममाषाढे पिष्टमुत्तमम् ॥
सर्वबीजरसैः पूर्णं कृत्वा तु शुभ्रलक्षणम् ॥
नानाकेशरगंधाढयं सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.168.m:
And likewise in Āṣāḍha [she should make] a second, excellent lotus of flour,
filling it with the essences of all seeds, making it with auspicious marks,
abundant with varied saffron-scents, adorned with all jewels.

1.168.s:
etairvā haimabhiryānaiḥ sarvabhogānvitairnṛpa ..
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ..29..
1.168.d:
एतैर्वा हैमभिर्यानैः सर्वभोगान्वितैर्नृप ॥
वर्षकोटिशतं साग्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥29॥
1.168.m:
Or on these golden vehicles provided with all pleasures, O king,
she is glorified in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred crore of years.

1.168.s:
bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānsarvalokeṣvanukramāt ..
prāptā tu sarvabhogāḍhayaṃ taruṇaṃ viṃdate patim .. 1.168.30 ..
1.168.d:
भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान्भोगान्सर्वलोकेष्वनुक्रमात् ॥
प्राप्ता तु सर्वभोगाढयं तरुणं विंदते पतिम् ॥ 1.168.30 ॥
1.168.m:
Having enjoyed abundant pleasures in all worlds in succession,
and having arrived [here], she finds a youthful husband endowed with all enjoyments.

1.168.s:
sarvadhātusamākīrṇaṃ vicitradhvajaśobhitam ..
nivedayeta sūryāya śrāvaṇe tilaparvatam .. 31 ..
1.168.d:
सर्वधातुसमाकीर्णं विचित्रध्वजशोभितम् ॥
निवेदयेत सूर्याय श्रावणे तिलपर्वतम् ॥ 31 ॥
1.168.m:
In Śrāvaṇa one should offer to Sūrya a mountain of sesame,
strewn with all minerals, adorned with variegated banners.

1.168.s:
svacchaṃdagāmibhiryānairnānā varṇavibhūṣitaiḥ ..
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 32 ..
1.168.d:
स्वच्छंदगामिभिर्यानैर्नाना वर्णविभूषितैः ॥
वर्षकोटिशतं साग्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 32 ॥
1.168.m:
On vehicles moving at will, adorned with various colours,
she is glorified in the world of Sūrya for a full hundred crore of years.

1.168.s:
saṃprāpya vividhānbhogānbahvāścaryasamanvitān ..
kramāllokamimaṃ prāpya rājānaṃ viṃdate patim .. 33 ..
1.168.d:
संप्राप्य विविधान्भोगान्बह्वाश्चर्यसमन्वितान् ॥
क्रमाल्लोकमिमं प्राप्य राजानं विंदते पतिम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.168.m:
Having attained diverse pleasures filled with many wonders,
she arrives in this world in due course and finds a king as husband.

1.168.s:
kṛtvā bhādrapade māsi vyoma śālimayaṃ nṛpa ..
vitānadhvajacchatrāḍhyaṃ nānāmālāvibhūṣitam .. 34 ..
1.168.d:
कृत्वा भाद्रपदे मासि व्योम शालिमयं नृप ॥
वितानध्वजच्छत्राढ्यं नानामालाविभूषितम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.168.m:
Having made a firmament of rice in the month of Bhādrapada, O king,
rich with canopies, banners, and royal parasols, adorned with various garlands,

1.168.s:
taruṇārkakaraprakhyairmahā yānaiḥ suśobhanai ..
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate .. 35 ..
1.168.d:
तरुणार्ककरप्रख्यैर्महा यानैः सुशोभनै ॥
वर्षकोटिसहस्राणि सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 35 ॥
1.168.m:
she is glorified in the world of Sūrya for thousands of crores of years
on beautiful great vehicles resembling the rays of the morning sun.

1.168.s:
saṃprāpya vividhānbhogāntsarvānnimiṣasaṃbhavān ..
kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ viṃdate patim .. 36 ..
1.168.d:
संप्राप्य विविधान्भोगान्त्सर्वान्निमिषसंभवान् ॥
क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन्राजानं विंदते पतिम् ॥ 36 ॥
1.168.m:
Having obtained various pleasures, all born in an instant,
she arrives in this world in due course and finds a king as husband.

1.168.s:
kṛtvā cāśvayuje māsi vipulaṃ dhānyaparvatam ..
suvarṇavastragaṃdhāḍhyaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet .. 37 ..
1.168.d:
कृत्वा चाश्वयुजे मासि विपुलं धान्यपर्वतम् ॥
सुवर्णवस्त्रगंधाढ्यं भास्कराय निवेदयेत् ॥ 37 ॥
1.168.m:
And having made in the month of Āśvayuja an extensive mountain of grain,
rich in gold, garments, and perfumes, she should offer it to Bhāskara.

1.168.s:
sāvitraiśca mahāyānairvarabhogasamanvitaiḥ ..
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate .. 38 ..
1.168.d:
सावित्रैश्च महायानैर्वरभोगसमन्वितैः ॥
वर्षकोटिसहस्राणि सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 38 ॥
1.168.m:
On great solar vehicles endowed with choice pleasures,
she is glorified in the world of Sūrya for thousands of crores of years.

1.168.s:
sūryalokādilokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān ..
asmim̐lloke cā saṃprāptā rājānaṃ viṃdate patim ..
candrāgnibhāskarāṇāṃ tu kāṃtitejaḥprabhānvitam .. 39 ..
1.168.d:
सूर्यलोकादिलोकेषु भुक्त्वा भोगान्यथेप्सितान् ॥
